jobs.description:
Job Description

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Data Center Development organization leads the planning, design, and delivery of the next generation of Oracle’s global data center portfolio. We are seeking a Senior Director of Data Center Development to provide strategic leadership and organizational oversight for the design of mission-critical infrastructure across OCI’s rapidly expanding global footprint.

This role is responsible for establishing and executing OCI’s data center design strategy across a portfolio of large-scale, highly complex developments. The Senior Director will lead a team of design management professionals and provide executive-level oversight of multidisciplinary design activities spanning architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, and mission-critical infrastructure systems.

The position requires a combination of organizational leadership, technical depth, design governance, and portfolio management. The successful candidate will establish clear design requirements, drive consistency across projects and delivery partners, manage technical risk, and ensure that OCI’s facilities meet established requirements for performance, reliability, resiliency, scalability, constructability, and operational readiness.

The Senior Director will serve as a senior technical and organizational leader within OCI Data Center Development, partnering closely with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Network, Capacity Planning, Energy, Security, and other internal organizations. The role will also provide senior-level direction to colocation partners, architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and other external stakeholders responsible for delivering OCI

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

Lead the Data Center Design Management function for an assigned global or multi-region portfolio of hyperscale and mission-critical infrastructure projects.
Establish organizational priorities, expectations, governance processes, and performance standards for the design management team.
Lead, develop, and mentor design managers and design leadership personnel, establishing clear accountability for project execution, technical quality, and professional development.
Provide portfolio-level oversight of multidisciplinary data center design across architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, life safety, and supporting infrastructure systems.
Establish and maintain design governance throughout the project lifecycle, from early planning and Basis of Design development through schematic design, design development, construction documentation, construction support, commissioning, and record documentation.
Ensure projects maintain alignment with OCI technical requirements, design standards, operational requirements, reliability objectives, and infrastructure strategies.
Provide senior technical leadership for high-density compute environments, including mechanical systems, liquid cooling, electrical infrastructure, controls, and other mission-critical systems supporting next-generation cloud and AI infrastructure.
Drive consistent implementation and continuous improvement of OCI global data center design standards, specifications, design criteria, and best practices.
Establish effective design review, technical approval, change management, and decision-making processes across the portfolio.
Identify systemic and project-specific design risks and ensure appropriate mitigation, escalation, and resolution before those risks impact construction, schedule, cost, reliability, or operations.
Lead resolution of complex multidisciplinary technical issues requiring coordination across internal organizations, design consultants, construction teams, operators, and external delivery partners.
Partner with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Network, Capacity Planning, Energy, Security, and other OCI organizations to ensure infrastructure requirements are coordinated and incorporated into project designs.
Provide senior-level oversight of architects, engineers, consultants, colocation providers, and other design partners responsible for delivering OCI infrastructure.
Establish expectations for consultant scope, performance, technical quality, schedule adherence, and design deliverables.
Ensure Basis of Design, SD, DD, permit, IFC, and record design packages meet OCI requirements and are appropriately reviewed and approved.
Drive standardization and repeatability while maintaining the flexibility necessary to address regional requirements, site conditions, utility constraints, code requirements, and evolving technology.
Evaluate proposed design changes and deviations to determine portfolio-level impacts to reliability, operations, schedule, cost, standards, and future scalability.
Develop and monitor design performance metrics, portfolio risks, technical issues, and organizational priorities, providing clear reporting and recommendations to executive leadership.
Support strategic planning for future data center capacity, emerging technologies, new infrastructure architectures, and evolving cloud and AI requirements.
Represent OCI Data Center Design Management in executive reviews, technical workshops, partner engagements, design reviews, and other internal and external forums.
Build a culture of technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and disciplined design governance across the organization.

Required Qualifications:

Professional licensure required as a Registered Architect (RA) or Professional Engineer (PE).
Accredited degree in Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of progressively responsible experience in data center, mission-critical, industrial, or large-scale infrastructure design and development.
Significant leadership experience managing design professionals, multidisciplinary technical teams, and external architecture and engineering organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale hyperscale, cloud, colocation, or mission-critical infrastructure programs.
Strong multidisciplinary understanding of data center architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, life safety, and supporting infrastructure systems.
Demonstrated ability to establish and manage design governance, standards, technical requirements, and change control across multiple concurrent projects.
Experience managing complex project portfolios involving multiple sites, delivery partners, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
Strong understanding of data center mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with experience in high-density and liquid-cooled environments strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of data center electrical distribution, resiliency strategies, controls, commissioning, and operational requirements.
Demonstrated ability to identify, communicate, and resolve complex technical and organizational risks.
Experience working within accelerated design and construction programs where schedule, scalability, repeatability, and technical quality are critical.
Strong executive communication, organizational leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to both executive and technical audiences.
Working knowledge of applicable data center codes, standards, and industry guidance, including NFPA, ASHRAE, IBC, and other applicable international, national, and local requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

15+ years of experience in mission-critical or large-scale infrastructure design and development.
Experience leading design organizations supporting hyperscale cloud or AI infrastructure.
Experience managing global or multi-region data center portfolios.
Experience developing and implementing enterprise-level data center design standards, specifications, and governance programs.
Experience with high-density compute environments, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, advanced thermal management, and next-generation data center infrastructure.
Experience with colocation and developer-led delivery models, including oversight of third-party design and construction partners.
Experience implementing formal design review, technical deviation, change management, and lessons-learned processes.
Working knowledge of BIM, digital design coordination, document management, and design collaboration platforms.
LEED AP, Uptime ATD, or other relevant mission-critical industry certifications.
Demonstrated experience developing high-performing technical teams and future organizational leaders.

jobs.description:
About The Team

The Applied AI Architecture team is responsible for helping developers and enterprises safely and effectively deploy OpenAI technologies in production. We act as trusted technical advisors and thought partners for customers, working side by side with their teams to identify high-value use cases, design practical architectures, and move from prototype to durable deployment.

Cybersecurity is one of the most urgent domains where AI can help. Security teams are under pressure to reason across code, logs, infrastructure, tickets, alerts, and vulnerability data faster than ever. As frontier models become more capable, organizations need deep technical guidance on how to evaluate, validate, and safely deploy AI systems in security-critical workflows.

About The Role

We are looking for a Cybersecurity Applied AI Architect to partner with customers and help them apply OpenAI models, APIs, Codex, and agentic workflows to real cybersecurity use cases. You will work with CISOs, security executives, application security leaders, SOC teams, security engineering teams, and hands-on practitioners to identify where AI can create measurable security outcomes.

This is a customer-facing technical role for someone who can move fluidly between executive strategy, practitioner-level cyber depth, and hands-on solution design. You will help customers evaluate and deploy workflows such as secure code review, vulnerability triage, threat modeling, remediation, SOC and incident response workflows, detection engineering, cloud security, GRC automation, and security validation.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Research, and Security to turn customer needs into safe deployment patterns, reusable field assets, and product feedback.

In This Role, You Will

Deeply embed with strategic customers as the technical lead for AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows, serving as a trusted partner to both security executives and technical practitioners.
Lead discovery across AppSec, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, SOC/IR, detection engineering, red team, cloud security, identity, and GRC automation use cases.
Build and deliver customer-facing demos, prototypes, workshops, proofs of concept, and reference architectures using OpenAI APIs, Codex, agents, scripts, CLIs, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, logs, tickets, scanners, and common security tools.
Scope pilots with clear success criteria, data requirements, workflow integrations, evaluation methods, security constraints, safety boundaries, and human approval points.
Advise customers on safe implementation patterns, including tool and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval, sandboxing, data handling, guardrails, telemetry, auditability, and approval-gated side effects.
Translate between CISO-level outcomes and practitioner-level implementation details so each audience understands value, risk, and practical next steps.
Create reusable field assets such as demo narratives, playbooks, FAQs, objection handling, qualification guides, assessment templates, and competitive positioning.
Validate, synthesize, and deliver high-signal feedback to Product, Engineering, Research, Security, and GTM teams based on recurring customer requirements, blockers, product gaps, and emerging cyber workflows.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have 5+ years of technical consulting, solutions engineering, security architecture, cyber advisory, deployment engineering, professional services, or equivalent customer-facing technical experience.
Bring strong cybersecurity domain expertise across one or more areas such as application security, cloud security, identity, vulnerability management, secure SDLC, incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, red teaming, or security architecture.
Can communicate credibly with CISOs, CTOs, security executives, engineering leaders, and highly technical security practitioners.
Have hands-on experience building prototypes or production systems with APIs, Python or JavaScript, agents, scripts, CLIs, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, logs, tickets, scanners, or other common security tooling.
Understand how to design AI workflows with retrieval, structured outputs, tool use, evals, guardrails, telemetry, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop review.
Are comfortable scoping pilots from ambiguous customer pain, including success metrics, required data, workflow integrations, evaluation criteria, deployment assumptions, and decision gates.
Have evidence-first security judgment: you validate findings, separate true positives from noise, document assumptions, and avoid overstating model or security claims.
Own problems end-to-end, operate with high throughput across multiple concurrent customer projects, and know when to stay hands-on versus create reusable leverage for the broader field.
Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team and our customers successful.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Director of Finance, Contract leads the day-to-day operations of the Finance function — financial planning & analysis, accounting, treasury, reporting, and controls — ensuring the organization's financial operations are accurate, timely, and disciplined. This role translates the CFO's financial strategy into operational execution and partners closely with the Director, PMO to ensure enterprise programs are properly resourced, tracked, and financially governed.

Reporting to the CFO, the Director, Finance partners with the Director, PMO; Director, Innovation; and Director, Human Resources as part of the CFO's core leadership team, ensuring finance, technology, people, and program delivery function as a coherent, well-run “operating system” for the business.

Duration: This is a 14-month maternity leave contract, running from February 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027.

WalterFedy is growing! For outstanding talent, this role has real potential to be extended. It's an opportunity to make an immediate impact and build a long-term future with our Finance team.

Accountabilities / Responsibilities

Client Delivery

This role's “clients” are primarily internal: business/practice line leaders who rely on Finance for accurate reporting, forecasting, and decision support. The role also maintains day-to-day external relationships (auditors, lenders, insurers), escalating strategic matters to the CFO.

Serve as the primary finance business partner to practice/business line leaders on budgeting, forecasting, utilization, margin, and project financial performance.
Maintain strong day-to-day working relationships with auditors, banking partners, and insurers, escalating strategic matters to the CFO.
Support practice leaders with accurate, timely financial data to inform pricing, resourcing, and project decisions.

Financial Delivery

Lead day-to-day financial planning & analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting for the organization.
Own the accounting function: general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, payroll coordination, and month-end/year-end close.
Lead treasury operations, cash flow management, and banking relationships.
Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial statements and internal management reporting.
Maintain strong internal controls and support audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
Monitor utilization, realization, backlog, and project margin performance, escalating trends to the CFO.

Business Processes

Own and continuously improve core finance processes, systems, and reporting tools (ERP, financial reporting/BI tools).
Automation & AI enablement: Partner with the Director, Innovation on finance system upgrades, automation of manual finance processes, and adoption of AI-enabled tools for forecasting, reporting, or analysis.
Develop and maintain financial policies, procedures, and delegation of authority frameworks.
Support enterprise governance by ensuring enterprise program budgets and business cases meet finance standards before approval, in partnership with the Director, PMO.

Leadership and Culture

Lead, coach, and develop the Finance team, building depth and succession within the function.
Partner with the Director, Human Resources on workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and headcount/capacity planning from a financial lens.
Act as a trusted, approachable finance partner to non-finance leaders, building financial literacy across the organization.
Model financial discipline and transparency, reinforcing a culture of accountability.
Support the CFO on special projects, board materials, and executive-level financial analysis as needed.

Skills / Competencies

Strategic Vision & Long-Range Planning: Finance function strategist; translates enterprise financial strategy into operational plans.
Financial Acumen & Capital Allocation: Deep technical expertise in accounting, treasury, and financial reporting.
Operational Excellence, Delivery & Resource Management: Finance operations, reporting, and controls excellence.
People Leadership & Talent Development: Finance team builder and developer.
Client Leadership & External Relationships: Day-to-day auditor, lender, and insurer relationship management.
Change Leadership: Finance process and systems change lead; partners with the Director, PMO on enterprise program financial governance.
Innovation/Continuous Improvement: Champions automation of finance processes and adoption of AI-enabled tools.
Commercial Acumen, Client Growth & Market Development: Supports pricing, fee models, and business case analysis.
Risk Management & Governance: Internal controls and audit-readiness specialist.
Communication & Executive Presence: Trusted finance advisor to non-finance leaders.
Technical / Practice Leadership: Finance and accounting subject matter expert.
Culture Building & Organizational Health: Champions financial discipline and transparency.
Cross-Functional Integration: Finance partner to the Director, PMO, Director, Human Resources, and Director, Innovation on enterprise initiatives.

Qualifications

University degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Active CPA (or equivalent professional accounting designation) required.
Minimum 7 years of progressive finance experience, including people leadership, ideally within a professional services, or engineering/architecture , or similarly project-based organization.
Demonstrated experience in financial planning & analysis, treasury, and controls.
Experience in a growth-stage or scaling organization is an asset.

At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. This job posting is for an existing vacancy. If you are ready to deliver best-in-class service and join a collaborative, motivated and fun team of professionals, IMCO offers the opportunity to do impactful work and broaden your expertise.

If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

‎

As IMCO continues to evolve its Target Operating Model, the importance of timely, trusted, and actionable risk and performance insights continues to grow. Technology plays a critical role in enabling investment decision-making, performance measurement, portfolio analytics, regulatory reporting, and enterprise risk oversight.

If you are looking to lead a strategic technology portfolio and help shape the future of Risk and Performance capabilities at IMCO, we would love to hear from you.

We are looking for a highly motivated Director, Risk & Performance Technology.

Reporting to the Vice President, Investment Technology, the Director, Risk & Performance Technology is accountable for the strategy, delivery, operation, and evolution of IMCO's Risk and Performance technology capabilities.

This role provides technology leadership for the applications, analytical platforms, reporting capabilities, and integrations that support Risk and Performance. The Director will establish the roadmap for the Risk and Performance technology portfolio, lead key technology initiatives, and ensure technology capabilities remain scalable, reliable, and aligned with IMCO's future operating model.

The role partners closely with Risk, Performance, Investment Operations, Data & AI Enablement, Enterprise Technology, and Front Office stakeholders to improve analytical capabilities, enhance reporting and measurement processes, and deliver trusted insights across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Business Partnership

Serve as a trusted technology advisor to leaders across Risk and Performance.
Partner with business stakeholders to identify future capability needs, technology opportunities, and process improvement initiatives.
Contribute to Investment Technology planning activities and support the development of long-term technology strategies across the investment ecosystem.
Support business case development, vendor evaluations, and technology investment decisions related to Risk and Performance platforms.

Risk & Performance Solution Delivery

Lead the delivery and enhancement of technology solutions supporting portfolio risk measurement, factor analytics, exposure analysis, performance measurement, attribution, benchmark management, and investment reporting.
Oversee the design, implementation, integration, and support of business-critical applications and analytical platforms.
Ensure solutions are designed to support scalability, automation, operational efficiency, and future business growth.

Application Portfolio Ownership

Establish application roadmaps, lifecycle management plans, and support strategies that align with business objectives.
Lead application upgrades, enhancements, integrations, modernization initiatives, and platform rationalization activities.
Evaluate emerging vendor solutions and analytical capabilities to support evolving business requirements.
Manage strategic relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and service providers.

Data, Analytics & Reporting Enablement

Partner with the Data Platform & AI Engineering team and business stakeholders to ensure Risk and Performance solutions leverage trusted, governed, and reconciled investment data.
Support the development and consumption of analytical data products, calculation engines, and reporting-ready datasets.
Drive improvements in measurement processes, reporting workflows, calculation transparency, and analytical consistency.
Promote the adoption of common data standards and integrated analytical capabilities across investment teams.
Enable modern analytics, reporting, and decision-support capabilities that improve investment insight and business outcomes.

Governance & Operational Excellence

Ensure Risk and Performance technology solutions operate in accordance with IMCO policies, architecture standards, security requirements, and governance frameworks.
Establish operational processes that support stable, secure, and sustainable application services.
Oversee incident, problem, change, release, and service management activities across the portfolio.
Support audits, risk assessments, compliance reviews, and control testing activities.
Ensure appropriate documentation, training materials, support procedures, and operational controls are maintained.

People Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing team of business analysts, application specialists, technical leads, and technology professionals.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Coach, mentor, and develop team members to support career growth and organizational capability development.
Establish clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans aligned with business and technology goals.

What you need to succeed:

12+ years of progressive experience delivering and supporting investment technology solutions within asset management, investment management, or financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading technology teams supporting Risk, Performance, Analytics, or related investment functions.
Strong understanding of portfolio risk management, performance measurement and attribution, benchmark management, investment reporting, and portfolio analytics.

Experience managing software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers.

Excellent communication, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Experience with industry-leading Risk and Performance platforms such as MSCI RiskManager, BarraOne, Axioma, FactSet, Bloomberg PORT, Eagle Performance, or similar solutions is highly desirable.

jobs.description:
Description

The opportunity

Aspire Software, an operating group of Valsoft Corporation, acquires, builds, and grows vertical market software companies around the world. Each brand operates with entrepreneurial autonomy while benefiting from shared expertise, leadership, and collaboration across our global portfolio.

Aspire Software is launching a new AI-driven B2B SaaS venture and is seeking an AI Lead to build and lead it from day one. We partner with vertical market software businesses to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can unlock significant customer value. This new venture will focus on building a developer-first, AI-enabled SaaS platform, designed to integrate seamlessly into existing workflows and scale through strong product adoption.

The market opportunity is proven, fragmented, and ready for transformation. As AI Lead, you will shape the product vision, drive go-to-market execution, build the founding team, and establish market leadership - backed by Aspire and Valsoft’s capital, infrastructure, and global operating expertise.

What You'll Be Doing 

Lead a new B2B SaaS business built around AI and platform innovation in a vertical software market 
Develop and execute a scalable go-to-market strategy: identify early adopters, iterate on positioning, and close first customers 
Define product and market strategy, with a strong focus on developer experience, adoption, and scalability
Build a milestone-based plan, allocate budget, and raise capital with our support 
Assemble a high-performing team to execute across product, tech, sales, and operations 
Partner closely with technical leaders to ensure high-quality APIs, SDKs, documentation, and integration workflows
Own and operate the business with full autonomy  

What You Bring 

A founder mindset: You’re motivated by building from scratch and fully owning the journey 
3+ years of experience building or operating AI software, API or SDK based platforms with leadership experience (e.g. Product lead, Startup Founder, or Sales/Operations lead) 
Demonstrated success in building early-stage ventures or leading 0→1 product launches, with bachelor in relevant field  
Strong understanding of developer-first products, including documentation, onboarding, reliability, and versioning
Grit and resourcefulness with proven success of operating without a playbook  
Commercial mindset with exposure to pricing, packaging, GTM execution, and customer adoption
Excellent communication skills across technical and business domains
Ability to drive the overall company vision, culture, and performance 

What You’ll Own 

P&L responsibility: You’ll run the company day-to-day and long-term 
Equity stake: You’ll be a significant shareholder in the business you help create 
Product and market vision: You’ll lead strategy, execution, and team alignment 
Customer outcomes: You’ll focus relentlessly on value creation for users 

How To Apply  

Interested? Send your resume and a brief note about why you're excited about this opportunity. We'd love to see:  

Your track record building or scaling businesses  
Examples of go-to-market strategies you've developed and executed  
Anything that demonstrates your ability to build from scratch and drive results 

About Valsoft 

Established in Canada in 2015, Valsoft Corporation acquires, operates, and scales vertical market software companies around the world. Through our AI Ventures program, we’re building a new generation of AI-native businesses designed to transform specific industries. Each venture operates as an independent startup — with speed, ownership, and autonomy, backed by Valsoft’s global infrastructure and capital.

L'opportunité

Aspire Software, une division de Valsoft Corporation, acquiert, développe et fait croître des entreprises de logiciels spécialisées dans des marchés verticaux à travers le monde. Chaque marque bénéficie d'une autonomie entrepreneuriale tout en profitant de l'expertise, du leadership et de la collaboration partagés au sein de notre portefeuille mondial.

Aspire Software lance une nouvelle plateforme SaaS B2B basée sur l'IA et recherche un Responsable IA pour la développer et la piloter dès son lancement. Nous collaborons avec des entreprises de logiciels spécialisées dans des marchés verticaux afin d'identifier les opportunités à fort impact où l'IA peut générer une valeur client significative. Cette nouvelle plateforme se concentrera sur la création d'une plateforme SaaS centrée sur les développeurs et intégrant l'IA, conçue pour s'intégrer facilement aux flux de travail existants et évoluer grâce à une forte adoption du produit.

Le marché est porteur, fragmenté et mûr pour la transformation. En tant que Responsable IA, vous définirez la vision produit, piloterez la stratégie de commercialisation, constituerez l'équipe fondatrice et établirez le leadership sur le marché, soutenu par le capital, l'infrastructure et l'expertise opérationnelle mondiale d'Aspire et de Valsoft.

Vos Missions

Piloter une nouvelle activité SaaS B2B axée sur l'IA et l'innovation de plateforme au sein d'un marché vertical du logiciel.
Développer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de commercialisation évolutive : identifier les premiers utilisateurs, optimiser le positionnement et conclure les premiers contrats.
Définir la stratégie produit et marché, en mettant l'accent sur l'expérience développeur, l'adoption et l'évolutivité.
Élaborer un plan par étapes, allouer le budget et lever des fonds avec notre soutien.
Constituer une équipe performante pour assurer la mise en œuvre des projets produit, technique, commercial et opérationnel.
Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables techniques pour garantir la qualité des API, des SDK, de la documentation et des flux d'intégration.
Gérer l'activité en toute autonomie.

Votre Profil

Plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans la conception ou l'exploitation de logiciels d'IA, de plateformes API ou SDK, avec une expérience en management (par exemple : chef de produit, fondateur de startup ou responsable commercial/opérations).
Expérience réussie dans la création d'entreprises en phase de démarrage ou le lancement de produits (de 0 à 1), avec un diplôme de niveau bac+3/4. Expérience pertinente
Solide compréhension des produits destinés aux développeurs, notamment en matière de documentation, d'intégration, de fiabilité et de gestion des versions
Esprit entrepreneurial : vous êtes motivé(e) par la création d'un produit à partir de zéro et souhaitez en assumer pleinement la responsabilité
Persévérance et ingéniosité, avec une expérience réussie de la gestion de projets sans plan préétabli
Sens commercial et expérience en matière de tarification, de packaging, de stratégie de mise sur le marché et d'adoption par les clients
Excellentes compétences en communication, tant sur le plan technique que commercial
Capacité à piloter la vision, la culture et la performance globales de l'entreprise

Vos responsabilités

Job Description

You will be working on a 100% remote schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.

Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.

At Fidelity, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.

Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.

How You’ll Make An Impact

The Director, Systems & Platform Integration will lead FCC’s capability for connecting the systems, platforms, vendors, services, and data flows that support Fidelity Clearing Canada’s business. FCC operates in a regulated clearing and brokerage environment serving introducing brokers, portfolio managers, and institutional/intermediary clients. This role owns the integration layer across FCC’s APIs, services, messages, files, data interfaces, vendor/client platform connections, workflows, reporting, operations, and enterprise services, while aligning with Fidelity Canada, FIL, and broader enterprise standards where relevant.

Integrate clients, platforms, vendors, enterprise services, APIs, messages, files, and data feeds securely and reliably.
Keep FCC’s clearing, brokerage, client, reporting, reconciliation, and operational flows auditable, monitored, recoverable, and ready for growth.
Move FCC toward reusable integration standards, stronger automation, AI enablement, operational digitization, scalable platform capabilities, and alignment with Fidelity Canada, FIL, and FCC-specific needs.
Provide senior client-facing leadership for organizations integrating with FCC, building trusted relationships with client technology and business representatives and ensuring that integration requirements, solution options, responsibilities, risks, timelines, testing, cutover readiness, and support expectations are clearly understood and effectively managed.
Own a roadmap balancing modernization, workflow automation, AI enablement, operational digitization, enterprise integration, resiliency, risk reduction, cost, and delivery trade-offs.
All direct reports have clear performance expectations, regular coaching, development plans, and succession or cross-training coverage for critical capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
7+ years of technology management and leadership experience in financial services, clearing, brokerage, wealth, custody, banking, capital markets, or another regulated transaction-processing environment.
Strong experience leading systems/platform integration, APIs, services, messaging, files, batch, data feeds, vendor connectivity, client-facing platform delivery, and modern integration platforms such as Solace, Boomi, Kafka, MuleSoft, IBM MQ/App Connect, AWS/Azure Integration Services, or similar tools.
Demonstrated technical leadership in integration architecture, solution design, design reviews, non-functional requirements, production readiness, and technical risk decisions.
Demonstrated experience in a client-facing leadership role, working directly with external clients and senior stakeholders
Experience leading teams of architects, analysts, technical leads, integration specialists, etc.,

Experience using AI-assisted development, automation, analytics insight, developer productivity tooling, and enterprise integration capabilities is an asset
Experience governing integration standards for service contracts, data mappings, API design, event flows, file exchanges, error handling, monitoring, logging, auditability, and support handoff.
Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud-enabled architecture, production reliability, observability, incident/problem/change
Technically credible and engineering-first - understands APIs, services, messages, files, event streaming, iPaaS, ESB, data flows, system dependencies, production support, architecture, standards, integration tools such as Solace, Boomi, Kafka, MuleSoft or similar platforms, automation, developer productivity, and technical risk.
Understands clearing, brokerage, reporting, reconciliation, regulatory, service quality, and operational impacts.
Architecturally minded, modernization oriented, and operationally disciplined - drives reusable standards, scalable integration capability, monitoring, controls, recoverability, cybersecurity, auditability, resilience, and production stability.
Strong client-facing, relationship-management, presentation, and communication skills, with the credibility to lead technical discussions, explain trade-offs, resolve issues, and build confidence with clients, partners, and senior executives.
Enterprise-aligned portfolio integrator - connects FCC priorities with Fidelity Canada, FIL, enterprise technology direction, modernization, AI enablement, operational digitization, and BAU stability.

jobs.title: Director, Investment & Digital Enablement
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As a Director, Investment & Digital Enablement, you will be a strategic voice on the Savings, Investments and Advice team. You will support defining the business intent and outcomes, author business cases, groom roadmaps and initiative-level direction for some of our most complex, highest-impact client journeys, working 1–3 quarters ahead to ensure squads always have a business-justified pipeline to execute against. You will regularly extend your expertise across multiple squads, partnering and advising stakeholders and Sr. Executives, while mentoring emerging talent across the team.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You'll Succeed

Own the business case and roadmap for high-impact initiatives — Lead the development of the squad-level roadmap, business cases and benefit forecasts for highly visible initiatives in the Saving, Investments & Advice domain, ensuring every initiative entering the backlog is grounded in a clear, quantifiable business rationale.
Lead discovery and business direction — Author and facilitate discovery with your Product Owner & stakeholders, establishing the business direction, journey context and initiative framing that sets the direction for requirements and overall squad success.
Author epics that set squads up to win — Defining business objectives, success metrics and scope before a single story is written. Hold the quality bar for Epics across the team.
Be the senior business voice with stakeholders — Act as the interface between your squads and senior business stakeholders, translating progress into compelling business narratives and representing the squad wherever investment and prioritization decisions are made.
Own benefit realization — Define KPIs and success metrics at the outset of every initiative, and partner with measurement and analytics teams post-launch to track performance against the original business case.
Extend your expertise across squads — Provide advisory support to multiple squads, bringing consistency and best practice to business execution planning throughout.
Mentor and elevate team talent — Coach junior and intermediate members of the Investment & Digital Enablement team and contribute directly to team standards, tools and ways of working.

Who You Are

You can demonstrate experience. 10+ years of experience in leading large, cross-functional, complex initiatives, business analysis, client/product strategy, or a closely related discipline, ideally within financial services or another regulated environment. You have a proven track record of owning Epics, business cases, or equivalent initiative-level artifacts, and translating them into roadmaps that Product Owners and squads can execute against.
You can demonstrate knowledge. You bring working knowledge of agile delivery — Jira, Epics and Stories, story-writing standards and INVEST principles — and apply it fluently across a multi-squad environment.
You are a strategic storyteller and influencer. You are able to distill complex, ambiguous business problems into a clear narrative and business case that earns buy-in from Product Owners, technology partners and senior executives alike.
You are a systems thinker with commercial instinct. You connect client needs, business objectives and platform capability, and know how to sequence work so today's results sets up tomorrow's opportunity.
You are a credible communicator. You are able to effectively communicate with senior business stakeholders, capable of building and defending a business case at the executive level.
You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can hold a long view of the roadmap 1–3 quarters ahead, while still bringing the discipline to translate strategy into a well-scoped, buildable Epic.
You are a trusted advisor. You build credibility through the quality of your thinking and the consistency of your judgment rather than a reporting line, and you use that credibility to guide Product Owners and shape team standards. You have experience mentoring or informally guiding colleagues. This role does not carry formal people-management accountability, but team-level mentorship is core to the mandate.
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

What You Need To Know

CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com
CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.

We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency).
We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.

jobs.title: Director, Technology
jobs.description:
We Are Banking At Another Level.

Choosing BDC as your employer
means working in a healthy, inclusive, and skilled workplace that puts forward the best conditions to bring together unique teams where employees are empowered to act. It also means being at the centre of ambitious economic and financial projects to see further and to do things differently, to fuel the success of Canadian entrepreneurs.

Choosing BDC As Your Employer Also Means

Flexible and competitive benefits, including an Employee Savings and Investment Plan where BDC matches part of your voluntary contributions, a Defined Benefit Pension Plan, a $750 wellness and health care spending account, to name a few
In addition to paid vacation each year, five personal days, sick days as necessary, and our offices are closed from December 25 to January 1
A hybrid work model that truly balances work and personal life
Opportunities for learning, training and development, and much more...

Explore the BDC Way in our Culture Book

Position Overview

BDC Mission AI helps small and medium-sized businesses identify their needs, matches them with Canadian AI solutions, and tests these tools in real-world business settings. To do this, we’re building a self-sufficient and agile AI platform, moving at a startup’s pace.

As Director of Technology, you are a builder who codes. You design and operate the Mission AI platform, lead a small team that delivers quickly, and contribute your AI expertise to technology and investment decisions. You make technical decisions within the authorized framework, in collaboration with business leaders—who define requirements and value criteria—and with the validation and investment teams.

CHALLENGES TO BE MET

AI Architecture and Platform
Define the architecture and technology roadmap for the AI platform, including decisions on whether to build, buy, or partner.
Deliver platform milestones, from the diagnostic MVP to its phased rollout to Canadian SMEs.
Establish AI system evaluation, human oversight, and tracking of operating costs.
Development and Team Leadership
Recruit, lead, and develop the AI development team; establish best practices for delivery, quality, and AI-assisted development.
Internal and External Technology
Develop the team’s internal tools: radar, pilot tracking, and metrics dashboards.
Provide the team with AI agents and automations that increase their autonomy and productivity; make Mission AI a model for AI-driven work.
Manage technology vendors and platform operations: availability, access, security, and disaster recovery.
Integrate BDC systems only when necessary, using lightweight connections.
Obtain BDC’s security and data protection approvals without slowing down delivery.
Conduct technical due diligence on investments: architecture, code quality, AI defensibility, data, security, intellectual property, costs, and scalability.
Evaluate the security and integrability of solutions with the relevant teams prior to approval.
Metrics and Data
Measure usage and productivity gains at 3, 6, and 12 months.
Conduct assessments and create a dynamic map of SMB needs.

Priorities for the First 90 Days

Define the architecture, data model, security requirements, and delivery plan.
Deliver the diagnostic MVP and test it with pilot SMEs.
Hire the first AI developers and establish development and evaluation practices.

What Success Looks Like (12–18 Months)

Platform milestones achieved, from the MVP to nationwide rollout.
Quality of AI recommendations and responses, reliability, cost per diagnosis.
Technical deliverables completed on schedule; team autonomy.

What We’re Looking For

10 or more years in software development
At least 7 years in technical leadership as well
Someone who still codes on a daily basis
Active developer: proficiency in a modern programming language and the ability to deploy to production independently.
Advanced AI expertise: products in production based on large language models (agents, RAG, evaluations, costs, and performance).
Knowledge of the model ecosystem (commercial, open-source, and Canadian) and the ability to select the right model for the use case.
Proficiency in cloud architecture, APIs, data pipelines, and application security.
Ability to explain a technical risk to a business stakeholder and to critically evaluate a startup or vendor.

Assets

Experience as a CTO or founding engineer at a startup or scale-up: strongly preferred.
Technical due diligence for investments (funds, venture studios, acquisitions).
Visible contributions: open-source projects, technical publications, launched AI products.
Knowledge of security requirements in regulated environments (financial institutions or government).

What Will Make The Difference

Pragmatic builder: prototypes in days, deploys to production in weeks.
Stays at the cutting edge of AI and applies it practically, without chasing every trend.
Keeps the user in focus: an SME owner with no IT staff or spare time.
Builds a platform where AI is the driving force, not an add-on, and empowers the entire team to work differently.

Why join BDC?

Combine the scale and mission of a national development bank with the autonomy of a startup. You’ll contribute to one of BDC’s most ambitious initiatives and shape the adoption of AI by Canadian SMEs.

Proudly one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers
and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers
, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive and accessible environment where all employees can thrive and feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work. If you require an accommodation to complete your application, please do not hesitate to contact us at accessibility@bdc.ca.

jobs.description:

At Arup we’re dedicated to shaping a better world. Our purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years. We’re a thriving and growing organization which offers you many possibilities to shape a better world, and your future.

In an increasingly competitive marketplace, our Marketing, Communications, and Business Development (MCBD) team enables Arup to build and protect our reputation, deepen client relationships, win quality work, and attract top talent. This role will be key in achieving strategic market and client ambitions. We are seeking to appoint a Head of Communications, Brand & Digital Marketing - Americas Region t o join our MCBD function.

What This Role Involves

The Head of Communications, Brand & Digital Marketing - Americas Region plays a central role in leading the development and implementation of Arup’s regional communications plan enhancing, protecting Arup’s brand and reputation, and guiding the evolution of our digital footprint, ensuring alignment with our strategy and the business priorities defined in our integrated business plan.

The role leads the regional Communications, Brand & Digital Marketing teams and ensures positive work sharing, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness of our resources supporting region and global priorities . They also work closely with the Regional Leadership: including the Managing Director, the Business and Markets Leader, MCBD Leader, Global Communications Leaders and Legal Counsel ensuring cohesive and effective delivery of content and campaigns that elevate the brand.

Team Leadership

Builds, mentors, and leads a high-performing team providing performance management and career development advice, as well as ongoing training and development opportunities to team members.
Foster a collaborative, inclusive and innovative team culture.
Champions connectivity and collaboration across the MCBD team, enabling joint working, resource flexibility and sharing better practice and learnings.

Communications Strategy, Planning and Management

Brand & Visual Communications

Digital Marketing & Social Media

Knowledge And Experience

10+ years proven experience in digital marketing, brand management, and communications.
Knowledge of current trends and developments in communications, particularly in strategy, reputation management, and application of digital tools and techniques.
Strong understanding of digital analytics, SEO/SEM, paid media, and content marketing.
Significant, proven experience in strategic communications and proven track record in several of the following areas: communications strategy and planning, crisis communications, leadership communications and/or internal communications.
Demonstrated experience in leading a large team in an international business and in applying business partnering models across a range of communications specialisms.
Demonstrated experience in building trusted, influential relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience in building, managing and reporting on budgets.
Experience in leading change, innovation and operational excellence within MCBD functions.

Strong skills in strategic thinking and analysis and problem-solving.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in communications technologies.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment across multiple time zones and adaptable to changing requirements. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
Comfortable with high levels of ambiguity, particularly in the context of matrix organizational structures.
Able to build strong and highly collaborative working relationships with peers, leaders and other stakeholders.
High level of personal integrity, professionalism, and inclusive leadership. Commitment to exemplifying Arup’s aims, particularly those of being a ‘humane organization’, maintaining ‘quality of work’, and ‘straight and honorable dealings’.

If you want to drive the evolution of our communications, brand and digital marketing at a moment of significant change, bringing together creativity, technology and insight to strengthen our reputation, deepen engagement and support future growth.
If you aim to lead an integrated global capability, influence senior leadership and transform how we communicate, engage our audiences and build relevance in a rapidly changing world.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

jobs.title: Director, Machine Learning
jobs.description:
**Narvar** is Growing! **We're looking for a leader to own the machine learning systems behind post\-purchase commerce — identity, fraud, and the intelligence layer that agentic AI runs on.**



Hundreds of millions of consumers interact with Narvar every year, across 20B\+ orders and 1,300\+ retail brands. That data powers three systems: **Graphite**, our identity resolution engine that ties fragmented consumer data into a single verified identity across retailers; **IRIS**, our fraud and returns\-abuse detection engine built on top of it.



You'll own the ML organization behind all of it — the models, the platform they run on, and the people who build them. This is a role for someone who wants a system with real consequences: fraud decisions that move retailer margin, identity resolution that agents make automated decisions on, and an adversary on the other side who adapts every quarter.

  

For this role, you should be located in Canada and able to work within EST/EDT OR PST hours. We are fully remote.


**Day\-to\-day**
----------------


* Own the ML charter across identity resolution, fraud and abuse detection, risk scoring, and consumer intelligence — strategy, roadmap, and delivery
* Build and grow a high\-performing, globally distributed team of ML engineers; hire, coach, and develop senior ICs and managers
* Set the technical bar for how models get built, evaluated, deployed, and monitored — and hold the org to it
* Push identity resolution coverage, precision, and profile classification accuracy against a measured, frozen\-holdout baseline — not against vibes
* Own IRIS model performance end\-to\-end: detection rate, false\-positive rate, label quality, and the feedback loops that keep both honest as fraud patterns shift
* Build the ML platform layer — feature stores, training pipelines, model registry, online serving, drift and performance monitoring — so model velocity isn't bottlenecked on infrastructure
* Partner with the AI engineering team so identity and risk signals are first\-class inputs to NAVI's agent decisions
* Work directly with Product, Engineering, Security, and Customer Success to translate messy retailer problems into ML problems worth solving — and to say no to the ones that aren't
* Own build\-vs\-buy and data\-partner decisions (third\-party identity data, enrichment providers), including the economics
* Communicate model performance, risk, and tradeoffs credibly to executives, retailers, and the board

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------



We care more about **judgment and ownership** than credentials.



You're likely a strong fit if you:


* Have 12\+ years in engineering with 5\+ years managing ML or data teams, including managing managers or senior ICs
* Are an engineer at heart — you can still read a training pipeline, review a feature spec, and tell when an eval is measuring the wrong thing
* Have shipped ML systems that make consequential automated decisions in production, and have owned them after launch — drift, retraining, incidents, and all

jobs.title: Director, Fraud Attack Response & Insights - Americas
jobs.description:
Our Purpose 

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

 Title and Summary 

Director, Fraud Attack Response & Insights - Americas 

Who is Mastercard? 
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview
The Fraud Attack Response & Insights team is Mastercard’s integrated fraud attack response, intelligence, and card security control functions, overseeing real-time incident response, fraud insights generation, and card/application security standards.

The Director, Fraud Attack Response & Insights/Americas role is responsible for response orchestration and insights generation across fraud attacks impacting Mastercard customers in Canada, US and Latin America.

The role is focused on fraud on account opening, payment cards and account-to-account transactions. This is a role focused on securing the transactions Mastercard enables and the stakeholders in those transactions (e.g., issuers, acquirers, merchants). This is not a corporate or information security function.

Role
•Lead participation in high-impact fraud TRTs (as commander or delegate)
•Drive post-incident retrospectives and systemic remediation recommendations
•Translate incident learnings into network-level controls, standards, or enhancements for products in the Security Solutions organization
•Liaison between the fraud attack risk registry management and fraud intelligence teams 
•Manage a small team of regional experts

All about you
•Deep fraud operations expertise
•Payment and payment fraud experience, with advanced experience in payment fraud analytics, fraud intelligence, network or product security and cross-functional governance
•Progressive leadership positions in payment fraud at a regional or global level
•Strategic and continuous learner mindset
•Proven ability to make decisions under uncertainty 
•Proven experience in managing high-performance teams across time zones and nurturing talent 

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly. 

 Corporate Security Responsibility 

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

Toronto, Canada: $150,000 - $234,000 CAD

jobs.title: Managing Director, Digital Finance
jobs.description:
Venture outside the ordinary - TMX Careers 

 The TMX group of companies includes leading global exchanges such as the Toronto Stock Exchange, Montreal Exchange, and numerous innovative organizations enhancing capital markets.  United as a global team, we’re connecting cross-functionally, traversing industries and geographies, moving opportunity into action, advancing global economic growth, and propelling progress. Through a rich exchange of ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a nimble operating model, we're powering some of the nation's most critical systems, fueling capital formation and innovation, bringing increased opportunity to business visionaries, product ingenuity to consumers, and career exploration to our team.

 Ready to be part of the action? 

 The Managing Director, Digital Finance serves as the senior finance leader accountable for leading the strategic transformation of Finance operations across systems, data, reporting, business processes, and artificial intelligence. In this business leadership capacity, you will establish priorities, set governance standards, and ensure sustained adoption and measurable value creation. Operating as the primary business counterpart to Technology and working in close partnership with the Chief Financial Officer and senior leadership, you will oversee the strategic roadmap to replace manual, fragmented workflows with a trusted, single source of financial data and insight that accelerates enterprise decision-making and supports global growth.

 Reports to: Chief Strategy and Innovation Officer
 Job Location: Hybrid (2–3 days/week in office) – based in Toronto, ON.

 Key Accountabilities 
 Finance Transformation & Portfolio Delivery
 Own and champion the multi-year Digital Finance roadmap and unified backlog across the CFO organization, prioritizing initiatives by business value, control requirements, readiness, effort, and operational cost in close collaboration with Technology.
 Sponsor and drive end-to-end process redesign across record-to-report, plan-to-perform, procure-to-pay, and order-to-cash workflows to modernize core operations.
 Establish robust business cases for all digital initiatives, tracking adoption metrics, cycle-time reductions, redeployed capacity, and internal control enhancements.
 Authorize the decommissioning of legacy reports, spreadsheets, and manual steps following the rigorous validation of modern digital replacements.
 Finance Systems & Core Architecture
 Act as the accountable Finance business owner for Workday Financials and Workday Adaptive Planning in collaboration with Controllership and FP&A process owners, establishing high standards for clean data capture, straight-through processing, chart-of-accounts governance, and audit-ready planning workflows.
 Ensure Workday configurations align with enterprise best practices, spearheading the design and ongoing governance of the Foundation Data Model (FDM) to support scalable accounting, reporting, and analytics requirements.
 Partner with Technology, external implementation specialists, and Workday to conduct recurring architecture reviews and remediate configuration gaps.
 Oversee and approve the business roadmap for the broader finance application ecosystem (close management, consolidations, billing, accounts payable, expense management, treasury, and tax), actively identifying rationalization opportunities.
 Align application release schedules with the financial close calendar, collaborating with Technology, Risk, and Internal Audit to enforce rigorous segregation of duties, access controls, and Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR).
 Finance Data, BI & Analytics
 Direct the team responsible for designing, building, and operating finance data models, data pipelines, and certified financial data products on Snowflake, establishing a single source of truth across all global entities.
 Establish robust semantic layer governance, ensuring every certified data product possesses an assigned Finance owner, approved definitions, and ongoing reconciliation to general ledger accounting outputs.
 Oversee Finance’s enterprise Business Intelligence (BI) capabilities and visualization standards, transitioning teams from static reporting to dynamic, interactive dashboards and executive decision environments utilizing tools such as Amazon QuickSight and native cloud analytics capabilities.
 Accelerate data-driven insights across Finance by collaborating with Finance Business Partners and operational data teams to integrate financial and operational drivers, including trading, clearing, listings, and market data subscriptions.
 Applied AI & Intelligent Automation
 Identify, prioritize, and oversee the rollout of high-impact finance AI use cases—such as variance analysis, exception triage, predictive forecasting, narrative document synthesis, and anomaly detection—ensuring each deployment maintains clear quality thresholds, human-in-the-loop oversight, and independent model validation.
 Drive end-to-end automation of data collation, reconciliation, and distribution throughout the reporting cycle while safeguarding professional financial judgment and formal authorization checkpoints.
 Market Innovation & Continuous Improvement
 Monitor evolving capabilities across Workday, Snowflake, business intelligence ecosystems, and emerging financial technologies, assessing business viability and integrating high-value opportunities into the strategic roadmap.
 Provide strategic advisory to the Finance Senior Leadership Team on emerging technology trends, fostering shared ownership of digital adoption.
 People Leadership & Change Enablement
 Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning finance systems, data engineering, business intelligence, and advanced analytics, establishing clear strategic direction while scaling functional capacity.
 Drive enterprise change management, communication, and training programs to embed digital literacy and analytical curiosity across the broader finance organization.
 Manage the Digital Finance operational budget, serving as the business partner to Technology and Procurement for vendor selection and delivery partner management.

 Must Have(s) 
 12+ years of progressive finance experience with comprehensive knowledge of core accounting and financial processes, coupled with advanced financial analysis capabilities.
 Professional accounting or financial credential (CPA preferred; MBA or CFA will also be considered).
 Demonstrated success serving as the business lead for major finance transformations (e.g., enterprise ERP implementations, EPM/planning platforms, or enterprise data and reporting overhauls) from conception through operational adoption and value realization.
 Proven leadership experience guiding data, BI, or analytics personnel, underpinned by sufficient technical literacy in data modeling, SQL, cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake), and modern BI suites to establish standards and guide technical execution.
 Deep knowledge of financial governance frameworks, internal controls, and ICFR requirements within large-scale system and process transformation environments.
 Demonstrated track record managing multi-year business cases, departmental budgets, third-party software vendors, and systems integration partners.
 Proven leadership acumen in ambiguous, matrixed environments with strong cross-functional stakeholder management and executive presentation skills.

 Nice to Have(s) 
 Experience with Workday Financials and Workday Adaptive Planning, including Foundation Data Model (FDM) architecture and data integration with Snowflake.
 Direct technical experience with data querying and scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python).
 Practical experience deploying artificial intelligence or machine learning solutions within corporate finance environments, including model validation and risk management frameworks.
 Industry experience within capital markets, financial services, financial technology, or software organizations.
 Leadership background within multi-entity, multi-currency, and multinational operating structures.
 Experience building, structuring, and scaling a digital or transformation function from early-stage maturity.

 The recruiting efforts for this role are intended to fill a vacant position.

 In the market for… 

 Excitement - Explore emerging technology and innovation, as well as ventures and digital finance that shape the future of global markets! Experience the movement of the market while grounded in the stability of close to 200 years of success. 
 Connection - With site hubs in some of the world’s most multicultural cities, we leverage our size and structure to create rich connections and belonging while experiencing powerful global impact through our work. 
 Impact - More than a platform, we use our talents to power mission-critical systems that drive global economic advancement, innovation, and growth. As well, our employee-led Team Impact spreads social good via our giving strategy. 
 Wellness - From empathetic leadership to a culture of flexibility and balance, we believe wellness at work creates the maximum yield and a stronger “we”. Plus, with a cloud-first and hybrid workstyle, as well as generous time-off and leaves, we support a life well lived!  
 Growth - From a growth mindset in our work, to expansion in our business, TMX is home to action-takers energized by the achievement of ambitious growth. 

 Ready to enrich your career with impactful work, leaders who truly care, and the flexibility and programs to help you thrive as part of #TeamTMX? Apply now. 

 Please note that our company is not currently sponsoring work permit applications and the applicant must be authorized to work in the country where this position is located.  

 TMX is committed to creating and sustaining a collegial work environment in which all individuals are treated with dignity and respect and one which reflects the diversity of the community in which we operate. We provide accommodations for applicants and employees who require it.
