At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren't just places to consume content - they're places where communities build.

Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA's history - from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.

As a Technical Director, you will lead the technical strategy for capturing research data from EA game sources. You will define how dedicated title streams, shared instrumentation, capture builds, and downstream data systems work together as a unified capability for Research & Engineering.

You will be responsible for driving the architecture, standards, priorities, and technical outcomes of the Game Data Capture team. You will coordinate across researchers, ML Data Engineers, title teams, central infrastructure, security, and legal partners while remaining hands-on in the most consequential technical decisions.

This is a hybrid role, working three days per week in Redwood City, Montreal, or Vancouver.

You will report to the Lead Technical Director.

Responsibilities

You will define the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for a unified cross-title game-data capture capability.
You will establish standards for supported modalities, synchronization, coordinate systems, schemas, build identity, provenance, validation, and platform performance.
You will determine which capabilities belong in the shared capture platform and which require title-specific integration.
You will prioritize title onboarding and research requests based on technical feasibility, research value, dependencies, and long-term platform leverage.
You will lead architecture and design reviews for capture SDKs, title adapters, build automation, and interfaces with central data infrastructure.
You will partner with title technical leaders to secure the expertise, access, and production safeguards needed to instrument complex game codebases.
You will define requirements for dedicated Perforce streams, automated merges, reproducible builds, CI/CD, deployment, and capture validation.
You will establish clear technical acceptance criteria for certified raw capture sessions and ensure limitations are documented.
You will identify repeated title-specific needs and guide the team toward maintainable shared solutions.
You will mentor engineers, communicate technical direction, resolve cross-team decisions, and represent Game Data Capture to research and technology leadership.

Qualifications

12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including technical leadership in AAA games, game engines, real-time simulation, or related systems
Experience setting architecture and technical direction across multiple engineering teams or products
Expertise in C++ and strong working knowledge of large, multithreaded game-engine codebases
Broad experience with engine systems such as rendering, simulation, gameplay, animation, physics, audio, tools, or build pipelines
Experience integrating technology across actively developed branches, platforms, or title codebases
Experience with Perforce, complex build systems, CI/CD, and release or integration workflows
Experience translating research or product requirements into platform strategy and executable technical plans
Experience balancing rapid experimentation with security, performance, stability, maintainability, and partner-team constraints

Job Description

What if you could redefine what’s possible?

With us, you can. You want Purpose. Growth. Opportunity.

With an unmatched breadth and depth of engineering, advisory and science‑based expertise, our global minds unite to power local solutions.

The Opportunity

Successful projects don't happen by accident. They are delivered through strong governance, disciplined execution, effective project controls, and leaders who give teams the tools and support they need to succeed.

WSP is seeking an experienced and passionate project delivery leader to join our Earth & Environment team as Director, Project Governance, BC & Yukon. This is a unique opportunity
to shape and lead the project management function across one of WSP's largest and most diverse regions. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Earth & Environment, BC & Yukon, you will establish and drive a regional project governance and project management office (PMO)
approach that strengthens consistency, accountability, and delivery performance across a diverse portfolio of environmental engineering projects.

As the leader responsible for project governance, project controls and project management capability, you will oversee our Project Controllers and Project Control Administrators while building the systems, processes, tools and performance rhythms that enable successful project delivery. You will work closely with operational leaders and project teams to improve project outcomes, strengthen commercial performance, enhance project management capability and create a more predictable and disciplined approach to delivering work.

This role is ideal for someone energized by project management excellence
, governance, continuous improvement and helping others succeed. If you are passionate about creating the frameworks, insights and support systems that allow teams to consistently deliver successful outcomes for clients and the business, we would love to hear from you.

Your Impact

Establish and lead a consistent project governance and controls framework across the BC & Yukon Earth & Environment business, strengthening accountability, discipline and delivery excellence.
Drive adoption of project management standards, tools and best practices to improve project execution, predictability, commercial performance and client outcomes.
Provide oversight of portfolio health, using performance insights to identify risks, trends and opportunities, and lead reviews or recovery efforts for strategic, high-risk or underperforming projects.
Lead and develop Project Controllers and Project Control Administrators, aligning resources and capabilities to provide effective support across the regional portfolio.

Strengthen forecasting, risk management, change management and commercial practices to improve profitability and reduce delivery risk.
Partner with operations, finance, commercial, risk and legal teams to align project delivery with regional and national priorities.
Lead continuous improvement and lessons learned initiatives, and support strategic pursuits, business planning and key initiatives by ensuring project readiness, governance and delivery risks are effectively considered.

The Skills That Set You Apart

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business, Environmental Sciences, or a related discipline.
Professional certification or designation such as PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or equivalent project governance, risk, or program management credentials considered an asset.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in project management, project controls, program oversight, governance, or professional consulting environments.
Proven experience overseeing complex, multidisciplinary project portfolios and supporting successful project delivery across diverse stakeholder groups.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies, governance frameworks, project controls, commercial management, and performance reporting.
Demonstrated success leading organizational change, continuous improvement, and capability-building initiatives.
Experience identifying and managing financial, operational, contractual, regulatory, and project delivery risks.
Strong business acumen, financial literacy, and an ability to translate project performance data into actionable business insights.
Experience working with enterprise project and financial management systems, such as Oracle, to support governance, forecasting, and decision-making.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with executives, operational leaders, project sponsors, and project teams.
A collaborative leadership style with a proven ability to influence, drive accountability, and achieve results in a matrixed environment without direct authority.
A passion for project delivery excellence, continuous improvement, and helping project teams achieve successful outcomes for clients and the business.

Why Choose WSP?

We exist to shape communities to advance humanity. The brightest engineers, advisors and scientists from across the globe call WSP home.

Proudly Canadian – we are a Top 100 Employer in Canada for 2026.
A global community of brilliant minds – your next idea, mentor, or opportunity is always within reach.
Limitless opportunities start here. Whether it’s across the country or around the globe, we help you tailor your role to match your ambition — because your growth drives ours.
Flexible work, real balance – we recognize the importance of balance in our lives and encourage you to prioritize the balance in yours.

Explore Limitless Possibilities

If you are passionate about project governance, delivery excellence and building high-performing project management functions, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact. You will have the platform to influence how projects are delivered, strengthen capability across the business, and help shape a culture of accountability, continuous improvement and project excellence.

About Us

At WSP
, we exist to shape communities to advance humanity.

It’s why we bring people together who are wired to solve complex challenges - engineers, scientists, advisors, and technical experts who are driven by a common passion - to redefine what’s possible and shape what comes next. We are Visioneers.

At WSP

Here, your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and you are encouraged to bring your authentic self to work. We empower our people to collaborate across disciplines, challenge the status quo, and shape a career with purpose.

Join us.

Homefield Sports Group is a leading recreational sports business with the mission of creating exceptional lifelong opportunities to play sports. Support M&A integration

jobs.title: Leader, Strategic Transformation (Quality & Safety)
jobs.description:
Salary

The salary range for this position is CAD $55.25 - $79.42 / hour

Job Summary

Lead Quality and Safety Transformation to Shape the Future of Healthcare

Are you a dynamic and strategic leader with a passion for making a positive impact in healthcare? Do you find fulfillment in improving quality and safety in complex healthcare environments? Do you have experience bringing together diverse groups of healthcare professionals to develop new initiatives and programs? If so, we have an incredible opportunity for you to be part of a well-established team and take the lead on transformative projects that will shape the future of healthcare!

The Opportunity

Bring your initiative, client service focus, systems level thinking and leadership skills to our dynamic team of seasoned project and change professionals. This Leader role is aligned to the Quality & Safety portfolio and focused on patient and provider experience priorities. You will be supporting a program of integrated regional initiatives in the Fraser Health Quality strategic pillar. As Leader within the Strategic Transformation Team, you will lead members of our internal consulting team (senior consultants and coordinators), and partner with executive sponsors (vice-presidents, executive directors, directors and/or medical leaders) across the region to ensure plans for Fraser Health’s highest priority, cross-organizational change initiatives, are successfully designed, implemented, integrated and evaluated.

What You’ll Do

Our Leaders support diverse portfolios, leading alongside clinical and corporate sponsors to facilitate collaboration between cross-functional teams and bring cutting edge ideas to the table. Your work will contribute to the improvement of healthcare processes, enhance the quality of patient and client care, and will make a meaningful difference in the lives of the individuals and communities that Fraser Health serves. Your expertise in leading teams, along with proven, applied skills in project and change management will be the driving force behind transformative initiatives that directly impact patient outcomes and organizational success.

Who We Are: The Strategic Transformation and Project Delivery Team

The Fraser Health Planning & Transformation department values a culture of openness, partnership, creativity and innovation where we recognize each other’s expertise, honour the contributions of everyone and have each other’s back. Your ideas will be welcomed as we collectively strive to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We provide ongoing professional development opportunities and a vibrant and inclusive work environment that supports flexibility and hybrid work models.

The Ideal Candidate For This Role Will

Have an in-depth understanding of the health care system and Fraser Health at both strategic and operational levels. Experience of clinical operations and knowledge of quality and safety in healthcare would be beneficial.
Have proven project management expertise: You've successfully led a complex portfolio of inter-related projects from initiation to completion, demonstrating a keen ability to navigate challenges and deliver exceptional results.
Be a change management champion: You're not just comfortable with change; you thrive on it. Your experience in change management will be pivotal in ensuring seamless transitions and maximizing the positive impact of our improvement initiatives.
Have proven experience engaging and partnering with clinical operations
Have a passion for healthcare: Your insights will drive projects that directly impact patient care and organizational success. Experience in a large health organization would be beneficial.
Have a collaborative spirit: We believe in the power of teamwork. Your ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and impacted parties is essential for success in this role.
Have a Master’s degree in health administration or a related discipline supplemented with project and change management courses: PMP and Prosci(R) or other certification/designation in leadership, project and change management would be an asset.
Have ten (10) years’ recent, related experience in an environment focused on delivering change/transformation initiatives using project and change management methods in a large, complex environment, including supervision of others.
Have access to a vehicle for business related purposes.

Valued Benefits

Joining our team offers you opportunities to work in a rapidly growing organization, with health professionals who are excellent in their respective fields, career growth and advancement, a competitive compensation package (including four weeks of vacation to start, comprehensive health benefits, and pension plan), and the rewarding opportunity to make a difference every single day in health care.

Detailed Overview

The Leader, Strategic Transformation is the principal agent for change who seeks to shift or transition a major part of the Organization from a current state to a desired future state. The Leader ensures that the plans and goals of the executive sponsor are successfully designed, implemented, integrated and evaluated as they relate to the requested redesign, restructure and reconfiguration of their service area. Where applicable, the Leader may provide subject matter expertise during the client's planning process. The Leader oversees and manages the budget specified for the change process and is required to assemble, direct and supervise a team of Senior Consultants that will ensure the Leader's blueprint for change is done effectively, efficiently, on time and on budget.

Responsibilities

Leads multi-stakeholder, organization-wide strategic initiatives from current state to the desired future state through idea generation, planning, design, implementation and evaluation; provides subject matter expertise and leadership on the strategic initiative to the executive sponsors or sponsor group (e.g., steering committees) throughout the change initiative.
Manages the overall coordination of strategic initiatives from a strategic change context; develops, oversees and manages the overall transformation plan on behalf of the sponsors; where appropriate, co-manages non-Strategic Transformation Team project resources working collaboratively with other support groups in the organization that are critical for the successful execution of the change.
Participates in the recruitment of staff and manages the professional development of employees through the formal assessment of training needs and the development of training plans: responsible to oversee and as required, participate in the management of human resource matters; prepares and conducts performance assessments for the Senior Consultants, Strategic Transformation.
Provides work direction and leadership to a team of Senior Consultants, Strategic Transformation throughout the initiative(s) assigned to them and ensures strategic transformation resource needs are assigned appropriately; secures and manages contractual relationships with external consultants, as needed.
Identifies and manages resources and budgets required to complete strategic transformation work; develops a budget report and schedule for monitoring expenditures and variance analysis of all assigned aspects of the initiative and reports regularly to the sponsor(s).
Identifies and manages key stakeholder strategies and works collaboratively with Communications to develop appropriate communication strategies.
Applies project and change management principles to develop engagement strategies and action plans to maximize likelihood of success; working collaboratively with Organizational Development as required.
Identifies, establishes, and oversees the appropriate team structure and membership required for the strategic transformation initiative(s) including sponsorship, champion, steering committee and delivery/implementation teams, as well as, FH and external resources.
Assesses the impact of strategic transformation initiatives from a systems perspective and manages the impacts and interdependencies with other initiatives happening in FH; supports the Director, Strategic Transformation in the STT prioritization process with the Executive Team.
Develops and/or oversees the development of relevant documentation (e.g., statements of work, proposals, charters, work plans, risk management plans, and change management plans,, etc.); working collaboratively with Health and Business Analytics and other departments on developing effective measurement systems to track progress towards achievement of results/outcomes.
Partners with other departments in the development, maintenance and promotion of the organization's repeatable and sustainable initiative, project, and change management processes.
Participates in the evaluation and refinement of tools and methods utilized by the Strategic Transformation Team, as required; champions the various STT methodologies; assists in the development and presentation of initiative, project, and change management coaching, mentoring and instruction strategies and materials.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

Master's degree in Health Administration or related discipline supplemented with project and change management courses. Ten (10) years' experience including five (5) years in a project management role and the supervision of others, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Valid BC Driver's Licence and access to a vehicle for business related purposes.

Competencies

Demonstrates the leadership practices of the Fraser Health Leadership Framework of Clear, Caring and Courageous and creates the conditions for people to succeed.

Professional/Technical Capabilities

Expert knowledge of change and project management principles coupled with an indepth understanding of the healthcare system at both the strategic and operational levels.
Knowledge of other health care disciplines and their role in health care.
Ability to operate a PC and effectively utilize a variety of software applications to support the initiative management activities.
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

About Fraser Health

Fraser Health is the heart of health care for over two million people in Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley in British Columbia, Canada, on the traditional, ancestral and unceded lands of the Coast Salish and Nlaka’pamux Nations and is home to 32 First Nations within the Fraser Salish region.

People - those we care for and those who care for them - are at the heart of everything we do. Our hospital and community-based services are delivered by a team of 50,000+ staff, medical staff and volunteers.

We are committed to planetary health and value diversity in the work force. We strive to maintain an environment of respect, caring and trust. Fraser Health’s hiring practices aspire to ensure all individuals are treated in an inclusive, equitable and culturally safe manner.

Together, we are the heart of health care.

Partners with other departments in the development, maintenance and promotion of the organization's repeatable and sustainable initiative, project, and change management processes.
Participates in the evaluation and refinement of tools and methods utilized by the Strategic Transformation Team, as required; champions the various STT methodologies; assists in the development and presentation of initiative, project, and change management coaching, mentoring and instruction strategies and materials.

Education and Experience

Master's degree in Health Administration or related discipline supplemented with project and change management courses. Ten (10) years' experience including five (5) years in a project management role and the supervision of others, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Valid BC Driver's Licence and access to a vehicle for business related purposes.

Competencies

Demonstrates the leadership practices of the Fraser Health Leadership Framework of Clear, Caring and Courageous and creates the conditions for people to succeed.

Expert knowledge of change and project management principles coupled with an indepth understanding of the healthcare system at both the strategic and operational levels.

English job description follows***

pour rejoindre notre équipe Solutions Numériques (ABSD) basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous travaillerez conjointement avec les équipes Business et IM basées à Mirabel et Toulouse.

Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale).

Définir et piloter la feuille de route stratégique de transformation numérique et d'IA alignée sur les objectifs globaux des Services Clientèle;
Cadrer, évaluer et déployer des solutions basées sur l'intelligence artificielle (IA générative, prédictive et automatisation) dans les processus métiers et produits clients;
Diriger la livraison de portefeuilles de projets complexes (CapEx/OpEx) dans le respect des délais, des budgets et des standards de qualité (Digital Gates)`;
Superviser les budgets des projets et établir des cadres d'évaluation de la valeur ajoutée et du retour sur investissement (ROI);
Piloter la stratégie globale de gestion du changement pour garantir l'adoption optimale des nouvelles technologies par les équipes internes et les clients;
Assurer l'alignement stratégique et la coordination transversale entre les parties prenantes Métier et IM réparties entre Mirabel et Toulouse.;
Gérer les relations stratégiques avec les fournisseurs externes, la négociation des mandats et le suivi des engagements contractuels;
Identifier et atténuer proactivement les risques liés aux projets, à la cybersécurité, à la protection des données et à la conformité de l'IA.

Votre Profil

Diplôme universitaire pertinent en ingénierie, informatique, gestion des systèmes d'information, administration des affaires ou dans une discipline connexe;
Minimum de dix (10) ans d'expérience en gestion de projets numériques et en conduite de transformations organisationnelles d'envergure à l'échelle de l'entreprise;
Expérience avérée dans l'intégration opérationnelle de solutions numériques avancées et de technologies basées sur l'intelligence artificielle;
Solide expertise en gestion des parties prenantes et capacité à influencer et aligner des équipes décisionnelles dans un environnement matriciel international;
Maîtrise éprouvée des méthodologies structurées de gestion du changement et de conduite de l'adoption par les utilisateurs;
Excellentes capacités d'analyse, d'arbitrage stratégique et d'évaluation financière de projets;
Niveau avancé en français et en anglais (oral et écrit).

En raison du secteur d’activité (aéronautique), de multiples contacts avec des entités Airbus situées dans le monde entier, et d’interactions avec les fournisseurs et clients également situés dans le monde entier, la connaissance de l’anglais est demandée dans ce poste.

Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What you'll be doing

Our AI team builds enterprise capabilities that support a wide range of users across the organization, from end users to technology teams and low-code or no-code builders. As a Principal Product Scaler – AI Engineering, you'll build the engineering foundation that helps us repeatedly deliver high-quality AI products safely, efficiently, and at scale. You'll architect and develop the reusable components, software development kits, testing frameworks, and delivery patterns that move us from individual implementations to a mature product engineering model. You'll establish the standards for how AI products are designed, built, tested, packaged, released, and monitored in production. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, and technology partners, you'll help turn strong prototypes into reliable enterprise products while strengthening the team's overall engineering capability.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

How you'll succeed

Build scalable engineering foundations
- Design and develop software development kits, libraries, reusable components, templates, and reference implementations that accelerate delivery across the AI portfolio and reduce repeated effort across teams.
Establish engineering excellence -
Define and implement standards for code structure, testing, code review, versioning, packaging, documentation, release management, and production readiness for AI and Generative AI products.
Advance AI quality and reliability
- Create automated testing, evaluation, regression, monitoring, and observability patterns that support both traditional software quality and the unique behavior of probabilistic AI systems.
Drive efficient delivery
- Establish continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) patterns, quality gates, and repeatable workflows that help teams move from experiment to production with greater speed and consistency.
Enable adoption across teams -
Design interfaces and developer experiences that make enterprise AI capabilities easy to consume for technology teams, other AI teams, and low-code or no-code solution builders.
Elevate team capability
- Review architecture and code for critical products, coach AI practitioners on engineering best practices, and help the team adopt effective agentic development workflows, tooling, and guardrails.

Who you are

You are a hands-on senior engineering leader
. You have experience operating at a Staff, Principal, Lead Engineer, or equivalent level, and you enjoy both designing systems and writing production-quality code.
You can demonstrate experience in
system design, application programming interface (API) and software development kit (SDK) design, testing, CI/CD, versioning, observability, and production operations. It’s an asset if you have built platforms, frameworks, developer tooling, or reusable services used by multiple teams.
You give meaning to data
. You understand the engineering challenges of taking AI and Generative AI solutions from experimentation into production, and you know that quality for AI systems requires more than traditional unit testing.
You look beyond the moment.
You're excited by the opportunity to shape how agentic software development evolves, including workflows, repository design, testing approaches, review practices, context management, and governance for increasingly autonomous delivery.
You're motivated by collective success
. You influence engineers, data scientists, technology partners, and leaders through strong partnership, sound judgment, and a commitment to raising the capability of the broader organization.
You act like an owner
. You naturally identify repeated patterns, remove friction from the development lifecycle, and build practical solutions that help teams deliver faster, more safely, and with greater consistency.
Values matter to you
. You bring your real self to work, and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.
We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

jobs.description:
**Putting people first, every day**  



BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award\-winning environment that fosters a people\-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.


**Your Opportunity**

Reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer and serving as a member of the HR Leadership Team, the **Director, Talent Management \& Workforce Insights** leads an integrated portfolio spanning Talent Management, Total Rewards, HR Operations and People Analytics. The Director sets priorities across the portfolio, leads experienced specialist teams and helps these capabilities evolve to better support the firm’s business and people priorities.  

  

  



Working closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition and leaders across the firm, the Director will shape the talent systems, workforce insights, rewards and HR services that help BDO retain its people, create meaningful opportunities for talent, and support the firm’s evolving workforce needs. jobs.title: AVP, CTR Promo Strategy & Programs
jobs.description:
Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited (“CTC”) is one of Canada’s most recognized and trusted companies, with a portfolio that spans retail, financial services, loyalty, petroleum, and real estate. Founded in 1922, CTC includes iconic banners and businesses such as Canadian Tire, SportChek, Mark’s, PartSource, Gas+, Triangle Rewards, Canadian Tire Financial Services, and CT REIT, supported by a national network of retail and gasoline outlets and tens of thousands of people across Canada.

CTC’s purpose is simple and enduring: “We are here to make life in Canada better.” The company continues to invest in technology, data, omnichannel capabilities, customer experience, and enterprise transformation while maintaining a strong connection to communities across the country. Leaders at CTC are expected to operate with integrity, build strong cross-functional relationships, and help advance a culture grounded in accountability, inclusion, innovation, and care for customers, employees, Dealers, franchisees, partners, and communities.

About The Role

The AVP, CTR Promo Strategy & Programs leads the strategy, planning and performance of CTR promotional programs, translating enterprise strategy into customer-relevant, financially productive and operationally executable plans. The role owns CTR promotional choices and governance, leveraging AI-enabled capabilities, while building a high-performing Promotions team.

Accountability spans the weekly promotional program, key promo events, non-product promotions, and integration with key strategic priorities inclusive of customer-centric growth, Triangle loyalty, Digital activation, and other key price value initiatives. The mandate is to deliver best in class CTR promotional programs through offer and price selection that strengthens customer value perception and drives key financial outcomes.

The AVP translates promo strategy priorities into coordinated delivery plans with strong stakeholder management and customer focus. The AVP leads continuous improvement across the function, strengthening workflows, champions automation, and drives disciplined performance management as the promotional ecosystem evolves.

What You'll Do

Lead CTR promotional strategy and deliver performance
Translate CTR Promotions strategy into an annual plan, inclusive of being a change agent for the multi-year price value transformation roadmap as part of True North.
Set the role, depth, frequency, placement and incentive approach for CTR promotions.
Balance promo sales, retail margin, net promo return, Triangle value and customer value perception.
Anticipate and respond to competitive dynamics to direct promotional resources toward higher-impact events and reduce low-ROI or duplicative promotions.Own promotional outcomes by driving solid in-season program communication, risk management, trade-offs, course correction and executive escalation.
Own CTR promo planning and program decisions
Lead product and price decisions for CTR promotional program.
Own product and price selection for key promotional events - IEPs, NPP events, Special Print Programs and Grand Openings.
Manage the CTR promotional calendar and ensure integration across events, categories and channels to maximize business performance and customer impact.
Align promotional plans to category roles, customer needs, key shopping moments and enterprise priorities.
Challenge the status quo, ensuring promo plans reflect customer and competitive signals to differentiate in the market.
Lead CTR promo optimization, governance and performance management
Set objectives, constraints and high-quality business inputs for AI-enabled pricing and promotion engines.
Embed enterprise promo guardrails for depth, frequency, placement and incentives.
Establish planning, in-season and post-event operating rhythms with standardized dashboards.
Reduce exceptions through stronger upfront planning, decision discipline and escalation paths.
Use post-event insights to improve future event, item and price decisions.
Advance AI-enabled promotional capabilities & optimization
Ensure CTR promo process and team readiness for newly launched price value initiatives under the True North strategy.
Develop a promo automation roadmap and prioritize enhancements that improve impact and efficiency.
Provide the CTR business perspective to improve models, tools, guardrails and workflows.
Champion adoption, change management and new ways of working across the team and partners.
Lead & build a high-performing CTR Promotions organization
Set clear roles, priorities, decision rights and accountability across Promo Strategy and Promo Programs.
Coach leaders and build capability in analytics, insight storytelling, systems thinking and judgement.
Manage capacity, workload and talent progression while strengthening bench strength.
Set a performance culture grounded in customer impact, reliable execution, evidence-based decisions, and continuous improvement.

What You Bring

You bring 8-10 years of progressive leadership experience, leading teams in promotions, pricing, merchandising or retail strategy, with the ability to work collaboratively with senior leaders.
A degree in business, marketing, operations, supply chain, finance or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A proven record of developing business strategies and delivering high-performing programs and events in a large, complex retail organization, ideally in a multi-category environment.
Deep understanding of promotional levers, including offer and price selection, depth, frequency, placement, incentive and loyalty mechanics, and promotional calendar planning.
Strong business and analytical acumen, with experience measuring promotional ROI, incrementality and margin trade-offs, and using customer and market insights to improve future decisions.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled optimization tools, automation and disciplined governance to improve business effectiveness and operational efficiency.
Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership, including coaching a manager team, building clear accountabilities, and translating competing priorities into clear decisions.

This posting represents an existing vacancy within our organization.

We may use artificial intelligence tools as part of our recruitment process to assist in the initial screening of resumes. All hiring decisions, including candidate evaluation, selection, and disposition, are made by human recruiters.

About Us

Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited (“CTC”) is one of Canada’s most admired and trusted companies. With more than 90 Owned Brands, over 1,600 retail locations, financial services, exemplary e-commerce capabilities, and exciting market-leading merchandising strategies. We dream big and work as one to innovate with purpose for our customers at every level of our business, investing in new technologies and products, and doubling down on top talent to drive the company forward. We offer competitive salaries and wages to CTC employees, as well as store discounts, supported learning through our Triangle Learning Academy, Canadian Tire Profit Sharing, and retirement and savings programs for eligible employees. As part of our enhanced flex benefits program, we offer mental health benefits in the amount of $5,000 per year for benefits-eligible employees and their families, including total well-being, and mental health tools and resources for all employees. Join us in helping to make life in Canada better through living and working our Core Values: we are innovators and entrepreneurs at our core, outcomes drive us, inclusion is a must, we are stronger together and we take personal responsibility. It is an especially exciting time to join CTC and its family of companies where career opportunities are wide-ranging! Join us, where there's a place for you here.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging

We are committed to fostering an environment where belonging thrives, and diversity, inclusion and equity are infused into everything we do. We believe in building an organizational culture where people are consistently treated with dignity while respecting individual religion, nationality, gender, race, age, perceived ability, spoken language, sexual orientation, and identification. We are united in our purpose of being here to help make life in Canada better.

Accommodations

We stand firm in our Core Value that inclusion is a must. We welcome and encourage candidates from equity-seeking groups such as people who identify as racialized, Indigenous, 2SLGBTQIA+, women, people with disabilities, and beyond. Should you require any accommodation in applying for this role, or throughout the interview process, please make them known when contacted and we will work with you to help meet your needs.

jobs.title: VP of Finance
jobs.description:
Snaplii is hiring a VP of Finance in Toronto who can manage the books, the money, the transactions and the systems together, and who still digs in personally when something breaks.

**About Snaplii**


Snaplii is a profitable North American wallet and payments platform for people and their AI agents, with offices in Toronto and Silicon Valley.

* 400K\+ users and about US$150M in annual payment volume
* 500\+ brand partners, including Costco, Walmart and Uber
* Now building financial infrastructure for people and their AI agents: Snaplii is already live on Muse, with about 2,000 AI agents running on it

**What you'll do**


You report to the CEO and lead the finance organization, including our Financial Controller. In priority order:

* **Finance and controls.** Own month\-end close, financial reporting, external audit and internal controls across our Canada and US entities.
* **Payments finance operations.** You don't reconcile every transaction yourself, but you own the whole mechanism and the outcome of every exception:
	+ End\-to\-end reconciliation across internal transaction records, the user balance ledger, payment processor records and bank statements
	+ Settlement and payouts: correct amounts, timing, receiving entities and approval authority
	+ Exceptions such as missing orders, duplicate payments, delayed settlements, fee differences and refunds not received, traced and closed out
	+ Clear accounting and control boundaries between company operating funds, user funds and settlement funds
	+ Treasury and liquidity: funds kept safe, liquidity sufficient and settlements accurate, with strong bank and payment\-processor relationships
* **Digital transformation.** Find the manual, error\-prone steps in finance and payment operations, then work with product and engineering to automate them and to monitor for fund discrepancies, late settlements and unusual transactions.
* **Team.** Lead, coach and grow the finance team, starting with the Financial Controller.
* **Fundraising and investments.** Partner with the CEO on fundraising, board and investor materials and the numbers behind major decisions; oversee corporate investments.
* **Compliance, over time.** Work with our compliance lead on fund controls, audit evidence and bank requirements, with room to take on more compliance responsibility as you grow into the role.

**How you'll work**


This is a startup seat: you manage the team and do the work yourself.

* While the team is still being built, you dig into the books, chase discrepancies and deal with banks and payment processors yourself
* You make sound calls with incomplete information, and bring risks and proposed fixes to the CEO early
* When you find a cross\-team problem, you push it through to resolution instead of only reporting it
* You keep daily money movement and finance running while you build the systems underneath

**What you bring**

* CPA designation, with a strong accounting and Controller foundation
* Experience leading a full finance function and managing a team
* End\-to\-end ownership of month\-end close, financial statements, external audit and internal controls
* Hands\-on experience with payment or transaction fund flows: reconciliation, settlement, payouts and refunds
* You have led at least one digital transformation of a finance or payment\-operations process and can explain the results before and after. You don't need to write code, but you can read a process, define the rules and verify the outcome
* Real banking and payment\-processor relationship experience you can walk us through with examples
* Professional working proficiency in both English and Mandarin
* Based in the Greater Toronto Area and able to work from our Toronto office


The strongest fit has grown from Controller or finance operations at a payments, wallet, fintech or high\-volume platform company, rebuilt systems hands\-on and led a small team. Big\-company titles count less than having managed the books, the funds and the transaction flows together.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in payments, fintech or other regulated businesses, working with compliance on fund controls, audit evidence and bank requirements
* SQL, BI or API data experience (real implementations matter more than tool names)
* Multi\-entity finance across Canada and the US
* Fundraising, bank credit facilities, data rooms, or investor and board communication
* Business analytics: runway, unit economics and operating KPIs

**Compensation and location**


The role offers an annual compensation package of up to CAD $300,000, including base salary and a performance\-based bonus, depending on experience.


Based in our Toronto office. Our team works in both English and Mandarin.

jobs.title: Technology Program Management, Vice President
jobs.description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count? 

 Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

 With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

 Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

 Summary:

 The Vice President manages multiple technology projects and teams, establishes governance and stakeholder communications, coordinates dependencies and resources, oversees schedules and reporting, and provides executive updates on strategy, budgets, risks, controls, and delivery. The role also tracks technology expenditures, manages project budgets and capital investments, negotiates internal resources and vendor proposals, and improves project management processes, tools, training, and methodology

 Education

 ·        Degree or equivalent work experience equally preferable.
 ·        Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.

 Certifications

 ·        PMP certification preferred.

 Work Experience

 ·        Technology program management experience in large, cross-organizational projects, prioritizing competing demands, scoping large efforts, and negotiating timelines.
 ·        Strong experience within a technology organization in the banking or financial services industries. Regulatory reporting domain exposure is a plus.
 ·        Demonstrated ability to manage multiple and diverse projects and initiatives, including analytical thinking, planning, prioritizing, problem solving, decision-making, and carrying out assigned projects and activities with minimal supervision.
 ·        Successfully managed large-scale and complex initiatives independently, from start to finish, with a duration of at least six months.
 ·        Prior business analyst experience and/or operational expertise preferred.
 ·        Experience and knowledge of change management principles, methodologies, and tools preferred.
 ·        Familiarity with AI and leveraging AI to improve day-to-day activities and optimization of TPM tasks.

 Functional Skills

 ·        Business & Strategic Acumen: Understands the business, the industry, and the role IT plays in driving financial success. Aligns technology strategy with organizational goals and vision to deliver stakeholder value.
 ·        Enterprise & Architecture Knowledge: Proficient in process and data modeling, architectural development, and IT planning methodologies. Has extensive knowledge of the enterprise's business and decision-making processes.
 ·        Technical Breadth: Has deep knowledge across multiple technical environments. Understands software and hardware requirements and implementation steps and translates them into business and program-level terms.
 ·        Delivery Methodologies: Proficient in SDLC project and process management tools and methodologies. Has experience with agile, scrum, or hybrid approaches.
 ·        End-to-End Project Execution: Has a solid understanding of the full technology project lifecycle. Identifies dependencies and sequences work efficiently.
 ·        Release & Risk Management: Demonstrated ability to manage software release risks, including holding releases when necessary.
 ·        Vendor Management & Negotiation: Negotiates beneficial terms for software and services agreements in support of project delivery.
 ·        Leadership: Builds, leads, and empowers interdisciplinary, geographically dispersed teams.
 ·        Continuous Improvement & Planning: Is planning- and process-oriented and introduces new processes or delivery methods as needed.

 Foundational Skills

 ·        Demonstrates leadership, leads by example, and acts with integrity.
 ·        Communicates effectively and serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.
 ·        Applies analytical and critical thinking, iterative problem-solving, and sound judgment to identify multiple paths to success in a complex environment.
 ·        Operates strategically to support continuous improvement and systems thinking, informed by industry trends and best practices.
 ·        Builds consensus and collaborates across functions, divisions, and organizations to drive large-scale initiatives and overcome obstacles.
 ·        Is flexible, decisive, resilient, and open to others' ideas, and inspires innovation and continuous learning.
 ·        Is organized and detail-oriented, with experience reporting to senior management.

 Responsibilities

 High-Level Responsibilities

 ·        Lead teams to support projects on implementation issues. Develop and execute review sessions for high-impact projects. Develop descriptions for project justification, plans, roles, responsibilities, and reporting structure.
 ·        Provide training and consulting for project managers and administrators. Provide technical and analytical guidance to project teams. Set the frequency and type of interactions, extent of stakeholder involvement, and develop a dispute resolution process.
 ·        Monitor the effectiveness of project management methodology and tools and recommend improvements, as appropriate. Ensure effective communication among business process owners, project team members, and all IT functions that participate in and impact project development results.
 ·        Implement enhancements and upgrades to project management processes and tools. Develop proposals, work plans, training plans, budgets, and reports for IT projects.

 Detailed Responsibilities

 ·        Perform hands-on program management for multiple technology development projects and teams.
 ·        Establish project governance, working groups, and stakeholder communications.
 ·        Stay abreast of industry trends, actively adopting new practices and techniques to accelerate delivery.
 ·        Partners with business, program management, architecture, system owners, third-party vendors, testing, and other teams as necessary to ensure successful delivery.
 ·        Drive planning at various organizational levels to ensure projects are on track and appropriately resourced.
 ·        Ensure timetables and deliverable schedules are understood and communicated.
 ·        Manage dependencies proactively, coordinating across teams to resolve issues and mitigate risks.
 ·        Align, plan, and precisely manage activities and dependencies across development teams to ensure cohesive delivery.
 ·        Contribute to executive-level updates on strategy, budget, project delivery, controls, risks, and related topics.

jobs.title: VP of Finance
jobs.description:
Snaplii is hiring a VP of Finance in Toronto who can manage the books, the money, the transactions and the systems together, and who still digs in personally when something breaks.

About Snaplii

Snaplii is a profitable North American wallet and payments platform for people and their AI agents, with offices in Toronto and Silicon Valley.

400K+ users and about US$150M in annual payment volume
500+ brand partners, including Costco, Walmart and Uber
Now building financial infrastructure for people and their AI agents: Snaplii is already live on Muse, with about 2,000 AI agents running on it

What You'll Do

You report to the CEO and lead the finance organization, including our Financial Controller. In priority order:

Finance and controls. Own month-end close, financial reporting, external audit and internal controls across our Canada and US entities.
Payments finance operations. You don't reconcile every transaction yourself, but you own the whole mechanism and the outcome of every exception:
End-to-end reconciliation across internal transaction records, the user balance ledger, payment processor records and bank statements
Settlement and payouts: correct amounts, timing, receiving entities and approval authority
Exceptions such as missing orders, duplicate payments, delayed settlements, fee differences and refunds not received, traced and closed out
Clear accounting and control boundaries between company operating funds, user funds and settlement funds
Treasury and liquidity: funds kept safe, liquidity sufficient and settlements accurate, with strong bank and payment-processor relationships

Digital transformation. Find the manual, error-prone steps in finance and payment operations, then work with product and engineering to automate them and to monitor for fund discrepancies, late settlements and unusual transactions.
Team. Lead, coach and grow the finance team, starting with the Financial Controller.
Fundraising and investments. Partner with the CEO on fundraising, board and investor materials and the numbers behind major decisions; oversee corporate investments.
Compliance, over time. Work with our compliance lead on fund controls, audit evidence and bank requirements, with room to take on more compliance responsibility as you grow into the role.

How You'll Work

This is a startup seat: you manage the team and do the work yourself.

While the team is still being built, you dig into the books, chase discrepancies and deal with banks and payment processors yourself
You make sound calls with incomplete information, and bring risks and proposed fixes to the CEO early
When you find a cross-team problem, you push it through to resolution instead of only reporting it
You keep daily money movement and finance running while you build the systems underneath

What You Bring

CPA designation, with a strong accounting and Controller foundation
Experience leading a full finance function and managing a team
End-to-end ownership of month-end close, financial statements, external audit and internal controls
Hands-on experience with payment or transaction fund flows: reconciliation, settlement, payouts and refunds
You have led at least one digital transformation of a finance or payment-operations process and can explain the results before and after. You don't need to write code, but you can read a process, define the rules and verify the outcome
Real banking and payment-processor relationship experience you can walk us through with examples
Professional working proficiency in both English and Mandarin
Based in the Greater Toronto Area and able to work from our Toronto office

The strongest fit has grown from Controller or finance operations at a payments, wallet, fintech or high-volume platform company, rebuilt systems hands-on and led a small team. Big-company titles count less than having managed the books, the funds and the transaction flows together.

Nice to have

Experience in payments, fintech or other regulated businesses, working with compliance on fund controls, audit evidence and bank requirements
SQL, BI or API data experience (real implementations matter more than tool names)
Multi-entity finance across Canada and the US
Fundraising, bank credit facilities, data rooms, or investor and board communication
Business analytics: runway, unit economics and operating KPIs

Compensation and location

The role offers an annual compensation package of up to CAD $300,000, including base salary and a performance-based bonus, depending on experience.

Based in our Toronto office. Our team works in both English and Mandarin.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Risk Assessments
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 278455

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Scotiabank is seeking a transformational senior leader to modernize how technology and cybersecurity risks are assessed across the Bank. Reporting to the Vice President, IT Governance & Risk Oversight within the Office of the Chief Information Officer, the Senior Director, Technology Risk Assessments leads Scotiabank's global first-line technology and cybersecurity assessment capability relating to the Bank’s Threat Risk Assessments and Vendor Security Review processes.

The Senior Director brings the Bank's Threat Risk Assessment and Vendor Security Review processes under one leadership responsibility, creating an integrated approach to assessing internally developed technology solutions and third-party technology services. Together, these form an integrated Assessment Authority: one first-line capability for technology and cybersecurity assessment that preserves specialized expertise while introducing common leadership and strategic direction, coordinated intake and triage, consistent assessment methods and risk language, shared evidence and quality principles, reusable platform and security patterns, stronger risk reporting and traceability, modern workflows and structured data, and progressive use of artificial intelligence (AI) and automation.

This role is broader than traditional assessment delivery. It is an enterprise leadership and transformation opportunity to turn fragmented, document-heavy processes into an integrated, risk-based and evidence-informed assessment lifecycle. It brings together technology risk, cybersecurity, security advisory, third-party risk, cloud and AI security, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) modernization, adoption of ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM), data and automation, and leadership of a global team.

You Will Shape And Lead Six Connected Themes

Integrated Assessment Authority: One accountable leadership model for Threat Risk Assessment (TRA) and Vendor Security Review (VSR), with common direction, methods and risk language across specialized assessment teams.
Shift-left security assessment: Technology and cybersecurity risks identified and addressed earlier in architecture, design and delivery, when they are least costly to resolve.
Platform and application assessment: A two-level model that assesses shared platforms once and focuses application and vendor assessments on what is genuinely specific.
Evidence-informed risk decisions: Risk conclusions grounded in structured, verifiable evidence and consistent rating criteria rather than document volume.
Modern workflow, data and automation: Assessments run through modern ServiceNow IRM workflows, supported by structured data and the progressive use of AI and automation.
Portfolio risk insight: Clear, traceable reporting that surfaces recurring and systemic risks across the Bank's technology and third-party portfolio.

The Platform And Application Model Works At Two Levels

Horizontal assessments evaluate common platforms, shared services and approved technology patterns once, so related controls and evidence can be reused.
Vertical assessments evaluate the application, workload, project, vendor or material change, and focus on specific deviations, exposures and residual risks

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

Lead the existing TRA and VSR capabilities under one senior leadership model, preserving specialized expertise while establishing common direction, coordinated intake and triage, and shared standards.
Define and maintain consistent assessment methodology, risk-rating criteria, quality requirements, evidence principles and finding taxonomies, aligned to the Bank's technology control objectives and enterprise control library and to recognized frameworks such as the National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF), ISO/IEC 27001 and the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS).
Embed technology and cybersecurity assessment earlier in architecture, design and technology delivery, including the Bank's delivery framework, architecture review processes and Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
Establish reusable security and platform patterns that allow downstream assessments to inherit approved baselines.
Assess material application-specific and vendor-specific risks, including data, identity, integration, architecture, exposure and residual risk.
Strengthen threat modelling and scenario-based risk analysis, using recognized approaches such as STRIDE and MITRE ATT&CK.
Act as the business owner for the technology-risk assessment capability within ServiceNow IRM, defining assessment requirements, workflows and data needs while working with the technical platform team, which owns platform configuration and delivery.
Lead the assessment-domain transition from legacy processes and repositories into modern IRM workflows, preserving application-to-assessment and application-to-risk traceability and establishing clear data-quality requirements.
Define risk-based triggers for reassessment following material change, significant vulnerability, control failure or deviation from an approved pattern.
Establish targeted post-implementation assurance for selected material controls, using authoritative evidence from accountable control owners and specialist functions.
Prioritize appropriate AI and automation opportunities across intake, triage, context extraction, pattern matching, assessment drafting, evidence orchestration and portfolio insight, in alignment with the Bank's enterprise artificial intelligence and technology-risk automation initiatives.
Identify recurring and systemic risks across the assessment portfolio and provide clear risk insight to technology leaders and governance forums.
Produce assessment outcomes that are timely, consistent, traceable, evidence-informed and defensible for regulatory, second-line, quality assurance and Internal Audit review, including under the Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions (OSFI) Guideline B-13 and the New York State Department of Financial Services (NYDFS) Part 500 cybersecurity regulation, where applicable.
Lead and develop a large, multidisciplinary and geographically distributed team, building capabilities in security advisory, cloud and AI security, third-party security risk, methodology, data and automation..

Critical Partnerships

Success depends on strong partnerships across the Bank's three lines of defense. Each partner keeps its established mandate, and the Senior Director works with them to ensure that assessment conclusions are well-informed and aligned. Key partners include:

Technology leadership: Chief Information Officers (CIOs) and their delivery, architecture and engineering teams, the primary clients of the assessment capability.
Cybersecurity and architecture: The Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and Enterprise Architecture, to align security standards, patterns and design guidance.
Control owners and control testing: Teams that implement and operate controls, and the Bank's technology control testing function, whose evidence informs assessment conclusions.
Technology risk management: Technology risk teams and Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) teams, which manage and aggregate technology risk across the Bank.
Platform and automation: The ServiceNow IRM platform and implementation teams, and the Bank's enterprise artificial intelligence and technology-risk automation initiatives, to ensure aligned workflows and data.
Governance and reporting: IT risk governance, issue management and reporting teams within the Office of the Chief Information Officer.
Independent oversight: Second-line risk management, Internal Quality Assurance (IQA) and Internal Audit, which provide independent challenge and assurance, and the teams that manage the Bank's regulatory relationships

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in technology risk, cybersecurity or risk assessment, including senior leadership of technology or cybersecurity risk assessment functions.
Deep expertise in security advisory, assessment methodology and threat modelling at enterprise scale.
Strong experience in third-party and vendor security risk, and in cloud, AI, application and platform security.
A track record of leading enterprise GRC transformation, including with ServiceNow IRM or a comparable GRC platform, from business requirements through adoption.
Strong understanding of development, security and operations (DevSecOps) practices and secure-by-design principles.
Experience engaging regulators and Internal Audit in a highly regulated environment, ideally financial services.
Proven ability to lead large, distributed teams and to lead through influence across federated organizations and with senior technology executives.

Preferred Experience

Advanced degree or professional certifications such as Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC) or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
Experience leading platform- and pattern-based assessment models that allow controls to be inherited across applications and workloads.
Hands-on experience with risk data, evidence orchestration and workflow automation, including integrations with security tooling.
Familiarity with AI, machine learning and agentic AI applications in GRC, such as intake triage, artifact analysis, control mapping and risk-theme identification.
Experience applying structured risk-rating criteria, calibration and quantitative risk techniques.
Experience partnering with control-testing functions to integrate authoritative control evidence into risk assessment, ideally within a large financial institution

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons, contests, Humans of Digital and much more.

Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.

The Director, Global Hosting Services, defines, leads, and governs Deloitte Global’s private-cloud hosting strategy, data center and cloud networking services, and Global Wide Area Network (GWAN). The role oversees secure, resilient connectivity among Deloitte Global hosting facilities, member-firm environments, and cloud service provider (CSP) hubs across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. The Director also leads CSP cost reporting and invoice reconciliation through the Deloitte Cloud Services (DCS) Cloud Business Office, supports agile delivery of platform and network enhancements, and ensures operational excellence and rapid incident response across these services.

Key Responsibilities:

Deloitte Cloud Services (DCS) Networking

Oversee the design and implementation of network architecture supporting DCS hubs, connectivity among Deloitte environments, the internet, and cloud service providers, and secure access to cloud-hosted services, including firewalls and load balancers:
Multi-CSP connectivity
Inter-CSP connectivity
Secure hybrid-cloud IPv4/IPv6 connectivity
CSP inter-region global connectivity
CSP intra-region scalability
IP addressing management

Lead the team in delivering these services, with operational excellence and 24/7 monitoring and support.
Drive continuous improvement and automation through API enhancements and agentic AI solutions to reduce service-delivery time and enable proactive monitoring, rapid issue identification, and resolution.

What will your typical day look like?

Interfirm Network Service (GWAN)

Lead the Interfirm Network Service (INS), providing seamless, secure, resilient, and optimized connectivity among member firms and across public-cloud environments.
Develop solution roadmaps and architectures that address evolving business needs, technology requirements, cybersecurity threats, and demand for high-performance, low-latency connectivity.
Drive operational service excellence, support member-firm disaster recovery testing exercises, and adapt connectivity options as firms implement local in-country WAN and SD-WAN solutions.
Manage IPv4/IPv6 address allocation for member firms and countries.

Deloitte Cloud Services (DCS) Cloud Business Office

Provide scaled agile delivery services supporting product enhancements for DCS platform, product, and networking teams, as well as Global Enterprise Cloud Management Services.
Lead Cloud Business Office delivery of CSP cost insights for member firms, CSP invoice reconciliation, and billing to Deloitte entities. Support FinOps through cost-optimization recommendations, CSP cost reporting, and AI token-ledger reporting.

Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.
Serve as a trusted liaison to Cyber teams on cloud-related matters, champion Cyber initiatives, and review and provide feedback on Cyber standards and programs.

Private Cloud Delivery (Colocation Services)

Define and continuously evolve Deloitte Global’s private-hosting and colocation strategy, including regional services in the United States and Germany. Adapt the strategy to emerging requirements such as zero-trust networking, private infrastructure supporting GPU-intensive AI workloads, and future quantum-computing capabilities.
Lead the team in delivering these services while maintaining operational excellence and compliance with audit, SOC, and ISO requirements.
Develop private-cloud roadmaps, standards, and reference architectures, and establish governance frameworks, policies, and cost-recovery processes.

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Strong background in automation and operational leadership.
Ability to plan, organize, and manage multiple responsibilities; provide technical direction through project completion; and deliver high-quality outcomes within target timeframes.
Demonstrated ability to drive change and influence senior stakeholders.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
Experience managing global, distributed teams.
Deep understanding of the latest technology, market and trends

Overview

Director, Digital & Information Management is a leadership role responsible for developing and implementing the digital strategy and information management framework for one of our major new build projects. The role is responsible for developing and implementing the digital strategy and information management framework for this project. The Director reports functionally to the Vice-President, Digital Solutions and operationally to the Project Director.

This Director ensures that all project data, documentation, and digital systems are integrated, secure, and aligned with company standards, regulatory requirements, industry standards, and project objectives. The position drives digital transformation to enable efficient collaboration, lifecycle data management, and regulatory compliance across engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning phases.

Key responsibilities include leading project teams, developing work execution plans, recruiting and assigning team members, managing project deliverables, organizational structure, budget, schedule, risk management, and overseeing people forecasting and levelling for the project.

Your role

Lead the development and execution of the Digital and Information Management strategy for a large-scale nuclear new build project.
Align digital initiatives with project objectives, corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and long-term asset lifecycle management.
Champion digital transformation through BIM, digital twins, data analytics, advanced collaboration platforms, and emerging technologies.
Establish and govern enterprise-wide information management frameworks, including data governance, metadata standards, and document control processes.
Ensure compliance with nuclear industry regulations, cybersecurity standards, and industry best practices such as ISO 19650 and IEC 62645.
Implement and manage integrated digital systems, including BIM, EDMS, project controls, scheduling, cost management, ERP, and asset information platforms.
Lead the deployment of Common Data Environments (CDE) and Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) solutions across EPCM partners, suppliers, and stakeholders.
Oversee project-wide BIM execution, ensuring cross-disciplinary integration, interoperability, data quality, and a single source of truth for project information.
Establish robust cybersecurity, digital safety, training, and corrective action programs to protect critical systems and ensure regulatory compliance.
Monitor digital performance, drive stakeholder adoption, report on system effectiveness and data integrity, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement and cost optimization.

About You

Minimum 10 years of leadership experience in digital transformation, information management, or IT management within large infrastructure, engineering, energy, or industrial projects.
Strong expertise with BIM, Common Data Environments (CDE), Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS), and project controls platforms.
Experience with integrated 3D engineering design technologies such as Hexagon SmartPlant/Smart 3D, AVEVA, or comparable plant design systems.
Knowledge of nuclear new build projects, reactor design, construction execution, and nuclear industry operating practices is preferred.
Proven ability to lead teams, manage direct reports, and support project delivery organizations through complex digital initiatives.
Solid understanding of Advanced Work Packaging (AWP), engineering, procurement, and construction workflows within large capital projects.
Familiarity with ISO 19650 information management standards, cybersecurity frameworks, and nuclear regulatory compliance requirements.
Strong commitment to nuclear safety culture, industrial safety programs, quality assurance standards, and continuous regulatory compliance.
Demonstrated leadership, stakeholder engagement, communication, customer relationship, and organizational management skills with the ability to drive change.
Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, accountability, teamwork, delegation, problem-solving, and decision-making while performing effectively in high-pressure environments.
