Your role at Dynatrace

The Senior Director of Enterprise AI is accountable for defining, governing, and scaling Dynatrace's enterprise AI strategy to drive measurable productivity, operational efficiency, and competitive advantage across the organization. This role operates at the intersection of business strategy, applied AI, and organizational capability, translating a rapidly evolving technology landscape into a clear, enterprise-wide AI agenda with multi-year impact.

Enterprise AI Strategy and Roadmap

Partner with the VP of AI, Data & Collaboration and executive stakeholders to define, refine, and operationalize Dynatrace’s enterprise AI strategy, ensuring alignment with company priorities and measurable business outcomes.
Develop a forward-looking perspective on generative AI, agentic systems, and workflow automation, translating market and technology shifts into practical strategic direction for the enterprise.
Own the enterprise AI roadmap by identifying, prioritizing, and sequencing initiatives across Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, Legal, Marketing, and IT based on business value, feasibility, and risk.
Lead portfolio-level build, buy, and partner decisions by evaluating SaaS vendors, platform integrations such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, and SAP, and custom-build trade-offs; bringing well-reasoned recommendations to executive leadership.
Use Dynatrace’s observability platform as a strategic advantage to monitor, measure, and continuously improve the reliability, performance, and business impact of internally deployed AI solutions.

AI Governance and Responsible AI

Mature and own Dynatrace’s enterprise AI governance framework, including acceptable use policies, risk tiering, human-in-the-loop thresholds, and decision authority standards for AI systems across the organization.
Partner with Legal, Risk, Security, Compliance, and Works Council stakeholders to ensure AI deployments meet requirements for data privacy, regulation, security, and labor co-determination.
Design AI risk assessment processes that enable responsible adoption at speed, creating guardrails that protect the organization without slowing practical innovation.
Define data usage policies, model transparency expectations, and audit standards so Dynatrace can demonstrate responsible AI practices to regulators, customers, employees, and internal stakeholders.
Serve as the senior internal voice on AI ethics, fairness, and accountability, building confidence in how AI-enabled decisions are made, reviewed, and governed.

Organizational AI Capability and Maturity

Design and execute an enterprise AI enablement program that includes executive briefings, AI literacy workshops, department-level playbooks, and training curricula to raise AI maturity at every level.
Establish an AI Center of Excellence to standardize delivery practices, capture institutional knowledge, and scale proven AI patterns across departments and workflows.
Define and track enterprise AI maturity metrics, measuring adoption, capability growth, and the organizational shift toward AI-augmented work.

Executive Engagement and Value Realization

Serve as the primary AI thought leader and internal advisor to Dynatrace’s leadership, translating complex AI developments into clear strategic guidance and business cases.
Own portfolio-level AI value realization by defining success metrics such as productivity gains, cycle-time reduction, cost savings, and manual work eliminated; build executive-facing ROI reporting and communicate impact on a regular cadence.
Stay current on emerging AI technologies, vendors, and industry practices, maintaining a strong external perspective that informs Dynatrace’s internal strategy.

Minimum Requirements

What will help you succeed

12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise technology, AI/ML, or digital transformation leadership — with at least 3–5 years in a senior director or equivalent role with demonstrated portfolio ownership.

Preferred Requirements

Demonstrated success shaping and operationalizing enterprise AI strategies that drive measurable impact across global, cross-functional organizations.
Deep knowledge of modern AI technologies including large language models (LLMs), agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and automation platforms — with the credibility to evaluate vendor claims and guide architectural decisions.
Experience owning AI governance: building acceptable use policies, risk tiering frameworks, human oversight models, and working with Legal and Compliance on enterprise-wide guardrails.
Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing teams — including hiring, developing, and retaining AI product managers and technical program leads.
Strong executive presence and communication skills: able to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical audiences, build business cases for AI investment, and present confidently to C-suite and board-level stakeholders.
Experience building AI centers of excellence, capability programs, or organizational enablement initiatives that measurably increased AI maturity.
Familiarity with enterprise platforms — ServiceNow, Salesforce, SAP, or similar — and an understanding of how AI capabilities are embedded within existing business systems and workflows.
Exposure to data platform architecture (Snowflake, medallion/lakehouse patterns, semantic layers) and how governed enterprise data enables AI at scale.
Track record of leading enterprise transformation through influence — driving adoption, managing change, and building cross-functional alignment without direct authority over every stakeholder.
Experience with build/buy/partner decisions at the portfolio level, including vendor evaluation, contract negotiation support, and post-implementation performance tracking.
Bonus: hands-on experience with observability or monitoring platforms — Dynatrace or similar — applied to AI system performance and reliability.

This is a remote eligible position out of Canada. Candidates are required to work EST hours for this position.

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

Compensation And Rewards

DOE, salary $208K CAD - $260K CAD, plus Health, Dental, Life, STD, LTD, 401K, PTO. Total compensation may vary depending on candidate experience/education and location.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff and AI Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
Summary

Role
: Work alongside our CEO to improve how we run the firm and serve climate founders.
Preferred experience:
3–6 years spanning top-tier consulting (MBB or comparable) and product management or hands-on product building
Location:
Fully remote and primarily in local timezone. Will require 1-2 hours of overlap with US Pacific late afternoons Mon–Thu.
Pay:
CA$155,000–180,000 a year + performance bonus + shadow client equity. Paid monthly as an independent contractor.
Seniority:
Associate or Senior Associate level, reporting to the CEO
Expected start
: Q1 2027

Overview

Planetary Scale partners with climate and energy-transition companies as their strategic finance arm. The founders we work with are turning breakthrough science into groundbreaking companies across energy, materials, transport, industry, and agriculture, and getting from the lab to scale requires a clear strategy and strong financial leadership. We've helped them raise hundreds of millions in venture and debt funding and get through the hardest moments on their path to scale.

We're hiring a Chief of Staff and AI Enablement Lead to work closely with our CEO on the special projects and initiatives that will dramatically improve how we operate and how we deliver for the founders and leadership teams we work with. Most of that effort will focus on how our client delivery teams work and the tools and processes they use to solve problems and create value for our clients. Secondary focus areas include our go-to-market execution, internal research and data management, team engagement, and the sourcing, hiring and onboarding of talent.

You'll use AI extensively to build new tools, improve the way we work, and give each of our team members new superpowers. Some of the things you build will become standalone products that we offer alongside our consulting and advisory services.

The Role

You'll be our CEO's partner on the firm's top priorities. That means taking an initiative from a rough idea to something that runs: scoping the problem, building the plan and the analysis, doing much of the work yourself, and bringing the team along so the change sticks. Alongside these areas, there will be special projects that don't fit neatly into any of them.

You'll spend at least half of your time building and working with AI. You'll use AI coding agents to build tools, automate workflows and solve complex problems, and you'll help everyone on our team to adopt and deploy AI in their own work. You don't need an engineering background, but you will need product judgment, process discipline, and a lot of curiosity and imagination.

A significant part of the job will be done outside of AI. You'll help our CEO to sharpen our company strategy, craft proposals, refine thought leadership content, and occasionally jump in to help a client-facing team tackle a new challenge or meet a deadline.

You'll have frequent check-ins with our CEO to set priorities, work through problems and keep initiatives moving. You'll also be in regular contact with teammates whose work your projects touch, and will play a key role in our monthly and quarterly team calls. In between, you'll develop ideas in shared documents and decks, refining them together live and in your own time.

The scope is intentionally broad. You'll typically work across 2-4 priorities and initiatives at a time, and when a workstream grows towards a full-time job, you'll hire someone to hand it off to.
You'll take on special projects and firm-level initiatives with our CEO, from scoping and analysis through to a working result, and support client work with analyses, research and the preparation that keeps engagements moving.
You'll improve how our client delivery teams operate: the workflows, templates and tools behind their client work. That includes carrying tools we've proven with one client to the next, and taking our fundraise-management product from a working prototype to a SaaS-level tool our clients and their investors log into.
You'll support our organization and talent strategy, including how we source and hire people, how we onboard them, and how we help them develop here.
You'll support our go-to-market strategy, including proposals, the content engine, and other initiatives that grow our presence and standing in the climate ecosystem.
You'll lead our internal AI enablement across all of this: build and ship tools with AI coding agents and own their quality, run working sessions, pair with teammates on their builds, check the tools they build before a client relies on them, and keep our shared guides current as the tools change.
You'll keep internal operations running — client onboarding logistics, tools administration, cross-team coordination — and find the next thing to automate before anyone asks.

Depending on where your strengths and interests pull you, you may end up building out an operations team under your leadership, grow further into a strategic Chief of Staff, or move into a functional leadership role (e.g. go-to-market).

About You

You hold yourself to a high standard — and you want to work somewhere that does the same. A few things that matter here:
You take ownership before you're asked.
When something needs doing, you do it, and when something looks wrong, you say so. "Not my problem" is not a phrase that gets used here.
You plan before you build.
Before you build a tool or kick off an initiative, you think deeply about the problem you're solving and the context a solution needs to operate in. You gather input from others and research effectively, and you see the value in creating a roadmap even though it may change as you make progress.
You make the people around you more effective.
Whether it's communicating proactively, putting yourself in other peoples' shoes, or being able to envision challenges around the next corner, you have a knack for making things work smoothly.
You learn fast and stay curious.
This role will involve constant variety and rapid learning across business domains, client challenges, a complex tool stack, and an ever-expanding technology frontier. If that doesn't sound exciting to you, then this role is not for you.
The mission matters.
Everyone at Planetary Scale cares deeply about the impact of our work and the importance of scaling new innovation to help mitigate the climate crisis and adapt to a changing world.

Beyond that, for this role specifically:
You bring consulting-grade structure to messy problems,
whether the problem is a client workflow, a hiring plan or a push to grow our presence. You size them, sequence them, and work through them in an order you can defend. This typically comes from a few years at MBB or a comparable top-tier analytical environment.
You've shipped product, and you build with AI every day.
Whether you've been an engineer, a product manager, a founder, or just someone building things to make your own life easier, you've brought new tools to life and made them work in the real world.
You can teach what you know.
You've helped people without your technical background take up a new tool or a new way of working, and they kept using it after you stepped back.
You write clearly and quickly.
Your written updates get the point across clearly and succinctly, and your drafts of proposals, plans and articles need a light edit rather than a rewrite.

It helps if you bring finance or venture literacy (burn, runway, SAFEs, board cadence), experience in go-to-market work, a creative or content bent, or experience on a remote team that works across time zones.

What makes this different

A front seat in building the firm.
You'll work side by side with our CEO on how the firm runs, grows and serves its clients, and help shape where it goes next. It's the kind of scope and influence that typically takes far longer to reach at a larger firm.
A steep curve and a supportive team.
You'll be building on your first day, and simultaneously learning how an AI-native company works while learning about the climate tech
A share in the upside.
Our shadow client equity program gives you a long-term stake in the financial success of the climate companies we serve. If we do our job well, we help save the planet, and we

We're fully remote with team members in the US, Colombia, Poland and the Philippines. Our offer includes performance bonus, client equity exposure and 30 days of PTO.

EEO

Planetary Scale is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates on their merits and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Executive Director, Enterprise Regional Enablement based in Canada.

The Executive Director, Enterprise Regional Enablement will lead the implementation and regional adaptation of enterprise operational risk management frameworks across multiple business units. This strategic leadership position serves as the primary link between enterprise risk functions and regional stakeholders, ensuring consistent standards while addressing local regulatory and operational requirements. The successful candidate will strengthen risk management capabilities, oversee regional control programs, and drive the adoption of enterprise methodologies and tools. Working closely with senior executives, business leaders, compliance teams, and internal audit professionals, they will promote a proactive risk culture and support informed decision-making. The role also involves developing high-performing teams, monitoring emerging regulatory developments, and ensuring regional risk insights contribute to enterprise-wide reporting and governance.

Accountabilities

Act as the primary operational risk enablement partner for regional business leaders, building strong relationships with senior stakeholders, compliance teams, Internal Audit, and other functions across the three lines of defense.
Adapt and implement enterprise risk management frameworks, methodologies, Key Risk Indicator (KRI) standards, taxonomies, and reporting tools to meet regional regulatory, linguistic, currency, and business-specific requirements while maintaining enterprise-wide consistency.
Lead and coordinate regional risk enablement activities, including Risk and Control Assessments (RCAs), KRI development, incident reporting, scenario analysis, and remediation planning. Coach first-line practitioners to develop the capabilities needed to manage risks independently.
Oversee the regional control program, ensuring consistent implementation of enterprise control standards, monitoring practices, control testing, and effectiveness assessments. Track control gaps and remediation initiatives while coordinating assurance activities with Internal Audit and compliance teams.
Strengthen regional risk management capabilities by coordinating training programs, practitioner communities, knowledge-sharing sessions, and regional roundtables. Promote operational risk awareness and support enterprise-wide change initiatives.
Monitor regulatory developments, emerging risks, and significant incidents across assigned regions. Escalate relevant developments to enterprise leadership and specialist Centers of Excellence (CoEs), ensuring timely assessment and appropriate follow-up.
Ensure regional risk data is accurate, reliable, and integrated into enterprise reporting processes. Provide regional insights and analysis to support executive briefings, Board Risk Committee discussions, and other governance forums.
Support regional risk quantification activities, including scenario analysis and loss modeling, in collaboration with specialist enterprise teams.
Represent regional business needs in enterprise Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform decisions, encouraging effective adoption and utilization of risk management technologies and tools.
Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing regional team, overseeing performance management, talent development, succession planning, and ongoing capability building.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
At least 10 years of progressive experience in operational risk management, enterprise risk, internal audit, internal controls, or a related second-line risk function within the financial services or insurance industry.
At least 5 years of people management experience, including leading and developing teams in regional, geographically dispersed, or matrixed environments.
Minimum 5 years of experience in the insurance or reinsurance industry, with at least 3 years of experience working across multiple geographies, regulatory environments, or cultural contexts.
Strong expertise in operational risk management frameworks, including framework design, Risk and Control Assessments (RCA), Key Risk Indicators (KRI), scenario analysis, loss-event management, and control effectiveness methodologies.
Comprehensive understanding of relevant regulatory and industry frameworks, including NAIC ORSA, Solvency II, COSO, and ISO 31000.
Demonstrated experience translating enterprise-level risk strategies into practical regional execution plans that account for local requirements and business priorities.
Hands-on experience with Enterprise Integrated Risk Management and GRC platforms such as ServiceNow IRM, Archer, or MetricStream, as well as reporting and data visualization tools such as Power BI.
Proven proficiency in AI tools, spreadsheets, databases, and emerging technologies applied to risk reporting, analytics, and process improvement.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust across diverse cultural, regulatory, and linguistic environments.
Experience driving organizational change and the adoption of new risk management frameworks, processes, and technologies, with a coaching-oriented approach to capability development.
Preferred experience includes 12+ years in operational risk management, particularly involving framework design and engagement with senior executives, regulators, and Board-level stakeholders.
Additional preferred qualifications include experience designing risk quantification approaches covering inherent and residual risk and control effectiveness, as well as professional certifications such as FRM, PRM, ORM, or CRMA. Lean/Six Sigma or Change Management certifications are also advantageous.

jobs.title: Director of Digital Marketing (Remote, Edmonton)
jobs.description:
Blacksmith Agency

Marketing
Full time
Remote (USA, Canada or South Africa)

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Director of Digital Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.

Our client is a diversified privately-held company that has been in business for over 25 years. They have over 500 employees and are growing across North America and have the immediate need for a Vice President, Finance. This is an on-site
role located in Brampton, ON.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the CFO, our client has the immediate need to recruit a VP Finance who will play an important role in leading and managing the financial operations and reporting of the company. You will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of financial management, providing strategic financial guidance, and contributing to the overall success and growth of the organization. Your expertise in financial analysis, forecasting, and decision-making will be crucial in driving the company’s financial performance and ensuring its long-term financial stability.

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited, to the following:

·Lead the financial reporting process and maintain effective controls over the responsibility, accuracy, and completeness of the results through a detailed understanding and ownership of the accounting processes and core operational systems. 
·Lead the budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling processes to ensure accurate and comprehensive financial projections.
·Conduct regular analysis of financial performance, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. 
·Oversee day-to-day financial operations, including accounting, treasury, taxation, and financial systems.
·Manage cash flow, working capital, and capital allocation to optimize financial resources.
·Implement internal controls and best practices to safeguard company assets and maintain financial integrity.
·Provide financial insights and analysis to support key business decisions, such as investments, mergers and acquisitions, and expansion initiatives.
·Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing finance and accounting team, fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture.
·Collaborate with external stakeholders, including auditors, tax advisors, and financial institutions.
·Identify accounting simplification where appropriate.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

·Approximately 12+ years of demonstrated technical financial acumen in accounting and reporting. Preferably have trained as a CPA with one of the public accounting firms. 
·A minimum of 3-5 years at the Director/VP level having managed a team. 
·Current or previous experience working in a public-company reporting environment either leading or having responsibility for multiple facets of the finance function.
·Strong technical accountant with a preference for someone with IFRS reporting experience.     
·An understanding of tax planning and tax structuring. 

PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS

·Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

EDUCATION

COMPENSATION

Our client is targeting a base salary of approximately $150,000 to $200,000 plus annual bonus, and benefits. There is no RSP or LTI. There is some flexibility on the base salary for the right candidate.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Strategy (AI, Data, Advertising)
jobs.description:
Publicis Groupe Canada
is the Canadian subsidiary of Publicis Groupe, the second largest communications group in the world and a global leader concentrated within four main activities: Communication, Media, Data and Technology. Publicis Groupe Canada represents the vision of a set of collaborative and integrated agencies that offer expertise and insightful services to many of the biggest brands in North America.

Canadian brands include:
Publicis Canada (Publicis Canada, Hawkeye, Razorfish, Publicis Health, ThePubProductions, Nurun, Moov AI, Publicis Sports & Entertainment), Publicis Media (Starcom, Spark Foundry, Zenith), Leo Burnett (Leo Burnett Canada, Ove Brand Design, Leo Burnett Design), Saatchi & Saatchi (Saatchi & Saatchi Canada, Synergize, TPM), MSL Canada/North Strategic and Publicis Sapient.

Overview

The Senior Director, Product Strategy
owns the vision and product roadmap strategy for Connected Solutions (Publicis Groupe’s AI & Data core products). They act as the bridge between client business needs and product capability: turning strategic priorities into a structured, sequenced business roadmap, and holding the line between strategic planning, tactical product design, and execution.

They are a product champion and strategic storyteller, representing Connected Solutions in client-facing pitches, senior presentations, and internal alignment discussions. Ultimately, this person turns individual client opportunities into scalable commercial momentum, and ensures Publicis Groupe’s Connected Solutions evolve in response to client needs.

Core Responsibilities

Roadmap Ownership:
Own the roadmap and rollout sequencing for core agentic solution, and identify adjacent products to grow around the core solution.
Roadmap Prioritization:
Establish clear prioritization criteria for roadmap decisions, balancing client demand, product feasibility, commercial potential, and strategic fit.
Business-to-Technical Bridge:
Set the high-level product vision and desired user experience, then partner with the Product Lead to translate it into an executable plan with Delivery & Technology.
Adoption & Impact
: Define what successful rollout looks like: identifying the adoption signals, client outcomes, and repeatable use cases that indicate potential for scale.
Feedback Loop Management:
Capture friction and adoption signals from clients and agencies, feeding them back into business roadmap prioritization.

Growth and Market Positioning.
Identify & shape growth opportunities within existing and prospective client relationships.
Storytelling & Demos:
Shape and present the business narrative for internal and client-facing moments, translating solution capability into a compelling story that stakeholders, clients, and agencies can act on. Represent Connected Solutions in pitches, senior presentations, demos, and strategic growth conversations.
Client Support:
Support account leads with rollout across priority Publicis Groupe clients. Serve as primary point of escalation for product-related issues, concerns, or strategic pivots; coordinating resolution in partnership with Product Lead.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Deep understanding of the agency ecosystem, ideally with experience across creative, media, and CRM disciplines.
Skilled at translating strategic priorities into terms technical leadership can act on, and vice versa.
Comfortable owning business strategy and rollout sequencing without owning or dictating technical architecture.
AI-fluent; understands where and how agentic AI and automation actually drive efficiency in marketing and media workflows.
Commercially-minded: thinks in terms of packaging, adoption, and client/agency value, not just features.
Strong communicator who can align business stakeholders, clients, agencies, and technical leadership at once.
Comfortable in front of C-level clients and internal executives.

Required Qualifications

BA/BS in Business, Marketing, or a related strategy discipline.
8+ years in product or marketing strategy, ideally within marketing/media agency environments.
Demonstrated expertise in marketing workflows and where AI/agentic solutions create efficiency (e.g., campaign optimization, insight generation, audience planning).
Experience building business roadmaps and rollout strategies for external clients or agency networks.

Preferred / Stand-Out Experience

Experience rolling out agentic AI or automation solutions within marketing or media organizations.
Familiarity with client and agency commercial models (licensing, packaging, service tiers).
Background partnering with technical/engineering leadership without owning technical delivery.
Experience running product advisory boards or structured client workshops.
New business / growth experience.

Additional Information

Eligibility: Candidates must be based in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), possess valid Canadian work authorization, and be willing to commute to our downtown Toronto office.
Hybrid schedule: Rotating 2-day / 3-day in-office schedule (Tue/Thu one week, Mon/Wed/Fri the next).
Competitive annual vacation program, enhanced between Christmas and New Year’s when our offices are closed.
Extended statutory holidays (we give our employees the Mondays and Fridays of provincial holidays so you can enjoy long 4-day weekends).
6 sick days per year and 2 personal days per year.
Monthly cell phone allowance
Employer RRSP matching contributions of up to 2%
“Work Your World” program, allowing you to work remotely for up to 6 weeks in any country where we have an office (50+ countries).
Comprehensive group insurance benefits (medical and dental care, vision care, psychological and paramedical services, disability insurance, fertility support, and gender-affirming care).
Internal support and guidance program for cancer, fertility, and gender transition.

The salary for this position is $160,000 - $200,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.

Publicis Canada is committed to building a diverse workforce representative of our community. We encourage and are pleased to consider all qualified candidates, without regard to race, colour, citizenship, religion, sex, marital / family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, aboriginal status, age, disability or persons who may require an accommodation, to apply. If you require a specific accommodation, please contact Human Resources at inquiries@publicisna.com.

jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

 What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

 Directeur(trice) principal(e) de l’architecture de solutions/Senior Director, Solution Architecture

 À propos du poste

 McKesson recherche un(e) Directeur(trice) Principal(e), Architecture d’Entreprise et Expérience Numérique pour diriger la stratégie d’architecture couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation des solutions héritées (legacy) et la gestion de l’expérience numérique. Ce leader définira la vision de solutions technologiques modernes, évolutives, sécurisées et centrées sur le client afin de soutenir les priorités de l’entreprise et d’améliorer les résultats opérationnels.
 Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez les pratiques d’architecture qui relient la stratégie d’affaires à l’exécution technologique. Vous collaborerez avec les dirigeants, les équipes produits, ingénierie, sécurité, opérations et les parties prenantes métier afin de moderniser les plateformes, simplifier les environnements hérités, orienter la stratégie d’expérience numérique et renforcer la gouvernance architecturale. Vous développerez également les talents, influencerez les décisions à l’échelle de l’entreprise et aiderez les équipes à livrer des solutions technologiques à fort impact dans un environnement complexe et réglementé.

 Ce que vous ferez
 Diriger la pratique d’architecture d’entreprise couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation et la gestion de l’expérience numérique.
 Définir les normes d’architecture, les feuilles de route, les modèles de gouvernance et les cadres décisionnels permettant une livraison technologique sécurisée et évolutive.
 Collaborer avec les dirigeants et les responsables métier afin d’aligner la stratégie d’architecture sur les objectifs d’affaires, les besoins des clients et les priorités de l’entreprise.
 Diriger les stratégies de modernisation des applications et plateformes héritées, y compris la rationalisation applicative, la migration vers le cloud, l’intégration, l’automatisation et la réduction de la dette technique.
 Orienter l’architecture de l’expérience numérique afin d’améliorer l’utilisabilité, l’accessibilité, la performance, la fiabilité ainsi que les parcours clients et employés de bout en bout.
 Conseiller les équipes sur les modèles d’architecture modernes, notamment les API, les microservices, les plateformes cloud natives, l’intégration de données, la gestion des identités, la sécurité et l’observabilité.
 Superviser la planification du portefeuille d’architecture, la stratégie fournisseurs, les recommandations d’investissement et la création de valeur mesurable.
 Développer les responsables et les équipes d’architecture grâce au mentorat, à la gestion des talents, à l’évaluation de la performance et à un leadership inclusif.

 Exigences de base
 13 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en technologie, dont au moins 6 ans dans des fonctions de leadership en architecture, ingénierie, livraison d’applications, plateformes numériques ou transformation technologique. 
 Diplôme universitaire en informatique, systèmes d’information, ingénierie ou domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
 Expérience dans la direction d’architectures d’entreprise, de solutions ou applicatives dans des environnements technologiques de grande envergure.
 Expérience de la conception et de la modernisation d’architectures de solutions d’entreprise en s’appuyant sur des plateformes intégrant l’intelligence artificielle et des technologies émergentes afin de stimuler l’innovation, l’évolutivité et la création de valeur.
 Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies d’architecture, de feuilles de route, de normes, de modèles de gouvernance et de recommandations destinées aux dirigeants.
 Expérience dans la modernisation d’applications, de plateformes ou de capacités numériques héritées.
 Expérience en gestion de responsables, d’équipes d’architecture ou d’équipes technologiques multidisciplinaires.
 Expérience de collaboration avec des parties prenantes métier et technologiques de haut niveau pour influencer la stratégie et l’exécution.
 Expérience en planification budgétaire, gestion des fournisseurs, priorisation de portefeuille ou prise de décisions d’investissement technologique.

 Compétences et expériences privilégiées
 Expérience avec les plateformes cloud, les stratégies API, les microservices, l’architecture événementielle (event-driven), le DevSecOps ou l’ingénierie de plateformes.
 Expérience en gestion de l’expérience numérique, plateformes d’expérience client, portails, applications mobiles/web ou solutions omnicanales.
 Expérience dans les secteurs de la santé, de la distribution pharmaceutique, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, du commerce de détail ou d’autres environnements d’entreprise réglementés.
 Expérience des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, des comités de revue d’architecture, de la modélisation des capacités ou de la gestion de portefeuille applicatif.
 Expérience de direction de programmes de transformation à grande échelle impliquant plusieurs équipes, fonctions ou unités d’affaires.
 Excellentes compétences en communication avec les dirigeants et capacité à simplifier des décisions technologiques complexes pour des audiences métier.
 Capacité démontrée à améliorer la performance opérationnelle, réduire la dette technique et accélérer la mise sur le marché.
 Style de leadership axé sur la collaboration, la vision stratégique, la conduite du changement, l’orientation client et le développement des talents.

 Déplacements, présence au bureau et exigences physiques
 Le modèle de travail peut être à distance, hybride ou en présentiel selon les besoins de l’entreprise et de l’équipe.
 Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des réunions de leadership, des sessions de planification, des rencontres avec des fournisseurs ou des activités de collaboration d’équipe.
 Le poste requiert une utilisation régulière de l’ordinateur ainsi qu’une participation à des réunions virtuelles et en personne.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing & Digital Commerce
jobs.description:
**Director of Marketing \& Digital Commerce**

**BARBECUES GALORE \| Full\-time \| Senior leadership \| Reports to President**

Barbecues Galore is a specialty retailer with eight store locations and a growing e\-commerce business. We help customers explore barbecues, outdoor kitchens, patio furniture, fireplaces, accessories and related products through knowledgeable in\-store service and convenient online shopping.

We are looking for a Director of Marketing \& Digital Commerce to lead our entire marketing and e\-commerce operations. You will own the website and digital content, build our brand, bring more customers into our showrooms and grow profitable online revenue. This is a hands\-on leadership opportunity for someone who can turn strategy into measurable retail and digital sales results.

**Key Areas of Responsibility** 

· Retail traffic and sales: Create local and company\-wide campaigns that increase qualified visits and sales at all eight stores; lead local SEO, Google Business Profiles, geo\-targeted advertising, signage and store\-specific promotions.

· E\-commerce growth: Own online sales strategy, revenue targets, merchandising, customer acquisition, conversion, checkout improvements, average order value, retention and profitability.

· One connected customer journey: Make the website a powerful research and store\-visit tool as well as a high\-performing online shop; connect promotions, product information and customer experiences across channels.

· Website and digital content: Direct website strategy, design, navigation, mobile experience, development roadmap and optimization; maintain accurate product descriptions, specifications, pricing, imagery, videos, buying guides and landing pages.

· Marketing and brand: Lead brand positioning, seasonal campaigns, paid search and social, SEO, email, social content, creative production, product launches and customer loyalty initiatives.

· In\-store cooking demos and vendor events: Plan and schedule demonstrations across stores, delivered by our own teams and vendor representatives; coordinate products, staffing, logistics and promotion to generate attendance, engagement and sales.

· Team and partner leadership: Lead and develop marketing and e\-commerce employees; manage agencies, developers, vendors, projects and collaboration with store management, Purchasing, Operations and IT.

· Budgets, systems and results: Manage marketing budgets and digital tools; coordinate with IT on e\-commerce, CRM, inventory and POS integrations; track performance and improve marketing return on investment.

**How success will be measured**

Growth in store traffic and retail sales; profitable online revenue; website conversion and average order value; customer acquisition and retention; local search visibility; successful in\-store events; campaign return on investment; and strong team execution.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

**Required**

* Significant leadership experience in marketing, digital commerce, and retail\-related business operations.
* Demonstrated success developing marketing strategies that drive both physical store traffic and online sales.
* Strong understanding of omnichannel retail marketing and customer purchasing behavior.
* Experience managing e\-commerce platforms and delivering measurable online revenue growth.
* Proven ability to lead marketing teams, manage budgets, and oversee external agencies.
* Experience with website management, digital content, SEO, paid advertising, and analytics.
* Strong knowledge of digital customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and retention strategies.
* Experience planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect marketing initiatives to revenue and profitability.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and project management skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in multi\-location retail environments.
* Experience in specialty retail, home improvement, outdoor living, appliances, or other product\-focused retail categories.
* Experience with large online product catalogues and complex product information.
* Familiarity with retail point\-of\-sale, inventory, CRM, ERP, and e\-commerce integrations.
* Experience developing local store marketing programs alongside national or company\-wide campaigns.
* Experience managing seasonal retail promotional calendars.
* Demonstrated success leading website improvements and digital transformation projects.

**The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded marketing leader who understands that the ultimate objective of marketing is to generate profitable business growth.

This individual understands the importance of physical retail stores and recognizes that a strong digital presence should not only generate online sales but also bring more customers into our showrooms.

jobs.title: Director SMB Digital Growth - B2B Payments
jobs.description:
Description

At Xe, we live currencies
. Founded in 1993, Xe is a global leader in currency exchange and international money transfers. What began as a simple currency converter has grown into a platform trusted by over 300 million people each year. We provide a comprehensive range of currency services and products, including our real-time exchange rates, Currency Converter, Market Analysis and Currency Data API, supporting 130+ currencies across 190+ countries with quick, easy, secure Money Transfers for individuals and businesses. We leverage technology to deliver these services through our website, mobile app, and by phone. Backed by Euronet, we process more than $115 billion in global payments annually. Xe is profitable, product-led, and focused on building reliable, user-first tools that make moving money across borders easier for everyone.

Our Principles

At Xe, we value people who take initiative, think big, and follow through. We’re curious by nature and not afraid to ask what if or try something new. Everyone’s voice matters here. We expect people to speak up, bring ideas, and take ownership of their work. We don’t micromanage. We trust each other to make good calls, take responsibility, and move fast when it counts. And we care about community. Not in a vague corporate way, but in the sense that we have each other’s backs, stay open to feedback, and build a culture of trust and real collaboration.

Ambition. We dream big, try things out, and always ask “why not?” and “what if?” We’re ambitious in our thinking and our delivery.
Responsibility. We get involved, bring our perspective, and are always open to new ideas. We take personal responsibility.
Community. We value a sense of belonging, trusting each other, and encouraging authenticity. We contribute to our community.

The Role.
In this role, you’ll be responsible for building and scaling Xe’s SMB acquisition and lifecycle engine. Combining Account-Based Marketing (ABM), digital sales leadership, funnel optimization, and modern go-to-market (GTM) technologies, you will drive scalable customer acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue growth. This is a strategic yet hands-on leadership role, ideal for a commercially driven growth leader who thrives on building scalable acquisition systems, leveraging data and automation, and translating innovative GTM strategies into measurable business results.

Owning the full SMB customer lifecycle — from inbound lead generation and qualification to activation, retention, and upsell.
Managing a digital sales team (1 BDM and 2 SDRs).
Using smart sales tech, intent data, and personalization at scale to improve efficiency and revenue growth.

Growth, Funnel Optimization & ABM

Lead the SMB digital growth strategy, focusing on Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and high-intent inbound sales.
Design and optimize inbound lead flows — from content and paid campaigns to qualification and activation.
Build and execute personalized outbound and inbound workflows using modern GTM tools (e.g., Instantly.ai, Clay, RB2B, Vector, HeyReach.io, Findymail, Trigify.io, ChatGPT).
Develop ABM campaigns that integrate ads, website intent data, and outbound engagement to improve relevance and timing precision.
Own the SMB funnel from lead to first transaction — optimizing conversion, activation, and LTV through testing and experimentation.
Partner with Marketing and Product teams to enhance onboarding UX and reduce friction for new SMB customers.

Strategy & Execution

Define and track SMB KPIs: acquisition, activation, ARPU, churn, NPS, and inbound/outbound ROI.
Align tightly with marketing to ensure lead quality, content alignment, and campaign targeting.
Collaborate with analytics to identify performance levers and test new acquisition hypotheses.
Feed SMB insights into the product and growth roadmap to influence future innovation.
Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and customer-centric growth.

Digital Sales Leadership

Manage the SMB digital sales team (BDM + SDRs) and align them around a hybrid inbound + account-based outbound model.
Implement smart outbound systems using signals, lead scoring, and automation to prioritize outreach.
Build scalable playbooks for lead nurturing, personalization, and cross-channel engagement.
Create repeatable, measurable sales workflows that balance automation and human connection.

What You’ll Bring

You have 5–8+ years of experience in B2B growth, digital sales, demand generation, revenue growth, or go-to-market roles, preferably within fintech, SaaS, financial services, or other digitally driven B2B environments.
You also have 2+ years of people management experience, including direct leadership of SDRs, BDRs, BDMs, or digital sales teams, with demonstrated success in coaching, performance management, and revenue delivery.
You bring a proven track record of scaling B2B inbound lead generation and optimizing sales funnels to improve lead qualification, conversion, customer activation, and revenue growth.
You have proven experience developing and executing Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and targeted outbound sales strategies, leveraging customer segmentation, intent data, personalized outreach, and multichannel engagement to generate qualified pipeline.
Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and optimize B2B acquisition funnels, from lead generation and qualification through conversion, activation, and revenue generation.
Hands-on experience with modern GTM technology, sales automation, and prospecting tools, such as Clay, Instantly.ai, RB2B, HeyReach, Apollo, or comparable platforms.
Strong analytical capabilities, including experience measuring and improving conversion rates, customer acquisition cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), activation, retention, and campaign ROI.
Experience implementing lead scoring, automated workflows, CRM integrations, and personalized sales engagement sequences to improve sales productivity and conversion.
Strong leadership experience managing cross-functional sales or growth teams. Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Sales, and Analytics teams to execute growth initiatives and improve customer experiences.
Excellent communicator who thrives in fast-paced, collaborative environments. Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to translate customer insights and performance data into measurable revenue growth.
Entrepreneurial, curious, and motivated by measurable impact. A hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset, with demonstrated success testing new growth strategies, building scalable processes, and operating in fast-paced environments.

Preferred

Background in fintech, payments, FX or cross-border money movement.
Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).
Experience building sales playbooks and scaling an inbound plus outbound hybrid model.
Familiarity with product-led growth or improving digital onboarding flows.

Why Xe

Global brand with 100M+ monthly users and a fast-growing B2B business.
Opportunity to build a cutting-edge inbound and ABM engine from the ground up.
Collaborative, innovative, and customer-first culture.

Perks & Benefits (Canada)

Competitive salary and incentive.
Vacation+ personal days + day off for your birthday + sick time + holidays
Volunteering day for a charity of your choice
Healthcare
Life & Disability insurance
Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing
Matched employer RRSP contribution (subject to limits)
Discounted Euronet Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP)
A chance to grow your career in a mission-driven global company.

Why Join Us?
You'll be part of a fast-moving team where your contributions directly impact growth. We invest in our people with tools, mentorship, and opportunities to level up fast-whether that's moving into closing roles or leadership paths. You'll also play a key role in shaping how we go to market in the competitive payments space, using real insights and industry benchmarks to stay ahead of the curve.

Xe offers a competitive salary and benefits package. Actual compensation is based upon factors such as the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Xe offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role, including healthcare, dental and vision benefits, retirement plan, paid vacation/sick leave and more.

Xe values diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. At Xe, we are committed to making our recruitment practices barrier-free and as accessible as possible for everyone. This includes adjustments or changes for disabled people, neurodiverse people or people with long-term health conditions. If you would like us to do anything differently during the application, interview or assessment process, including providing information in an alternative format, please contact us at recruitment@xe.com. It is not to be taken as a complete statement of responsibilities or requirements. Director, AI Applications Development.

iVedha Inc. is hiring Director - AI Applications Development, where you'll lead the AI Applications Development function and guide a high-performing team of AI engineers, developers, and quality assurance specialists who build and support enterprise-grade AI solutions. As Director, you'll provide technical and people leadership to drive the design, development, deployment, and ongoing evolution of advanced AI applications across the organization. You'll work closely with technology and business partners to shape solution architecture, define integration requirements, and deliver solutions that align to strategic priorities and enterprise standards. You'll help ensure AI-driven applications are secure, scalable, reliable, and well monitored, with a strong focus on cloud-native delivery, observability, and compliance. iVedha is a global AI-first digital transformation company with over 25 years of proven excellence, empowering enterprises to modernize, scale, and innovate. Toronto, Ontario, Canada

37.5

This role is eligible for a discretionary variable compensation award that considers business and individual performance. 
 TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

 As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

 Job Description: 
 The Head, Technology Portfolio Management, Transaction Banking is the accountable executive for the integrated management and delivery oversight of the full Transaction Banking technology portfolio spanning digital channels, ledger and payments. The role converts business and technology strategy into a prioritized, funded and executable portfolio; oversees multiple concurrent programs and projects, including Tier 1 initiatives; and provides a single, trusted view of portfolio health, value, risk, dependencies and decisions to senior executives. 

 The role leads a significant, high-complexity, multi-year portfolio with substantial regulatory and risk oversight; manages aggregate portfolio financials, including budget, forecast, actuals and variances, and benefits realization; operates portfolio governance and controls; and leads senior program and project management talent. The current portfolio scale is approximately $235 million for 2026, with a similar level anticipated for 2027, subject to annual planning and approval. 

 ·       VCP technology portfolio across Transaction Banking digital channels, client connectivity and servicing capabilities; modern ledger and ledger integration; and wholesale payments platforms and rails.
 ·       Multiple concurrent, interdependent transformation programs and technology initiatives, including high-complexity and Tier 1 work, with material enterprise dependencies.
 ·       Accountability for integrated portfolio planning, prioritization, financial management, delivery governance, risk and control oversight, benefits realization, executive reporting and talent leadership.
 ·       Portfolio headcount, vendor spend, geographic mandate and committee memberships are to be confirmed through role evaluation and annual planning; the 2026 technology portfolio budget is approximately $235 million, with a similar scale anticipated for 2027.

 1. Portfolio strategy and prioritization
 ·       Define and maintain the integrated Transaction Banking technology strategy, investment thesis and multi-year roadmap across digital channels, ledger and payments, translating business strategy into executable technology priorities in partnership with Product, Operations and Architecture.
 ·       Translate business priorities, architecture visions, regulatory obligations and platform health needs into a sequenced portfolio with clear outcomes, dependencies and funding requirements.
 ·       Recommend portfolio investment, sequencing, capacity and scope trade-offs; stop, defer or redirect work where value, readiness, risk or strategic alignment is insufficient.
 ·       Ensure the portfolio balances transformation, modernization, resilience, regulatory and mandatory commitments, and sustainable run-state outcomes.

 2. Integrated delivery and dependency management
 ·       Oversee end-to-end delivery performance across all in-scope, multi-year programs and projects and multiple agile teams, with accountability for coherent execution against approved scope, milestones, budget, quality and benefits.
 ·       Own the integrated portfolio plan, critical path and cross-domain dependency view, resolving conflicts across channels, ledger, payments and shared enterprise platforms.
 ·       Establish clear intervention and escalation mechanisms; identify emerging slippage early and drive timely corrective action and executive decisions.
 ·       Ensure disciplined transition from design and build through testing, implementation, stabilization and hand-off to accountable run-state owners.

 3. Financial, capacity and benefits management
 ·       Own aggregate portfolio financial management, including annual planning, forecasts, actuals, variances, vendor commitments and investment transparency.
 ·       Align funding and capacity to the highest-value and highest-obligation priorities, while maintaining traceability from investment to deliverables, outcomes and benefits.
 ·       Establish benefits baselines and oversee realization of client, financial, operational, resilience and risk outcomes; address benefit leakage and underperformance.
 ·       Optimize the deployment of senior program, project and specialized resources across the portfolio.

 4. Governance, risk and control
 ·       Operate portfolio governance as a decision system, with clear accountabilities, decision rights, escalation thresholds, KPIs, executive reporting and disciplined follow-through.
 ·       Maintain an integrated view of delivery, technology, operational, cyber, data, regulatory, third-party and change risks, including assumptions and dependencies.
 ·       Ensure risk and control requirements are embedded from design through implementation and that portfolio evidence supports audit, regulatory and governance expectations.
 ·       Provide strategic guidance to business and functional leaders on material portfolio issues and ensure concerns are managed within enterprise risk appetite.

 5. Executive leadership and talent
 ·       Provide a single, credible executive narrative on portfolio status, value, financials, risks, dependencies and decisions required.
 ·       Lead and develop senior program managers, project managers and portfolio specialists; build succession, capability and disciplined performance management across the function.
 ·       Create a culture of accountability, transparency, constructive challenge, inclusion and continuous improvement.
 ·       Act as the senior portfolio management advisor to Transaction Banking Product, Technology, Operations, Architecture, Finance, Risk and Compliance leaders.

 Skills, Education & Experience:

 ·       15+ years of progressive experience in financial-services technology, portfolio, program or transformation leadership, including significant executive-level accountability in a complex regulated institution.
 ·       Demonstrated success overseeing a significant portfolio of multiple concurrent, high-complexity programs and projects, including Tier 1 initiatives and substantial technology investment.
 ·       Deep knowledge of Transaction Banking technology domains, including corporate digital channels and connectivity, payments and cash-management infrastructure, liquidity solutions, ledger or core-banking integration, APIs, data, cloud platforms and platform modernization.
 ·       Proven experience with portfolio financial management, integrated planning, benefits realization, vendor oversight, delivery governance and executive reporting.
 ·       Experience leading senior program and project management teams and influencing large matrixed delivery organizations across business, technology and control functions.
 ·       Demonstrated delivery in environments with material regulatory, cyber, operational resilience, data and third-party risk requirements.
 Leadership and technical skills
 ·       Enterprise portfolio strategy, prioritization and investment governance.
 ·       Executive judgment, commercial acumen and value-based decision making.
 ·       Integrated roadmap, dependency, critical-path and risk management.
 ·       Technology fluency across architecture, engineering, cloud, APIs, data, cybersecurity, resilience and platform operating models.
 ·       Outstanding executive communication, board-level storytelling and ability to present a concise, evidence-based view of decisions and trade-offs.
 ·       Strong stakeholder influence, conflict resolution and ability to lead through ambiguity without relying solely on direct authority.
 ·       People leadership, talent development, succession planning and creation of high-performing, inclusive teams.
 Education and credentials
 ·       Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Finance or a related discipline.
 ·       MBA, advanced technical degree or equivalent executive experience preferred.
 - Portfolio, program, project, Agile, Lean or technology governance certifications are assets, such as PfMP, PgMP, PMP, SAFe or equivalent.

 TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple.  Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. Job Description:

Role Summary

The Director, Domain Enterprise Architect (Artificial Intelligence - AI) is accountable for the enterprise AI architecture domain, ensuring all AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine intelligence, and intelligent automation investments across global operations align to a coherent strategic vision.

This leader establishes the enterprise AI domain strategy, target-state architecture, standards, roadmaps, governance frameworks, reference architectures, and investment priorities required to scale AI responsibly across the organization.

The Director functions as the senior architecture authority for AI, partnering closely with business executives, enterprise architects, platform leaders, risk functions, and technology teams to ensure AI investments are coordinated, reusable, governed, and strategically aligned.

This role balances long-term strategic planning with strong execution leadership, ensuring the enterprise AI roadmap translates into measurable business outcomes while maintaining regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and architectural consistency.

What will you do?

Enterprise AI Domain Strategy

Define and maintain the enterprise AI architecture strategy.
Establish target-state AI domain architecture and multi-year roadmaps.
Create AI reference models, standards, principles, policies, and guardrails.
Ensure AI strategy aligns with enterprise business strategy, technology strategy, and operating model.

Enterprise Investment Alignment

Establish visibility into AI investments across global business units.
Identify duplication, fragmentation, risk, and technology overlap.
Drive enterprise-wide reuse and strategic consolidation of AI capabilities.
Guide investment decisions toward scalable enterprise platforms and services.

Domain Governance & Standards

Own enterprise AI standards, approved technologies, architecture patterns, and reference architectures.

At FSRA, our vision is to ensure financial safety, fairness, and choice for Ontarians. As a financial services regulator, we’re passionate about protecting consumers. Our principles-based approach means we can quickly and effectively respond to the changing needs of consumers and the industry.

Our team combines industry expertise with commitment to public service. We attract individuals who are interested in meaningful work and who measure success through outcomes, not inputs.

At FSRA, we invest in the personal and professional growth of our team. Job Description:

$149,00-$199,00 (hiring range and will be determined based on the successful candidate's qualifications, skills, and relevant experience)

PURPOSE OF POSITION

To provide strategic leadership, business ownership, and program direction for FSRA’s Property & Casualty Auto Transformation Program, a multi-year initiative to modernize auto insurance regulation through the implementation of a new supervisory technology platform and future-state operating model.

The position leads the design, implementation, change management, benefits realization, and operational transition required to enable FSRA’s future Auto Insurance Supervisory Model, including insurer accreditation, risk-based supervision, advanced analytics, streamlined regulatory processes, and enhanced market oversight. Working collaboratively with internal business areas, technology partners, system integrators, insurers, and other stakeholders, the position supports FSRA’s broader modernization agenda by advancing innovative, data-driven, automated, and sustainable supervisory approaches that strengthen regulatory effectiveness and improve consumer outcomes in Ontario.

Key Responsibilities

Auto Transformation Program Leadership

Lead the delivery of FSRA's Auto Transformation Program, ensuring successful implementation of the new supervisory technology platform, associated business processes, and future-state operating model.
Establish and maintain program governance, executive reporting, performance measures, and oversight mechanisms to support successful delivery.
Manage program scope, budget, timelines, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements while ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and approved business outcomes.
Lead implementation planning, readiness assessments, operational transition activities, and post-implementation stabilization.
Provide strategic advice and recommendations to senior leadership on program direction, delivery risks, and transformation opportunities.

Supervisory Modernization and Business Transformation

Lead the design of the future-state supervisory operating model supporting risk-based regulation and insurer accreditation.
Work across supervision, actuarial, policy, legal, operations, and technology teams to redesign business processes and improve regulatory effectiveness.
Ensure the transformation supports enhanced supervisory capabilities, proactive oversight, market intelligence, and consumer outcome monitoring.
Drive process simplification, automation, standardization, and continuous improvement across regulatory operations.

Technology Enablement and Innovation

Partner with Information Technology, vendors, and system integrators to ensure business requirements are effectively translated into technology solutions.
Champion the use of automation, artificial intelligence, workflow technologies, and advanced analytics to improve supervisory effectiveness and efficiency.
Guide development of capabilities including risk-based filing triage and decisioning, regulatory workflow and case management, supervisory analytics and market intelligence, AI-assisted supervision, digital insurer experience and self-service functionality and enterprise reporting and regulatory intelligence capabilities.

Stakeholder Engagement and Change Leadership

Serve as the primary business lead for stakeholder engagement related to the transformation program.
Build and maintain strong relationships with insurers, industry associations, technology partners, and other stakeholders.
Lead organizational change management, communications, training, and adoption activities required to support successful implementation.
Represent FSRA at industry forums, conferences, working groups, and stakeholder engagements related to regulatory modernization and supervisory transformation.

Benefits Realization And Business Performance

Monitor achievement of expected outcomes, including reduced filing review cycle times, increased supervisory capacity, improved stakeholder experience, enhanced regulatory intelligence, greater operational efficiency and improved market oversight capabilities.
Establish and maintain a comprehensive governance and performance management framework, including KPI tracking, outcome measurement, benefits realization, and executive reporting, to ensure delivery of strategic objectives and sustainable transformation outcomes

Leadership and People Management

Lead and develop a team responsible for transformation delivery, business modernization, and strategic initiatives.
Foster collaboration across supervision, actuarial, policy, legal, operations, data, and technology teams.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of FSRA's Auto Insurance Supervisory Model and broader regulatory modernization efforts.
Champion innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and evidence-based decision-making.

Education

University degree in business, public administration, technology, finance, insurance, economics, engineering, or a related field or an equivalent combination or education and experience
Master's degree, project management designation, or relevant professional designation considered an asset.

Experience

10+ years of progressive leadership experience within the property and casualty insurance sector, financial services, regulatory environment, or a similarly complex operating environment.
Demonstrated experience leading major business and technology transformation initiatives
Experience leading complex organizational change and business transformation initiatives impacting both internal and external stakeholders.
Experience leveraging technology, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to improve business outcomes.

Knowledge And Skills

Executive-level experience serving as a senior business lead, program owner, or transformation sponsor for complex, enterprise-scale technology implementations.
Proven ability to engage effectively with executive leadership, external vendors, industry stakeholders, and governance bodies to advance strategic priorities and delivery outcomes.
Advanced understanding of the property and casualty insurance sector, including regulatory environments, market dynamics, emerging risks, and industry trends.
Deep knowledge of digital transformation, operating model design, business process modernization, technology-enabled service delivery, and implementation best practices.
Strong understanding of supervisory frameworks, risk-based regulation, governance models, accountability structures, and performance measurement disciplines.
Exceptional strategic judgement, enterprise program leadership, decision-making, and stakeholder relationship management capabilities.
Highly effective communication, executive briefing, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build alignment across diverse audiences.

Director, Measurement & Analytics

About Flywheel

Flywheel’s suite of digital commerce solutions accelerate growth across all major digital marketplaces for the world’s leading brands. We give clients access to near real-time performance measurement and improve sales, share, and profit. With teams across the Americas, Europe and APAC, we offer a career with real impact, endless growth opportunities and the support you need to be the best you can be.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a director to support and contribute to our Measurement & Analytics (M&A) team. Reporting to the Senior Director of the M&A consulting practice within Flywheel’s Commerce Intelligence team, you will play a key role in providing internal and external teams with campaign tracking solutions, reporting, and insights that transforms data into actionable business strategies.
