jobs.description:
**Chief Solution Architect (Pre\-sales, AI \+ Data Transformation)**
====================================================================

**Reporting to:** Managing Director, AMER


As Google Cloud's premier partner in AI and Data Transformation, we provide world\-class businesses with the strategic consulting and technical execution required for cutting\-edge data solutions in the cloud. We partner with clients to push the limits of leading technology by combining our expertise in machine learning, data engineering, and analytics. With Google Cloud Platform as our foundation, we help businesses future\-proof their solutions, deepen their understanding of consumers, increase competitive advantage, and unlock massive operational efficiencies through data transformation programs.

**The Role**


Datatonic is seeking a Chief Solution Architect as the first hire in our new pre\-sales function to help shape, qualify, and win our most strategic data, AI, and Agentic transformations. This role sits at the intersection of **data \& AI consulting, technical advisory, and industry storytelling**. You will partner with the Account Manager and technical/engineering leadership to grow our most strategic accounts across Telecommunications, FSI, Media, and Agencies.


You will help take our clients along a transformative journey in their thinking about what is possible with data and AI. This will result in large\-scale engagements with direct links to the C\-suite. You will run early discovery, define solutions, shape SOWs, and represent Datatonic’s offerings in the market.


You do not need to manage people, but you must be exceptional with **technical and business stakeholders**, able to build trust quickly, and comfortable presenting at C\-suite and architect levels.

**What You’ll Do**

### **Pre\-Sales Leadership**

* Lead early discovery alongside Sales: understand business pain points, qualify opportunities, and translate ambiguity into structured technical narratives.
* Take an insight\-led approach to bring industry best practices in data and AI to shape and guide clients’ strategic transformations
* Architect data, ML, and GenAI solutions on Google Cloud.
* Own scoping, estimation, and writing of Statements of Work and RFP responses in collaboration with Sales and Delivery.
* Support RFP responses, solution reviews, and deal strategy for opportunities and accounts $1m\+.

### **Strategic Advisory**

* Facilitate client workshops on AI strategy, platform modernization, and GenAI readiness, with a lens toward bringing our clients along on a transformative journey in their approach to data and AI.
* Build POVs and architecture options that balance business value, feasibility, and cost.
* Act as a trusted advisor for our clients across data platforms, MLOps, Generative and Agentic AI, and application design.

### **Thought Leadership, GTM \& Vertical Expertise**

* Represent Datatonic on site at client, at events, conferences, partner sessions, and executive dinners
* Work with our GTM team to create industry\-relevant content (decks, briefs, POVs) tailored for **Telecommunications, FSI, Media, and Agencies** and help shape our offering by surfacing patterns, reusable architectures, and packaged solutions.
* Work with the Office of the CTO and our Architecture delivery team to establish standards, handbooks, and technical best practices for data and agentic deployments.
* Enable Sales and Delivery teams on industry trends, discovery patterns, and Datatonic accelerators.

**What You Bring**

* 7–12 years of experience in data, analytics, ML, or cloud engineering/architecture, including in large scale digital/data/AI transformations, with at least 3 years in a pre\-sales or client\-facing advisory role.
* Strong knowledge of cloud\-based architectures (including infrastructure, data architecture, governance), application design, and Generative and Agentic AI concepts and deployments.
* Hands\-on depth in **GCP is ideal**, but strong AWS/Azure SAs with a proven ability to cross\-skill to GCP quickly will be considered.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to simplify complex technical ideas for business leaders.
* A consultative sales approach with experience shaping deals over **$1M**.
* Comfortable presenting to C\-suite, negotiating trade\-offs, and influencing stakeholders.
* Ideally, a track record in at least one of our verticals: **Telecommunications, FSI, Media, and Agencies**

**What Success Looks Like (first 12 months)**

* Consistently shaping and winning large scale data and AI transformations for our biggest clients.
* Recognized by Sales as the go\-to technical partner for complex pursuits.
* Recognized by Delivery for the accuracy of SOW scoping and technical leadership when needed.
* Trusted by strategic accounts as a value\-driven advisor.
* Strong contribution as a thought leader to vertical narratives, events, and Datatonic’s GTM.

Job Description 

 What is the Opportunity? 
 As part of the Group Risk Management team, the Associate Director, Global Risk Analytics is responsible for the conceptual design, development, and ongoing maintenance of the mathematical models used for the measurement and capitalization of the market risk of RBC's trading portfolio.

 This includes ensuring that the model's underlying methodologies are appropriate and that they are implemented with integrity, to facilitate the effective management of the bank's market risk and capital adequacy assessment for CCAR scenarios under the FRTB framework. 

 What will you do? 
 Work with model users to understand their business requirements.
 Conduct research, review regulatory requirements and consult with industry stakeholders to evaluate best practices for modeling.
 Make recommendations on model methodologies, and develop technical implementation, either for production usage or to serve as a prototype for benchmark testing.
 Provide business requirements with technical implementation details and user acceptance criteria to technology teams for production deployment, and validate implementation using independently developed benchmark models.
 Document model methodologies, implementation details and testing results, and work with internal validation to facilitate their approval of the models.
 Develop tools to assess and monitor model performance, including assumptions and limitations, on an ongoing basis for reporting to the various model monitoring governance committees.
 Investigate and remediate modeling issues identified through ongoing monitoring or by internal validation.
 Re-assessment and testing of models, including assumptions and limitations and benchmarking against alternative models, and documentation of the results in models whitepapers and annual assessments for review by internal validation.

 Must Have: 
 Broad knowledge of traded products across various asset classes, and knowledge of regulatory & internal risk management requirements for market risk and CCAR

 Ability to work collaboratively to achieve team goals

 Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, especially in the explanation of complex modeling concepts to senior management and regulators

 Masters in Financial Engineering, or a degree in another quantitative subject such as physics, statistics, mathematics or mathematical finance and/or a relevant professional qualification, with concentration in quantitative methods and/or finance.
 Experience in FRTB is considered a strong asset

If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

Our headquarters and most of our team are based in Ottawa. For employees located in Ottawa,

this role follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of approximately four days per week

in the office at our headquarters. We also welcome remote candidates from anywhere in

Canada.

About The Role

The Vice President, Financial Accounting & Reporting is a senior accounting and controllership executive for a global public company. Working in close partnership with the CFO, the VP, Financial Accounting & Reporting ensures the integrity, discipline, and operational effectiveness of the company’s financial management framework across accounting, financial reporting, internal controls, audit oversight, compliance, and revenue accounting globally.

The role serves as a trusted advisor to the CFO and Audit Committee on financial governance, controllership, regulatory readiness, and enterprise risk management related to financial operations and reporting

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy

What you will do

Lead the day-to-day operating rhythm of the accounting, external reporting, and internal control functions, with accountability for efficient and accurate close processes, disciplined financial administration, and effective oversight of core accounting operations and global compliance.
Ensure timely, accurate, and decision-useful financial reporting, including external reporting obligations such as OSC and SEC filings and public disclosures, in compliance with IFRS/US GAAP, internal policies, and public-company requirements.
Oversee audit readiness, external audit coordination, control certification support, Canada NI 52-109 requirements, U.S. Sarbanes-Oxley readiness, and the operational processes required to maintain a strong compliance posture across jurisdictions.
Partner with risk management and internal audit.
Support the CFO in Audit Committee matters and serve as a senior operational counterpart on financial governance, controls, and compliance topics.
Ensure accounting processes scale effectively as the business grows in complexity across geographies, products, commercial models, and regulatory obligations.
Grow high-performing teams and create an environment that supports collaboration, operational excellence, and modern enterprise thinking.

What we are looking for

15 years of progressive financial leadership experience.
Significant experience with public-company reporting, external audit, internal controls,

regulatory compliance, and Audit Committee support.

TSX experience is required; NASDAQ and NYSE experience is highly desirable.
Deep knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, SOX, and internal control frameworks is highly

desirable, including direct experience owning SOX/ICFR programs.

Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

* Partner with Audit leadership, technology teams, and other stakeholders to design and implement scalable technology solutions.

What you bring to this role:
* Education: University degree in technology, computer science, engineering, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Experience: Senior leadership experience delivering large\-scale technology transformation within a complex professional or enterprise environment.

* Delivery: Demonstrated experience leading technology initiatives from strategy and planning through implementation and adoption, including governance and stakeholder management.
* Leadership: Proven ability to lead and develop teams and collaborate effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders in a complex organization

 **KPMG Ontario Region Pay Range Information**
The expected base salary range for this position is $117,000 \- $196,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. **Integrity**, we do what is right \| **Excellence**, we never stop learning and improving \| **Courage**, we think and act boldly \| **Together**, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences \| **For Better**, we do what matters

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 277846
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  

**Director \& Head, Global Capital Markets (GCM) Product, GCM Transformation – Toronto, ON**

  

**Global Banking and Markets**

Global Banking and Markets (GBM) conducts the Bank’s wholesale banking and capital markets business with corporate, government and institutional investor clients. GBM is a full\-service wholesale bank and investment dealer in Canada and Mexico and offers a range of products and services in the U.S., Latin America and in select markets in Europe and Asia\-Pacific.

  

More specifically, GBM provides clients with: corporate lending; transaction banking (including payments, trade finance and cash management); investment banking (including corporate finance and mergers \& acquisitions); fixed income and equity underwriting, sales, trading and research; prime services (prime brokerage and stock lending); foreign exchange sales and trading; commodity derivatives; and collateral management.

  

**Purpose**


The Director \& Head, GCM Product, contributes to defining and executing the product vision, roadmap and delivery strategy for one or more Global Capital Markets (GCM) investment journeys. The role is responsible for aligning business strategy, investment priorities and engineering capacity to deliver measurable business outcomes across trading, sales, financing, structured products, commodities, FX, equities and supporting platforms. The Director partners closely with Front Office, Operations, Technology, Risk, Finance and Data teams to drive product discovery, prioritization, delivery and value realization while modernizing platforms, automating workflows, improving controls and enhancing client and employee experiences. The role acts as the primary product leader for their investment journey, ensuring clear ownership from strategy through execution and adoption.

  

**What You'll Do**


* Contributes to defining and maintaining the product vision, strategy and multi\-year roadmap for assigned Capital Markets investment journeys, ensuring alignment to GBM strategic priorities, revenue objectives, risk management requirements and technology modernization goals


* Owns product backlog prioritization and investment sequencing by balancing business value, client impact, regulatory requirements, operational efficiency, technology dependencies, capacity constraints and benefits realization


* Acts as business product lead and subject matter expert for assigned Capital Markets platforms and workflows across front, middle and back\-office functions


* Partners with Desk Heads, Business Leads, Technology, Operations, Risk, Finance and Architecture teams to translate strategic objectives into product roadmaps, requirements, business capabilities and delivery priorities


* Leads discovery, business case development and prioritization activities to establish a transparent, value\-based investment backlog aligned to business outcomes and strategic objectives


* Drives modernization of trading, financing, risk, operations and client\-facing platforms through automation, workflow optimization, data integration and process simplification


* Partners with agile delivery teams establish sprint priorities, manage dependencies, remove delivery impediments and ensure successful execution against committed outcomes


* Establishes and monitors product performance metrics, including revenue enablement, client adoption, operational efficiency, risk reduction, platform stability, delivery predictability and business value realization


* Supports governance forums including portfolio planning, backlog refinement, prioritization reviews and executive reporting to provide transparency across demand, capacity, delivery and outcomes


* Maintains strong knowledge of Capital Markets products including FX, Fixed Income, Commodities, Equities, Financing, Structured Finance and post\-trade processes, while evaluating emerging technologies and market trends to enhance business capabilities

  

**What You'll Bring**


* Undergraduate degree in Business, Finance, Technology, Engineering or related field. MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred


* 10\+ years of leadership experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Sales \& Trading, Product Management, Technology or Transformation


* Deep understanding of one or more Capital Markets domains including Fixed Income, FX, Commodities, Equities, Financing, Prime Services, Structured Finance or Trade Lifecycle Management


* Proven experience leading large\-scale platform modernization, digital transformation and operating model initiatives


* Strong knowledge of Agile product management, backlog prioritization and outcome\-based delivery methodologies


* Experience managing complex stakeholder groups including Front Office, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Finance

  

**Work Arrangement:**

This position is an onsite role, with the expectation that you will work 5 days a week in the office. Please note that this is subject to change based on the needs of the business.


\#LI\-Onsite \#GBM

  

**Interested?**

At Scotiabank, you’ll be joining an organization that values inclusion, accountability, innovative thinking and collaboration, a culture where people feel safe to learn, grow, and contribute while delivering exceptional results for our clients. We believe in winning together, as one team, strengthening the collaborative spirit that defines GBM’s client partnerships. We value transparency, shared goals, and purposeful work.

  

**What's in it for you?**

Scotiabank wants you to be able to bring your best self to work – and life, every day. With a focus on holistic well\-being, our many flexible benefit programs are designed to help support your unique family, financial, physical, mental, and social health needs.

From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About The Team & Business Line

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

A challenging and exciting role in a rapidly growing industry, Portfolio Analytics services across a diverse client base spanning hedge funds, private markets and multi-asset strategies across North America, the United Kingdom, Continental Europe and Asia. The Vice President of the Portfolio Analytics group will take a senior leadership role managing existing US client relationships, ensuring client retention, and driving sales, marketing and business development initiatives across the region. The team provides ad-hoc and regulatory risk reports that include, but are not limited to, exposure and P&L reports, limits monitoring, scenario analysis, stress testing, value-at-risk and fund performance analytics - supporting clients across a broad range of strategies and structures.

The role provides a unique opportunity to work closely with a wide range of securities, derivatives and structured products in many currencies traded across global markets, and to lead the build-out of a structured, high-performing client service model across the US book. The individual's duties will include, but are not limited to, client onboarding project management, senior client relationship leadership, team management, and the training and development of staff — mirroring and helping to embed a proven operating model already established elsewhere in the group.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Business Development & Commercial Acumen — Take an active, leading role in the CFS 'new business acquisition' process from a Portfolio Analytics perspective, effectively demonstrating our suite of Portfolio Analytics services to potential clients as well as new or enhanced services to existing clients, positioning this as a core driver of the role; evaluate the viability of current and new business proposals with emphasis on tactical issues and barriers
Client Relationship Management — Own and lead senior client relationships across the US book, participating in regular client calls and working closely with the global Client Integration team who oversee and project manage the firm-wide onboarding process
Reporting of Client KPIs — Own and maintain the KPI and RAG framework across the US client base, supervising junior team members in day-to-day tracking and reporting to support senior management oversight
Team Leadership & Management — Provide day-to-day leadership and management of the US Portfolio Analytics team, embedding a structured, KPI-driven client service model and ensuring consistent standards of client oversight and RAG reporting across the book
Communication — Use appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance and help others understand the importance of the vision on the day-to-day reality of the risk reporting process
Building Networks - Proactively build strong relationships with Client Service and Business Development colleagues across CFS offices as a first priority, while also networking across departments (Valuation/Profit & Loss, Operations, Internal Audit, Integration, etc.) to establish collaborative business relationships at all levels and facilitate the accomplishment of business objectives
Leading & Managing Others — Embody the CFS culture, lead and inspire team through change, encourage others to seek opportunities for different approaches to address problems and opportunities
Organization & Resource Management — Oversee the US team with responsibility for pre-sales, onboarding, client coverage planning, and other new business initiatives
Building and Retaining Organizational Talent —Focus on identifying, developing, deploying and retaining key talent within the US team (including succession planning) for the future success of CFS, initiating strategies to develop internal talent through ongoing training and conducting timely performance evaluations.
Operational Decision-making — Commit and take responsibility for tactical decisions, adopting innovative approaches to move resolution of challenges to completion; communicate outcomes to all stakeholders and contribute to CFS vision and strategy
Execution — Execute business strategy by aligning communication, accountabilities, skills, internal processes and measurement to ensure sustainable and profitable results
Client Risk & Continuity Oversight — Identify and manage clients with elevated customisation and key person risk, ensuring documented continuity plans are in place and escalating concentration risk where appropriate

Qualifications

About You:

Drive for Results — Possessing an energetic and tenacious achievement orientation; proactively seeking opportunities to drive performance of self and team, and setting stretching goals; managing personal and group strengths and opportunities
Navigating Complexity — Proactively and quickly making sense of complex issues where ambiguity exists; communicating complicated information concisely and logically
Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with proven ability to summarise and interpret client requirements
Aspiration to become a subject matter expert in proprietary risk solutions
Someone who enjoys project-based work, collaboration across teams, and dealing directly with clients — no two days the same
Quantitative background with a Bachelor's/higher level degree or professional qualification (MSc, PhD, CQF, FRM, PRMIA, GARP, CFA, FIA)
Proficient in Excel, VBA, SQL, with Python experience in particular advantageous
Knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Qlik Sense (or Tableau) and Jaspersoft is a plus
7–10 years' experience in investment and regulatory risk reporting and performance analytics in funds/asset management/banking/insurance - including hedge fund, private markets and multi-asset strategies , with demonstrated experience in client relationship leadership, team management, pre-sales, onboarding and business development
Prior experience managing or supervising a client-facing team is required
Knowledge of market, credit, liquidity and counterparty risk measurement and management under regulatory frameworks such as Form PF, Form CPO-PQR, Annex IV, Basel III/CRD IV/CRR and Solvency II is advantageous
Candidates must be willing to travel to the United States for business purposes

Salary Range:
$115,000 - 155,000

This position is for an existing vacancy

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise AI Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE 
 Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Director, Enterprise AI Strategy & Transformation leads the development and execution of the organization’s enterprise AI strategy and transformation agenda to drive measurable business value, productivity, operational efficiency, innovation, and informed decision-making. The role serves as the organization’s AI subject matter expert and enterprise coordinating point, providing strategic guidance on AI opportunities, investments, governance, risk, technology, adoption, and value realization. 

 The Director partners with business and functional leaders to identify, prioritize, and implement AI and intelligent automation opportunities aligned with organizational objectives and financial goals. The role initially focuses on leveraging AI to enhance financial and operational performance, including forecasting, reporting, analysis, productivity, workflow efficiency, cost management, and decision-making, with successful capabilities and practices progressively expanded across other functions. The Director oversees the enterprise AI portfolio and lifecycle from opportunity assessment and business case development through solution selection, implementation, adoption, benefits realization, ongoing monitoring, and retirement. 

 KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
 AI Strategy, Portfolio & Value Management Develop and maintain the enterprise AI strategy, operating model, portfolio, and roadmap aligned with corporate objectives and financial goals. 
 Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI opportunities based on strategic alignment, business value, cost, complexity, data readiness, risk, and organizational readiness. 
 Develop business cases, investment recommendations, and implementation roadmaps, including build, buy, configure, or partner options. 
 Establish performance measures, baseline metrics, and value-realization frameworks to track AI adoption, ROI, productivity, cost savings, revenue impact, and other business outcomes. 
 Provide executive leadership with visibility into AI investments, performance, realized benefits, opportunities, and risks. 
 AI Solution Development & Implementation Lead the evaluation, design, development, and deployment of AI solutions across enterprise productivity, function-specific applications, intelligent automation, advanced AI, and emerging agentic capabilities. 
 Partner with business units and end users to identify opportunities, develop practical AI-enabled solutions, and improve processes and ways of working. 
 Oversee AI pilots, proofs of concept, and enterprise implementations through the full lifecycle—from opportunity identification and feasibility through deployment, adoption, benefits realization, monitoring, and retirement. 
 Coordinate with Cybersecurity, Human Resources and other stakeholders to ensure solutions are appropriately designed, implemented, adopted, and measured. 
 Assess solution performance and recommend whether initiatives should be scaled, enhanced, consolidated, paused, or retired based on business value, adoption, cost, and risk. 
 AI Governance, Risk & Responsible Adoption Establish and maintain enterprise AI governance frameworks, policies, standards, controls, and risk-based processes to support responsible AI adoption. 
 Ensure AI initiatives are appropriately assessed for cybersecurity, privacy, data, intellectual property, legal, ethical, third-party, model, and business continuity risks. 
 Maintain an enterprise inventory of approved AI technologies, platforms, models, agents, and material use cases, with appropriate review, approval, testing, human oversight, monitoring, and escalation requirements. 
 Ensure data quality, classification, access, security, information governance, and regulatory requirements are addressed before AI solutions are deployed. 
 Monitor the evolving AI landscape, regulatory expectations, and associated risks, and update governance practices as required. 
 Enterprise AI Adoption & Change Management Lead enterprise AI literacy, adoption, and change-management initiatives across executives, leaders, employees, technical teams, and advanced AI users. 
 Develop and deliver role- and function-specific training, guidance, and resources to promote effective and responsible use of AI. 
 Serve as the enterprise resource for AI strategy, best practices, use-case guidance, and adoption support. 
 Measure AI utilization, adoption, training effectiveness, employee feedback, and business outcomes to continuously improve AI enablement. 
 Coordinate internal subject matter experts, technology teams, business stakeholders, and external partners to support successful AI adoption 
 Vendor, Technology & Partner Management Evaluate AI technologies, vendors, consultants, platforms, and implementation partners against business requirements, value, security, architecture, scalability, risk, and total cost of ownership. 
 Manage AI technology and vendor relationships to ensure service quality, effective implementation, and value realization. 
 Maintain oversight of the enterprise AI technology portfolio to identify duplicate capabilities, unnecessary licensing, overlapping solutions, and opportunities for consolidation. 
 Monitor emerging AI technologies—including generative AI, large language models, predictive AI, intelligent automation, computer vision, and agentic AI—and assess their practical business applicability and potential value. 
 QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS 
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred. 
 Minimum seven (7) years of progressive experience in AI, data analytics, digital transformation, automation, technology, or related fields, including significant experience leading enterprise AI or generative AI adoption. 
 Proven experience leading complex, enterprise-wide AI or business transformation initiatives from strategy and business case development through implementation, adoption, scaling, and measurable value realization. 
 Strong business and financial acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, reporting, business case development, technology investment evaluation, performance measurement, and ROI. 
 Strong knowledge of AI technologies, including generative AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, large language models, AI agents, and emerging AI capabilities, with an understanding of data, cybersecurity, privacy, and AI governance. 
 Strong strategic thinking, analytical, communication, stakeholder management, project management, and change management skills, with the ability to translate complex technology into practical business solutions and influence cross-functional decisions.  
 Strong technical and business judgment to evaluate AI solutions, vendors, risks, data and technology dependencies, and investment decisions. Professional certifications in AI, analytics, project management, responsible AI, or AI governance are considered an asset. 

 PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS Standard office setting - hybrid arrangement (4 days in-office) 
 Fast paced office environment 
 Travel expectations between facilities in Mississauga and North York

Job Description:

Chief Technology Officer

Position Summary

ICS is an established B2B retail software provider at a pivotal moment. The company is investing strategically in technology to fuel growth, improve customer experience, and optimize operations — and that investment requires modernizing a mature, business-critical platform. We are looking for a transformational Chief Technology Officer to own that mandate.

Reporting directly to the President, the CTO will own the engineering vision and strategy, shape the target architecture and modernization path, and lead the continued cultural transformation to AI-driven development (AI-DLC) across the organization. This is a hands-on, player-coach executive role: the CTO sets direction and leads through managers and team leads while remaining close enough to architecture, cloud, security, product, and delivery decisions to challenge assumptions and intervene when required. The primary mandate is to modernize the legacy platform and the engineering organization around it, while protecting business continuity, customer confidence, and future scalability.

The ideal candidate is a balanced transformation leader who combines executive judgment, product orientation, technical credibility, and disciplined execution — someone who raises standards and makes difficult trade-offs while building trust, developing leaders, and guiding the organization through change with clarity, even under uncertainty.

Key Responsibilities

Own technology strategy, software engineering, architecture, infrastructure, DevOps, and delivery across the organization.

Embed AI tooling into the development process (AI-DLC) — automated testing, smarter code review, faster iteration cycles — and make AI-assisted development standard practice across engineering.
Own cybersecurity, IT general controls, compliance, business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology risk governance for a platform serving both trade customers and end consumers.
Reduce tribal knowledge by getting institutional knowledge out of people’s heads and into documentation and runbooks, making the platform easier to maintain, improve, and ramp new engineers into.
Lead, develop, and retain a distributed 14-person engineering organization spanning internal, offshore, and external partner resources, setting clear expectations and building a team that ships consistently and owns its work.
Evaluate and prioritize commercially viable customer-facing AI capabilities on their commercial merit, separate from internal AI-DLC tooling adoption.
Maintain selective involvement in strategic customers, major escalations, product advisory discussions, and technically complex opportunities.
Provide periodic Board and executive exposure on modernization, technology investment, strategy, cybersecurity, and risk.

AI and Operating Expectations

ICS is actively investing in AI across operations, product development, and go-to-market execution. The CTO is expected to make AI-driven development the organization’s standard operating model, not an experiment.

Make AI-assisted development a standard practice across the engineering organization, embedding AI tooling into automated testing, code review, and iteration cycles.
Establish the organization’s AI-DLC maturity baseline and a validated target and timeline, and lead the mindset shift required to get there.
Separately assess and prioritize customer-facing AI opportunities on commercial merit, distinct from internal AI-DLC tooling adoption.
Model disciplined AI-enabled decision-making for the engineering organization, verifying outputs and exercising sound judgment with technical and customer data.
Champion new workflows and process improvements that support ICS’s broader AI-enabled operating model and raise team effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

Prior Chief Technology Officer, VP of Engineering, or equivalent executive accountability for a software organization.
15+ years of progressive technology experience, including 10+ years leading software development teams.
Hands-on experience modernizing legacy systems, not theoretical — including demonstrated leadership of a POS or eCommerce platform modernization and/or a migration off legacy platforms.
Track record building or deploying CI/CD pipelines, observability systems, and automation in resource-constrained environments that demanded ruthless prioritization and speed.
Experience leading distributed teams across internal, offshore, and external partner resources.
Executive oversight of cybersecurity, technology risk, operational resilience, and business continuity.
Technical depth paired with business fluency: able to connect engineering decisions to business outcomes and hold credible conversations with the President about what the work means for the business.

Preferred Qualifications

Retail technology, point-of-sale, eCommerce, or payments experience.
Beverage-alcohol, grocery, or specialty retail industry experience.
Cloud modernization leadership on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud transformation experience.
Adjacent experience in vertical SaaS, fintech, ERP, or other high-availability transaction environments.

What Success Looks Like

Completes a technology, product, and delivery assessment within the first 60 days, establishing baselines and aligning leadership on modernization priorities and decision criteria.
Delivers an agreed target architecture and a funded modernization roadmap by 120 days, with CI/CD and observability infrastructure deployed and the team shipping on a predictable weekly cadence.
Makes AI-assisted development standard practice, with tooling integrated and adopted by the engineering team within the first 120 days.
Reduces tribal knowledge through platform documentation, runbooks, and cross-training, while keeping the technical roadmap locked, communicated, and on track.
Shows measurable modernization progress, stronger delivery predictability, improved product execution, and increased resilience within 12 months.
Builds trust and credibility with the President, the executive team, and the Board through clear communication, sound judgment, and disciplined execution, even under uncertainty.

Application Strategy and Delivery

The successful candidate will partner closely with senior investment leaders to evaluate strategic opportunities, assess portfolio resilience and provide forward-looking insights that support decisions across public and private markets.

 As a senior leader within the Risk Division, the Senior Director will influence how investment risks and opportunities are understood at the total portfolio level. The role will help advance HOOPP's Total Portfolio Approach through innovative analytics, rigorous research, constructive challenge and strategic thought leadership.

 Strategic Portfolio Leadership
 Partner with Investment Management and the Total Portfolio Group to provide insights that support portfolio construction, strategic asset allocation and investment decision-making across HOOPP’s total fund.
 Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on portfolio design, investment strategy, risk-return trade-offs and portfolio resilience.
 Assess the interaction of public and private market exposures, providing an integrated view of portfolio opportunities, concentrations and vulnerabilities.
 Provide constructive challenge and independent assessment of strategic allocations, portfolio construction choices and material investment transactions.

 Total Portfolio Analytics & Risk Insight
 Lead enterprise-wide oversight of total portfolio risk across public and private markets, including equities, fixed income, derivatives, real estate, infrastructure, private equity and private credit.
 Monitor macroeconomic conditions, market developments and structural investment themes to assess their potential impact on total portfolio outcomes.

 Drive research and thought leadership in portfolio construction, asset allocation, risk factor modelling, diversification and advanced portfolio analytics.
 Advance analytical capabilities related to emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and data-driven investment insights, and assess their implications for portfolios, markets and investment processes.
 Lead innovation in cross-asset correlation, tail-risk analysis, scenario design and forward-looking portfolio assessment methodologies.
 Collaborate with technology partners, external experts and industry peers to strengthen analytical capabilities and investment decision-support frameworks.

 Leadership & Influence
 Lead, develop and mentor a high-performing team of portfolio risk and analytics professionals.
 Build trusted partnerships across Investment Management, Finance, Actuarial, Technology, Legal, Human Resources and other key stakeholder groups.
 Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders and governance forums.
 Represent HOOPP externally through industry forums, peer collaboration, research initiatives and thought leadership.
 Contribute to the long-term evolution of HOOPP’s Total Portfolio Approach and broader investment risk framework.

 What you bring: 

 A graduate degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration or a related discipline. A CFA, FRM, MBA or equivalent professional designation is considered an asset.
 12+ years of experience in institutional investing, portfolio construction, investment strategy, total fund management, multi-asset investing, OCIO, capital markets or investment risk leadership.
 Deep understanding of portfolio construction, asset allocation, investment decision-making and risk management across public and private markets.
 Experience evaluating complex multi-asset portfolios, including alternative investments and derivatives.

Canadian Blood Services is seeking a Regular Full-Time Associate Director, Portfolio Governance and Value Realization
to join our Enterprise Portfolio, Program and Project Management Office (ePMO)
team in our Ottawa or Toronto office.

The ePMO
team delivers programs and services that advance valuable organizational initiatives, ensuring they are completed on time and on budget. Our focus is on maximizing business outcomes for Canadian Blood Services and the people in Canada we serve.

As the Associate Director, Portfolio Governance and Value Realization, you will lead value realization and benefits tracking activities aligned with corporate strategy, corporate funding cycles, and the delivery of high-visibility projects and programs across the organization.

Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Program Enablement & Project Management Office, you will lead ePMO-led value realization activities across enterprise programs and provide guidance to support value-informed decision-making. You will contribute to enterprise portfolio management and reporting for all corporate priority projects, including ePMO projects; escalate issues requiring executive attention; and provide leadership to enterprise projects coordinated through process management. You will also ensure compliance with corporate portfolio reporting requirements and support the execution of select projects within the portfolio by fostering collaboration and integration across divisions. In addition, you will provide a challenge function across other ePMO activities, including reporting, automation and artificial intelligence (AI), data and analytics, and alignment with corporate strategy.

Formula for success

Leveraging your skills in ePMO operations, you will oversee value realization driven through programs, providing leadership, coordination, and management of enterprise PMO processes and functions.
Applying your expertise in value realization leadership, you will oversee the development of proposals and business cases, as required, to help articulate anticipated benefits and the value proposition.
Demonstrating your skills in influencing and negotiating, you will motivate and coach staff for high performance, act with transparency, and promote a problem-solving mindset and collaborative culture.
Utilizing your experience in benefits management and performance measurement, you will ensure all centrally delivered projects and programs have defined benefits, measured using key performance indicators, tracked, and communicated in a consistent and effective manner, and incorporate effective change and risk management controls.
Drawing on your skills in project interdependency management and prioritization, you will identify, manage, and address interdependencies between projects and prioritization to drive the greatest value.
Demonstrating your ability to lead with empathy and emotional intelligence, you will apply the advanced soft skills required to lead and motivate others to achieve deliverables, particularly when priorities and expectations may be in conflict.
Contributing your expertise in strategic initiatives and project leadership, you will take a lead role in developing and maintaining various initiatives and participate in special projects and corporate initiatives as assigned by the Director.
Applying your skills in performance improvement and governance, you will identify opportunities to improve performance and apply fit-for-purpose processes that balance governance and empowerment.
Fostering your strengths in people leadership and talent development, you will create a high-performing, engaged, and inclusive team environment by setting clear expectations, developing talent, supporting career growth and succession planning, and promoting continuous learning, collaboration, and professional development.
Applying your analytical and problem-solving skills, you will use your seasoned experience and knowledge to analyze highly complex problems, interpret business needs, and develop integrated, innovative solutions. This will often require deeper investigation of conflicting information and novel thinking to establish solutions.

Desired Education And Skills

A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Science, Public Administration, Health Administration, or a related discipline. A master’s degree (MBA, MPA, MSc, or equivalent) is considered an asset. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.
A minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience managing multiple projects and programs involving large teams, significant budgets, and multiple stakeholders, including at the executive level.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead teams, including managing, coaching, and developing project managers, employees, and contracted resources.
Proven ability to manage a significant project portfolio within a large organization, with a focus on value realization and measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated success in establishing and maturing value-driven portfolios and programs that support organizational transformation and strategic objectives.
Expertise in process transformation and service delivery, including the ability to develop recommendations and present outcomes to executive leadership.
Strong analytical and technical capabilities, with the ability to leverage portfolio reporting, data analytics, performance metrics, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve decision-making, reporting, and operational efficiency.
Knowledge of corporate planning, budgeting, and financial management processes that support effective portfolio management and prioritization.
Familiarity with introducing new products or processes within a regulated environment is considered an asset.
Knowledge of managing and implementing process changes within a unionized workforce environment is considered an asset.
Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain project and portfolio documentation, reports, business cases, and executive-level presentations.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and working within Agile teams is considered an asset.
Proficiency with relevant project and portfolio management tools, including Microsoft Project Professional and Microsoft Project Online (MSPO), is considered an asset.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, including collaboration, facilitation, influencing, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement.
Strong financial and operational planning capabilities, with the ability to align resources, budgets, and priorities with organizational objectives.

What We Offer You

4 weeks’ vacation.
Comprehensive group health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family.
Annual performance award of up to 10%.
Defined benefit pension plan.
Employee discounts, wellness programs, and access to professional development resources.

You will work Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week, 7.5 hours per day.

If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply by providing your up-to-date resume. This could be your first step towards a meaningful and inspiring career. Come to work each day knowing that you save lives.

We recognize the land and waters that have inspired our work and offer gratitude to those Indigenous peoples on whose territory we work, live and play.

Diversity and inclusion play a vital role in ensuring health equity for patients across Canada. We are committed to reflecting Canada’s population in our organization and fostering an environment where all employees can be their authentic selves, with equal opportunities to succeed and contribute.

jobs.description:
Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space (TSX:MDA) is a trusted mission partner to the global space industry. A robotics, satellite systems and geointelligence pioneer with a 55\-year\+ story of world firsts and more than 450 missions, MDA Space is a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, and space exploration and infrastructure. The MDA Space team of more than 3,400 space experts in Canada, the US and the UK has the knowledge and know\-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission – bringing to bear a one\-of\-a\-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide\-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there.


**The Role:**



The **PLM/MES Business Transformation Director** is accountable for leading complex, enterprise\-wide **PLM and MES transformation initiatives** across multiple business units. This role requires senior\-level experience delivering large\-scale implementations in highly complex environments, driving alignment across business, operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders. The role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into executable roadmaps, elevating processes and system capabilities to **industry best practices**, and ensuring disciplined execution, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.


**Key Accountabilities**


* Lead enterprise\-wide end\-to\-end PLM and MES implementation across functions, sites, and business units.
* Align business strategy with operational priorities and program objectives for scalable enterprise processes.
* Build and manage integrated roadmaps covering harmonization, solution design, deployment, change management, and capability enhancement.
* Own program governance: scope, milestones, risks, issues, budget, benefits, and executive reporting.
* Align complex, disparate requirements, decisions, and deployment priorities among business, manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders.
* Guide cross\-functional teams, vendors, and experts in a matrix environment.
* Embed PLM and MES solutions into operations through adoption, governance, training, and continuous improvement.
* Translate business and regulatory needs into actionable implementation plans.
* Coordinate process design, configuration, data readiness, integration, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
* Ensure PLM/MES capabilities align with enterprise platforms and digital transformation.
* Drive standardization and best practices while balancing business realities.
* Define success metrics, KPIs, and readiness measures for transformation programs.
* Manage delivery risk, dependencies, escalation, and remediation.
* Present concise updates to Steering Committees and senior leadership.
* Focus on business outcomes, adoption, and sustained value post\-deployment.


**Stakeholder \& Change Leadership**


* Serve as a trusted transformation partner to senior leaders across business, operations, manufacturing, engineering, and technology functions
* Drive alignment across enterprise leaders with differing priorities, legacy processes, and business unit requirements to achieve common PLM and MES outcomes
* Lead business change activities to ensure stakeholder readiness, process adoption, and sustainable capability uplift across impacted teams
* Influence decision\-making, resolve cross\-functional conflicts, and drive timely executive escalation in a complex matrixed environment


**Required Expereince:**


* **15\+ years' experience** leading large, complex enterprise transformation and system implementation programs
* Demonstrated senior\-level experience delivering **PLM and MES implementations** in highly complex, multi\-business\-unit enterprise environments
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
* Program or Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent)
* Proven track record of managing multi\-workstream programs with significant organizational change, cross\-functional dependencies, and enterprise process alignment.
* Experience working in matrixed or federated operating models across multiple business units, functions, and implementation partners.
* Executive\-level communication experience, including Steering Committee engagement, sponsor management, and senior stakeholder alignment.
* Experience with process standardization, global template or multi\-site deployment approaches, and industry best practice adoption is an asset


**Leadership Capabilities:**


* Strong outcome‑orientation with a bias for action and accountability
* Ability to influence at senior levels without direct authority
* High tolerance for ambiguity and ability to structure complex problems
* Pragmatic, disciplined, and calm under pressure
* Trusted advisor mindset with strong judgment and professionalism


**Special Considerations:**



Successful candidates must obtain and hold security clearance at the Reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Controlled Goods Program (CGP), and be able to obtain higher clearances.

MDA Space offers competitive compensation and benefits to its employees at all of its locations. As a member of the MDA Space team, you and your eligible dependents can enroll in a benefits plan that provides a comprehensive level of protection through competitive health care, including: health care plans supplemental and flexible drug plans, dental and vision benefits, disability income protection, life insurance, group retirement savings plans and an employee assistance program and to their family.


**Equal Opportunity Statement:**



MDA Space is an equal opportunity employer with a strong focus on diversity and inclusion. We are committed to treating all employees and candidates with respect and dignity. I

jobs.title: Director, Restructuring, Montreal | Corporate Finance
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

FTI Consulting est un chef de file mondial des sociétés d’experts-conseils pour les organisations qui font face à des crises et à des transformations. Nous travaillons sur les enjeux majeurs de beaucoup de multinationales, cabinets d’avocats, banques et sociétés de financement par capitaux propres, qui sont parmi les plus importants au monde, pour créer un impact qui fait la différence. Qu’il s’agisse de résoudre des questions litigieuses, de naviguer à travers des crises, de gérer des risques et d’optimiser le rendement, nos équipes répondent rapidement aux situations complexes et dynamiques.

Chez FTI Consulting, vous travaillerez aux côtés de leaders qui ont façonné l’histoire, en aidant à régler les plus grands défis qui font les manchettes aujourd’hui. Dès le premier jour, vous ferez partie intégrante d’une équipe focalisée où vous pourrez faire une vraie différence. Vous serez entouré d’une culture ouverte et collaborative qui souscrit à la diversité, à la reconnaissance, au perfectionnement professionnel, et de façon plus importante, à vous.

Êtes-vous prêt à faire votre différence ?

Français

À propos de FTI et du poste

Le groupe Financement corporatif et restructuration de FTI Consulting accompagne les entreprises, prêteurs, investisseurs, conseils d’administration, fonds de capital-investissement et autres parties prenantes dans la gestion de défis financiers, opérationnels et stratégiques complexes. Nos professionnels travaillent aux côtés des équipes de direction afin de répondre à des enjeux de liquidité, d’améliorer la performance, d’évaluer des solutions stratégiques et d’accompagner les organisations dans des périodes de transformation, de crise ou de changement. Le groupe Financement corporatif et restructuration de FTI offre des services couvrant le redressement et la restructuration, les transactions ainsi que les initiatives de transformation d'entreprise.

FTI Consulting est un cabinet-conseil de premier plan à l’échelle mondiale comptant plus de 8 000 professionnels et des bureaux dans les principaux marchés canadiens. Notre pratique de Montréal poursuit sa croissance et offre une occasion unique de joindre une équipe entrepreneuriale tout en bénéficiant des ressources, de l’expertise et des possibilités de carrière d’un leader mondial du secteur.

Nos équipes de mission sont volontairement de taille restreinte, permettant à chacun d’assumer rapidement des responsabilités importantes, d’interagir directement avec les clients et d’accélérer son développement professionnel dès le premier jour.

À titre de directeur(trice), vous jouerez un rôle clé auprès des entreprises et des parties prenantes confrontées à des situations financières et opérationnelles complexes, en dirigeant des mandats, en développant des relations de confiance avec les clients et en contribuant à la croissance continue de notre pratique.

Exemples de mandats récents

Gestion des liquidités et préparation de flux de trésorerie prévisionnels sur 13 semaines
Revues indépendantes des opérations de l’entreprise pour des prêteurs et investisseurs
Évaluations de la performance financière et opérationnelle
Mandats de redressement et de restructuration
Procédures en vertu de la Loi sur la faillite et l’insolvabilité (LFI) et de la Loi sur les arrangements avec les créanciers des compagnies (LACC)
Transactions de fusions et acquisitions en contexte de détresse financière et évaluations d’alternatives stratégiques
Mandats de conseil auprès des parties prenantes

Ce poste convient parfaitement aux candidats souhaitant mettre à profit leur expérience en restructuration, en finance corporative, en conseil auprès des parties prenantes et en gestion tout en jouant un rôle concret dans le développement d’une pratique en forte croissance.

Ce que vous ferez

À titre de directeur(trice), vous travaillerez directement avec des équipes de direction, des prêteurs, des investisseurs, des conseillers juridiques et des professionnels chevronnés de FTI sur des mandats auprès d’entreprises canadiennes et internationales évoluant dans divers secteurs d’activité. Vous serez impliqué dans des mandats complexes, superviserez leur exécution et contribuerez au développement continu de la pratique Financement corporatif et restructuration de FTI à Montréal.

Responsabilités principales

Superviser l’exécution quotidienne de mandats de restructuration, de redressement d’entreprise et de transactions, incluant des interactions avec les équipes de direction, les conseillers juridiques, les prêteurs, les investisseurs et les autres conseillers financiers
Mettre à profit vos compétences en affaires, en comptabilité, en finance et en analyse dans le cadre de divers mandats
Examiner les états financiers et les informations opérationnelles afin d’évaluer la performance de l’entreprise et d’identifier les principaux facteurs de risque et opportunités
Préparer et réviser des projections de flux de trésorerie, des analyses de liquidité et des modèles financiers complexes
Évaluer des plans d’affaires, des initiatives de restructuration, des alternatives stratégiques et d’importants volumes de données liés aux mandats
Réaliser des revues diligentes financières et d’autres analyses en appui à des mandats de restructuration, de refinancement ou de transaction
Développer une compréhension approfondie des activités des débitrices, incluant leur performance opérationnelle et financière, leurs flux de trésorerie et leurs principaux moteurs de création de valeur
Préparer et réviser des rapports, des présentations et d’autres livrables destinés aux équipes de direction, prêteurs, investisseurs, conseils d’administration et autres parties prenantes
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de direction, les conseillers juridiques, les prêteurs, les investisseurs et les autres parties prenantes dans le cadre de processus de restructuration, de financement ou de transaction
Gérer les équipes de mission et offrir du mentorat, de l’encadrement et des opportunités de développement aux professionnels plus juniors
Contribuer aux initiatives de développement des affaires et à la croissance continue de la pratique de Financement corporatif et restructuration de Montréal
Ce poste nécessite des déplacements chez les clients et dans les bureaux de FTI, selon les besoins

Votre développement chez FTI

jobs.title: PLM/MES Business Transformation Director
jobs.description:
Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space (TSX:MDA) is a trusted mission partner to the global space industry. A robotics, satellite systems and geointelligence pioneer with a 55-year+ story of world firsts and more than 450 missions, MDA Space is a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, and space exploration and infrastructure. The MDA Space team of more than 3,400 space experts in Canada, the US and the UK has the knowledge and know-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission – bringing to bear a one-of-a-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there.

The Role

The PLM/MES Business Transformation Director
is accountable for leading complex, enterprise-wide PLM and MES transformation initiatives
across multiple business units. This role requires senior-level experience delivering large-scale implementations in highly complex environments, driving alignment across business, operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders. The role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into executable roadmaps, elevating processes and system capabilities to industry best practices
, and ensuring disciplined execution, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

Key Accountabilities

Lead enterprise-wide end-to-end PLM and MES implementation across functions, sites, and business units.
Align business strategy with operational priorities and program objectives for scalable enterprise processes.
Build and manage integrated roadmaps covering harmonization, solution design, deployment, change management, and capability enhancement.
Own program governance: scope, milestones, risks, issues, budget, benefits, and executive reporting.
Align complex, disparate requirements, decisions, and deployment priorities among business, manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT stakeholders.
Guide cross-functional teams, vendors, and experts in a matrix environment.
Embed PLM and MES solutions into operations through adoption, governance, training, and continuous improvement.
Translate business and regulatory needs into actionable implementation plans.
Coordinate process design, configuration, data readiness, integration, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
Ensure PLM/MES capabilities align with enterprise platforms and digital transformation.
Drive standardization and best practices while balancing business realities.
Define success metrics, KPIs, and readiness measures for transformation programs.
Manage delivery risk, dependencies, escalation, and remediation.
Present concise updates to Steering Committees and senior leadership.
Focus on business outcomes, adoption, and sustained value post-deployment.

Stakeholder & Change Leadership

Serve as a trusted transformation partner to senior leaders across business, operations, manufacturing, engineering, and technology functions
Drive alignment across enterprise leaders with differing priorities, legacy processes, and business unit requirements to achieve common PLM and MES outcomes
Lead business change activities to ensure stakeholder readiness, process adoption, and sustainable capability uplift across impacted teams
Influence decision-making, resolve cross-functional conflicts, and drive timely executive escalation in a complex matrixed environment

Required Expereince

15+ years' experience leading large, complex enterprise transformation and system implementation programs
Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering PLM and MES implementations in highly complex, multi-business-unit enterprise environments
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
Program or Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent)
Proven track record of managing multi-workstream programs with significant organizational change, cross-functional dependencies, and enterprise process alignment.
Experience working in matrixed or federated operating models across multiple business units, functions, and implementation partners.
Executive-level communication experience, including Steering Committee engagement, sponsor management, and senior stakeholder alignment.
Experience with process standardization, global template or multi-site deployment approaches, and industry best practice adoption is an asset

Leadership Capabilities

Strong outcome‑orientation with a bias for action and accountability
Ability to influence at senior levels without direct authority
High tolerance for ambiguity and ability to structure complex problems
Pragmatic, disciplined, and calm under pressure
Trusted advisor mindset with strong judgment and professionalism

Special Considerations

Successful candidates must obtain and hold security clearance at the Reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Controlled Goods Program (CGP), and be able to obtain higher clearances.

Benefits Statement

MDA Space offers competitive compensation and benefits to its employees at all of its locations. As a member of the MDA Space team, you and your eligible dependents can enroll in a benefits plan that provides a comprehensive level of protection through competitive health care, including: health care plans supplemental and flexible drug plans, dental and vision benefits, disability income protection, life insurance, group retirement savings plans and an employee assistance program and to their family.

Equal Opportunity Statement

MDA Space is an equal opportunity employer with a strong focus on diversity and inclusion. We are committed to treating all employees and candidates with respect and dignity. If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please let us know.

The compensation range for this position is $180-000-200,000 annually. The specific compensation offered will be based on the qualifications and experience of the successful candidate.

Le Directeur de la transformation métier PLM/MES
est chargé de diriger des initiatives de transformation PLM et MES
complexes à l’échelle de l’entreprise, couvrant plusieurs unités opérationnelles. Ce poste requiert une expérience de haut niveau dans la mise en œuvre de projets à grande échelle dans des environnements hautement complexes, ainsi que la capacité à assurer la coordination entre les intervenants des secteurs d’activité, des opérations, de l’ingénierie, de la qualité, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et des TI. Le titulaire du poste est chargé de traduire les objectifs stratégiques en feuilles de route réalisables, d’aligner les processus et les capacités des systèmes sur les meilleures pratiques du secteur
, et de garantir une exécution rigoureuse, une adoption efficace et des résultats commerciaux mesurables.

Principales Responsabilités

Diriger la mise en œuvre de bout en bout des systèmes PLM et MES à l’échelle de l’entreprise, en coordination avec l’ensemble des fonctions, des sites et des unités opérationnelles.
Aligner la stratégie commerciale sur les priorités opérationnelles et les objectifs du programme afin de mettre en place des processus d’entreprise évolutifs.
Élaborer et gérer des feuilles de route intégrées couvrant l’harmonisation, la conception de solutions, le déploiement, la gestion du changement et l’amélioration des capacités.
Assurer la gouvernance du programme : portée, jalons, risques, problèmes, budget, avantages et rapports à la direction.
Harmoniser les exigences, les décisions et les priorités de déploiement complexes et disparates entre les intervenants des secteurs commercial, de la fabrication, de l’ingénierie, de la qualité, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et des TI.
Diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles, des fournisseurs et des experts dans un environnement matriciel.
Intégrer les solutions PLM et MES dans les opérations au moyen de la mise en œuvre, de la gouvernance, de la formation et de l’amélioration continue.
Traduire les besoins opérationnels et réglementaires en plans de mise en œuvre concrets.
Coordonner la conception des processus, la configuration, la préparation des données, l’intégration, les essais, la mise en service et la stabilisation.
Veiller à ce que les capacités PLM/MES s’alignent sur les plateformes d’entreprise et la transformation numérique.
Promouvoir la normalisation et les meilleures pratiques tout en tenant compte des réalités opérationnelles.
Définir des indicateurs de réussite, des indicateurs de rendement clé (IRC) et des mesures de préparation pour les programmes de transformation.
Gérer les risques liés à la mise en œuvre, les dépendances, les recours hiérarchiques et les mesures correctives.
Présenter des rapports concis aux comités directeurs et à la direction.
Se concentrer sur les résultats opérationnels, l’adoption du projet et la création de valeur durable après le déploiement.

Leadership auprès des intervenants et gestion du changement

Agir à titre de partenaire de confiance en matière de transformation auprès des responsables des fonctions commerciales, opérationnelles, de fabrication, d’ingénierie et technologiques
Favoriser l’alignement entre les responsables de l’entreprise ayant des priorités, des processus hérités et des exigences opérationnelles divergentes afin d’atteindre des résultats communs en matière de PLM et de MES
Diriger les activités de changement organisationnel afin de garantir la préparation des intervenants, l’adoption des processus et l’amélioration durable des capacités au sein des équipes concernées par les répercussions
Influencer la prise de décision, résoudre les conflits interfonctionnels et assurer un recours hiérarchique rapide dans un environnement matriciel complexe

Expérience Requise

8 à 10 ans d’expérience dans la direction de programmes de transformation d’entreprise et de mise en œuvre de systèmes à grande échelle et complexes
Expérience avérée à un poste de cadre supérieur dans la mise en œuvre de systèmes PLM et MES au sein d’environnements d’entreprise hautement complexes regroupant plusieurs divisions
Baccalauréat en gestion, en génie, en systèmes d’information ou dans un domaine connexe
Certification en gestion de programmes ou de projets (PMP ou équivalent)
Expérience avérée dans la gestion de programmes comportant plusieurs axes de travail, impliquant des changements organisationnels importants, des interdépendances interfonctionnelles et l’alignement des processus d’entreprise.
Expérience de travail au sein de modèles opérationnels matriciels ou fédérés, couvrant plusieurs unités opérationnelles, fonctions et partenaires de mise en œuvre.
Expérience en communication au niveau de la direction, notamment en matière de collaboration avec les comités directeurs, de gestion des gestionnaires et de coordination avec les intervenants de haut niveau.
Une expérience en matière de standardisation des processus, d’approches de déploiement à l’échelle mondiale ou sur plusieurs sites, ainsi que l’adoption des meilleures pratiques du secteur constituent un atout

Compétences en matière de leadership

Forte orientation vers les résultats, avec un penchant pour l’action et la responsabilité
Capacité à exercer une influence auprès des hauts responsables sans exercer d’autorité directe
Grande tolérance à l’ambiguïté et capacité à structurer des problèmes complexes
Pragmatique, discipliné et calme face à la pression
Une attitude de conseiller de confiance, alliant un sens aigu du discernement et un grand professionnalisme
