jobs.title: VP, Finance & Controllership
jobs.description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

 The Opportunity

 This is the operational core of our global Finance function. You will own the close, the consolidation, the audit, and the reporting rhythm that turn a growing portfolio of acquired software companies into a coherent whole.

 Banyan acquires vertical software businesses and holds them permanently. We don’t buy to flip. We buy to grow. That permanence shapes how we build Finance: it rewards investment in process, systems, and people that compound over years. You will inherit a function in motion, healthy and growing, and set the trajectory for the next layer of operational maturity across HQ and the operating companies.

 You will lead a team across Controllership, Global Payroll, and ERP & Reporting, partner closely with FP&A, Tax, and Treasury at HQ, and work directly with Finance Directors at the operating companies.

  

 Why Banyan

 A permanent-hold model changes how Finance is built. Most controllership leaders inherit a function being optimized for a sale or transition. Here, you’re building for the long arc: maturing close, consolidation, and reporting practices that compound with every acquisition we add. The work you do this year is still relevant five years from now.

 Real scale, real complexity, real velocity. Many legal entities globally. A growing collection of vertical software businesses, each with its own data and accounting nuances, rolling up into one coherent group. Acquisitions flow through the close on a regular cadence.

 Direct partnership with the CFO. You’ll operate as a thought partner, not a back-office function. The CFO is looking for someone who can translate the numbers into narrative, surface implications, and bring discipline to how Finance shows up across the group.

  

 What You Own

 The global close and consolidation cycle. Own the monthly close across HQ and operating companies under US GAAP. The current close runs about ten days; the working target is five. You will set the path to get there, holding integrity as the floor.

 The year-end audit. Manage the external audit relationship and deliver a cleanly run year-end. Coordinate audit asks across HQ and operating companies. Hold the function to a standard an auditor can lean into.

 Group-level technical accounting. Bring deep US GAAP fluency, particularly around software industry topics. Translate technical positions into practical, operational outcomes. Partner with the CFO on judgment calls that need an executive view. You understand the grey, not just the rule.

 Standardization across operating companies. Partner with OpCo Finance Directors to align chart of accounts, reporting packages, close timelines, and day-to-day accounting practice as we continue to migrate operating companies onto a common ERP environment. Bring coherence without flattening what makes each business work locally.

 Controllership, Payroll, ERP & Reporting, and AR / AP leadership. Lead a team of approximately ten, including a Director of Controllership, a Director of Global Payroll, and a Head of ERP & Reporting. Hire, develop, and stretch the team. Build a culture of delegation, ownership, and accountability so the function scales without you becoming the bottleneck.

 HQ Finance partnership. Work alongside the VP, FP&A on reporting infrastructure; with Tax on compliance cadence; and with Treasury on cash and FX support. Bring connective tissue.

 Systems and automation. NetSuite is the group ERP, with adjacent close-management, AP, and expense tooling in place. Identify and introduce automation, AI, and system enhancements that create efficiency as the portfolio scales.

 Acquisition integration. Integrate newly acquired operating companies into the close and reporting rhythm. Make onboarding repeatable.

  

 Who You Are

 An experienced controllership leader. 12+ years of progressive controllership experience, including approximately 5+ years in a senior Controllership role.

 Public-company-grade reporting rigor. You've operated in an environment where audit, internal controls, and disclosure discipline are taken seriously. Whether at a public company, a PE-backed platform with audited GAAP financials, or a leveraged credit reporting to an institutional lender group. Public-company background is welcome.

 Multi-entity, multi-currency, multi-jurisdiction consolidation. Required. You've owned a consolidation across 100+ legal entities, many currencies, and multiple jurisdictions. You know what breaks first when an acquisition lands in the close, and you know how to fix it permanently.

 A Big 4 (or comparable firm) foundation. Required. Big 4, or a strong, reputable firm equivalent.

 Software industry experience. Required. Either in-industry or as a software-focused practice at a public-accounting firm.

 Hands-on NetSuite experience. Required. NetSuite is the group ERP. We need someone who has worked in it directly, not someone planning to learn it on the job.

 Strong on technical accounting, with commercial sense. Deep US GAAP applied to software industry topics. You navigate technical positions and audit requirements fluently, and you balance the technical view with what is practical and operational.

 An “altitude” leader. You move from the close-cycle detail to the implications conversation with the CFO without losing either. You tease out the “so what”: not just what the numbers say, but what they mean and what should change because of them.

 A team leader who empowers and trusts. You hire well, develop people, hold a high bar, and run a team without needing to be in the middle of every detail.

 Humble and collaborative. Ego doesn’t show up in the work. You partner across functions without elbows.

 Energized by execution. You drive things to done. You don’t wait for a perfect playbook before you move. The pace is real, and it’s a reason strong operators thrive here.

 Intellectually curious about AI and automation. You evaluate tools. You bring an early-adopter mindset, even if you haven’t yet led a transformation program. AI is helpful here, not critical.

  

 Strongly Preferred

 Private equity-backed, holdco, or serial-acquirer environment.

 Track record leading or supporting Finance systems improvements: NetSuite migrations or expansions, close-management tool implementations, AI-enabled tooling.

 Acquisition integration experience: volume of integrations matters more than complexity of any single deal.

 Experience compressing a close cycle.

 Global team experience, including managing or partnering with offshore teams

  

 Location & Compensation

 Location: Toronto, ON, Canada (hybrid - 3 days / week in-office)

 Travel: periodic (~10%)

 Compensation: CAD $200,000-$250,000 base salary, excluding annual bonus and equity (when applicable). Salary is based on a number of factors including market conditions, location and may vary depending on job-related skills and experience.

  

 This position is for an active vacancy.

 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.

 Please Note: Banyan Software does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications submitted via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed.

 Recruitment Notice 

 Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

  

 Beware of Recruitment Scams 

 We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. 

 Protect yourself by following these steps: 

 Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.

 Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process.

 If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.

 Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the Managing Director of AI
jobs.description:
Location: US or Canada
Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor 

 **A note before you read further** 

 The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

 About Human Agency 

 We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

 We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

 Our clients' missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

 Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

 We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are at and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff for our Managing Director of AI—someone who combines strategic vision in AI with hands-on execution and technological know-how. You'll be both a force-multiplier and a transformation architect: designing AI-enabled processes, building automated engines that run independently, leading organizational rollouts, and ensuring crisp execution across our AI solutions practice.

 This role goes beyond traditional Chief of Staff responsibilities. You'll design processes that leverage AI, build repeatable systems that scale, and lead entire client transformations from discovery to sustained adoption. You have the potential to grow into leading organizational-level AI implementations as the practice expands.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Strategic & Executive Leadership 

 Partner with the Managing Director of AI and the executive team to translate priorities into sequenced plans, resourcing, and measurable outcomes

 Lead Human Agency's AI transformation methodology: define offerings, build repeatable frameworks, and establish best practices for AI-enabled workflows

 Design end-to-end processes that embed AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms, knowledge assistants) into client workflows and internal operations

 Translate complex AI capabilities into clear business cases, use cases, and implementation roadmaps for executive audiences

 Produce high-quality executive materials (briefings, roadmaps, decision memos) that drive alignment and decisions

 Identify where AI creates leverage across client engagements and surface strategic opportunities to leadership

 AI Process Design & Automated Engines 

 Design and build AI-powered systems that operate independently with minimal ongoing intervention—automated engines that scale beyond individual engagements

 Create repeatable processes for AI implementation: discovery frameworks, solution architectures, evaluation routines, and governance models

 Design prompts, playbooks, and knowledge bases optimized for reliability, consistency, and reusability across multiple clients

 Implement lightweight automation using no/low-code tools (Zapier, Make, Airtable) integrated with AI capabilities

 Establish monitoring and feedback loops that enable self-correcting, continuously improving systems

 Document patterns and best practices that can be deployed at scale

 Client Service Delivery & Organizational Rollouts 

 Own end-to-end delivery on multiple client engagements involving AI-enabled solutions (e.g., knowledge assistants, workflow automations, content summarization, research copilots), from discovery through launch and sustained adoption

 Lead company-wide and client-wide AI adoption initiatives—managing stakeholder alignment, training, governance, and measurement across entire organizations

 Run comprehensive discovery to surface use cases, success metrics, risks, change-management needs, and technical requirements; translate findings into scopes, timelines, and clear acceptance criteria

 Coordinate solution build-outs with internal teammates and external partners: data/connectivity needs, tool selection, integration planning, prompt engineering, and rollout choreography

 Design change-management approaches that address skill gaps, cultural resistance, workflow disruption, and organizational readiness

 Partner with client leadership to sequence rollout phases, manage dependencies, and demonstrate ROI

 Quality, Governance & Evaluation 

 Set lightweight evaluation routines: accuracy metrics, latency benchmarks, cost tracking, quality assurance processes, and continuous improvement cycles

 Establish prompt/playbook management, basic safety/guardrail checks, and UAT plans

 Build governance frameworks that enable responsible, scalable AI adoption across organizations

 Implement monitoring systems that track performance, usage, and business impact

 Stakeholder Management & Enablement 

 Lead standing client check-ins, executive presentations, demo readiness, decision logs, and release notes, presenting succinct options and recommendations

 Create comprehensive enablement materials: user guides, FAQs, training programs, and governance playbooks that empower client teams to operate AI systems independently

 Build lasting client relationships through proactive communication, anticipation of needs, and consistent delivery quality

 Present to executive audiences with clarity and confidence, addressing concerns about accuracy, security, and adoption

 Operations & Project Management 

 Design and continuously improve the operating system for AI work: intake → triage → prioritization → delivery → QA → launch → measurement

 Manage staffing assignments and subcontractor contributions across concurrent workstreams; keep tools current (Asana/Notion, Google Workspace, Slack)

 Budget & scope control: track time against SOWs, flag changes early, manage vendors, and ensure on-budget delivery with clear documentation

 Establish shared dashboards for delivery health (timeline, risk, burn, dependency status) and run tight meeting cadences

 Communications & Reporting 

 Prepare agendas, briefings, and executive-ready presentations; synthesize complex information into actionable insights

 Provide clear, timely reporting to the Managing Director of AI and stakeholders on progress, risks, and decisions

 Contribute to Human Agency's AI thought leadership through documentation of best practices, case studies, and insights

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5-7+ years in operations, client services, product/program/project management, strategic support, consulting, or transformation roles with direct ownership of client-facing delivery

 Demonstrated success leading multi-stakeholder projects and organizational change initiatives end-to-end (scope, timelines, budgets, risk, and change management)

 Deep AI fluency: hands-on experience implementing LLM-enabled solutions, prompt engineering, workflow automation, and knowledge management systems; can shape prompts/playbooks, evaluate quality, and choose appropriate tools or vendors

 Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, when to use AI, how to design for reliability, and how to manage risks responsibly

 Proven ability to design repeatable processes and systems that scale beyond individual projects

 Experience with no/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier/n8n), knowledge bases, and modern AI tooling

 High proficiency with Google Workspace, Asana/Notion, Slack, and comfort with modern web and content tools; experience preparing polished executive documents and presentations

 Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for non-technical audiences

 Bonus: Experience leading organizational-level technology rollouts, background in management consulting, familiarity with responsible AI considerations (privacy, data handling, consent, bias mitigation), or experience in AI/ML product development

 Mindset & Traits 

 Builder and operator: You design systems that work without constant oversight, not just execute tasks

 Strategic and tactical: Comfortable setting vision while rolling up sleeves for hands-on implementation

 AI pragmatist: Excited about possibilities but grounded in what actually delivers measurable value

 Mission-driven; systems thinker with bias for action

 Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence executive stakeholders and earn trust through delivery

 Calm under pressure with excellent judgment about when to escalate vs. solve independently

 Able to hold strategic context while driving tactical execution across multiple concurrent engagements

 Intellectually curious with strong learning agility, you stay current on AI capabilities and translate findings into practical applications

 Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists

 Considerations 

 Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; an advanced degree in business, technology, or a related field is a plus

 Ethics: Commitment to ethical practices and responsible AI (transparency, human oversight, privacy, bias mitigation)

 Travel: Regular (20–40%) for client activities, organizational rollouts, and events

 Location: Remote-friendly with preference for candidates in major tech hubs

 Compensation 

 This role offers a competitive base salary with performance-based bonuses and potential equity participation. Final compensation will vary based on experience, performance, and location.

 Why Join Human Agency 

 Join a team of thinkers and builders creating meaningful impact across sectors—with autonomy to lead, the resources to succeed, and room to grow. This role offers the opportunity to shape how organizations integrate AI at scale, with clear pathways to increased leadership responsibility as our practice expands.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse backgrounds and strive to build an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and empowered.

 Most AI consultants are good at one of two things: writing the strategy or doing the work. We need someone who refuses to separate the two. That might mean designing an AI-enabled workflow on Monday, pressure-testing a product decision with a C-suite on Wednesday, and shipping a working prototype by Friday. The client doesn't see the seams. You own the outcome.

 This is the right role if you've spent years inside Big Four firms, strategy boutiques, or early-stage companies and found yourself frustrated by the gap between advice and execution. You know what good looks like, you've seen what happens when no one stays accountable for making it real, and you're done handing off decks to someone else's team. You want the whole thing - the strategy, the build, the proof.

 What You'll Own 

 Client Engagement Leadership — Run AI transformation projects from discovery through delivery, serving as the primary client relationship owner and the person ultimately accountable for outcomes.

 Strategy and Execution, Both — Develop transformation roadmaps grounded in a client's actual constraints, then stay in the work long enough to see them implemented, not handed off.

 0-to-1 Product Building — Identify high-value AI use cases, prototype solutions, and shepherd them from concept to something clients can actually use, often building hands-on alongside the client's internal team.

 Executive-Level Communication — Translate complex AI concepts, technical constraints, and strategic tradeoffs into crisp, confident communication for boards, C-suites, and frontline operators alike.

 Go-to-Market and Growth Support — Contribute to business development, help scope new engagements, and actively deepen relationships with existing clients as their needs evolve.

 AI Tool Deployment — Apply AI tools aggressively across your own workflow and your clients', not as a demo, but as a working standard for how fast and how well this work can get done.

 Internal Contribution — As a senior member of a flat, growing team, you'll help shape how Human Agency delivers, what we learn, and who we become.

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5–8+ years of experience in management consulting, venture-backed startups, product strategy, or a combination, with direct ownership over outcomes, not just deliverables.

 Demonstrated track record of taking AI from concept to working reality in an organizational context — not just advising on AI strategy, but building or deploying something that worked.

 Fluency with the AI tooling landscape — foundation models, workflow automation, prompt engineering, and the judgment to know when to build versus buy versus recommend against.

 Proven ability to lead client relationships at the senior level, including navigating organizational politics, managing ambiguity, and keeping complex engagements on track without a safety net.

 Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp executive brief, run a working session with a skeptical VP, and explain a technical architecture decision to a non-technical founder, often in the same day.

 Experience in 0-to-1 product building — you've shipped something, taken something from nothing to real, and you can speak concretely about how you did it.

 Bonus: Background in venture studios, high-growth AI or tech companies, or operator roles at the intersection of strategy and product.

 Mindset & Traits 

 You're a builder first. Decks are useful; working things are better. You default toward making something real.

 You manage yourself completely. No one will check on your progress, remind you of a deadline, or coach you through a hard week. You are the accountability structure.

 You have no patience for the gap between strategy and execution and have spent your career closing it.

 You're curious about AI in a way that shows up in your actual work — you experiment, you break things, you have opinions formed by firsthand experience, not secondhand summaries.

 You can hold the big picture and the small detail simultaneously, and you know when to zoom in and when to zoom out without being told.

 You do what the work requires. Not what's in scope, not what's comfortable, not what's in your lane.

 Logistics 

 Location: Remote-first; US and Canada eligible. 

 Travel: Occasional travel required for client engagements, company offsites, and key strategic meetings.

 Application Note: Attach proof of something you've built with AI — a product, a workflow, a tool, a result. If you don't have something to show, this is not the right role.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) principal(e), Finance - Planification et Analyse Financières d'entreprise / Senior Director, Finance - Corporate FP&A
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

 What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

 Résumé du poste 
 Le Directeur principal, Finance – FP&A corporatif, est responsable de l’élaboration, de la communication et de la mise en œuvre de la planification et de l’analyse financières pour la consolidation de McKesson Canada. Il agit comme principal interlocuteur financier auprès de McKesson Corporate et des équipes de direction des différentes unités d’affaires pour les prévisions, le budget, le plan à long terme ainsi que pour tout projet ponctuel nécessitant une analyse financière. Il conseille la haute direction en tant que partenaire d’affaires dans la consolidation des budgets, des prévisions et des plans à long terme, tant au niveau stratégique que tactique.

 Responsabilités principales 
 • Agir comme partenaire d’affaires et conseiller financier clé auprès du VP, Finance, FP&A corporatif, ainsi que du CFO.
• Diriger et superviser toutes les activités liées à la planification et à l’analyse financières pour l’unité d’affaires de McKesson Canada, incluant notamment les rapports financiers, les budgets annuels, les prévisions mensuelles, les revues opérationnelles trimestrielles, les plans à long terme et les analyses financières ponctuelles.
• Conseiller la haute direction sur les implications financières des décisions d’affaires, identifier et gérer les risques et opportunités associés aux opérations et au plan à long terme (consolidation McKesson Canada).
• Fournir du soutien stratégique, de la planification de scénarios, ainsi que des analyses de risques et d’opportunités afin d’atteindre les objectifs financiers prévus et à long terme.
• Diriger le développement d’évaluations continues des objectifs financiers stratégiques à court et long terme et recommander des solutions aux parties prenantes, en tenant compte des facteurs internes et externes, de l’impact du marché, de la législation et de l’alignement avec les objectifs financiers corporatifs.
• Diriger les discussions et favoriser le consensus entre les équipes sur les sujets interdépendants entre les BU.
• Jouer un rôle clé dans l’avancement de la stratégie FP&A de McKesson Canada à travers les différents groupes.
• Soutenir l’équipe dans l’identification et la mise en œuvre de stratégies visant à maximiser la précision des prévisions au sein des différentes unités d’affaires.
• Appuyer l’équipe dans les livrables de fin de mois.
• S’assurer qu’à un niveau consolidé, les objectifs budgétaires sont atteints et que la croissance attendue pour les années futures est adéquate. Communiquer clairement au VP, Finance FP&A et M&A ainsi qu’aux CFO des BU les risques et opportunités pour l’année en cours et les années futures.
• Diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles pour suivre la performance des indicateurs clés par rapport au budget ou aux analyses financières prévues.
• Déterminer les normes et indicateurs permettant de mesurer la performance financière de McKesson Canada.
• Concevoir et communiquer des modèles flexibles (tests de résistance, gestion des dépenses, analyse coûts variables vs coûts fixes, etc.) afin d’assurer une communication efficace avec les parties prenantes et une intégration fluide dans les processus de clôture mensuelle, de prévision et de budgétisation annuelle.
• Identifier et communiquer les KPI/indicateurs clés à la haute direction, en mettant en lumière leur impact global sur l’entreprise avec des rapports clairs et concis.
• Assurer un environnement de contrôle interne hautement efficace et veiller au respect de tous les processus SOX dans le cadre du budget et du plan à long terme.

 Analyse et performance financière 
 • Diriger l’analyse des résultats financiers de l’entreprise en lien avec les profits, tendances, coûts, et conformité aux budgets, prévisions et plan à long terme.
• Surveiller les résultats financiers mensuels, trimestriels et annuels et recommander des solutions stratégiques essentielles à la croissance de l’entreprise.
• Développer et mettre en œuvre des KPI appropriés et ponctuels pour l’équipe de direction des BU, ainsi que des indicateurs permettant la gestion en temps réel des activités.
• Remettre en question les soumissions financières des BU pour les budgets, plans à long terme et prévisions continues afin d’assurer que les économies nécessaires sont prises en compte et que les coûts sont correctement reflétés.
• Guider la direction dans le développement des hypothèses mensuelles lors des prévisions et du rolling forecast; élaborer des plans de réussite pour les budgets et le plan à long terme qui seront examinés et approuvés par l’équipe de direction exécutive.
• Agir comme partenaire d’affaires du groupe des relations avec les investisseurs chez Corporate pour représenter les principaux moteurs et la performance du Canada par rapport à l’année précédente.
• Diriger et soutenir les initiatives d’amélioration des processus et les projets de mise en œuvre de systèmes liés à la planification financière (incluant les projets dirigés par le corporate).

 Responsabilités générales 
 • Agir comme la ressource principale de l’entreprise dans son domaine d’expertise, en fournissant leadership et orientation sur tous les enjeux connexes.
• Promouvoir les principes I2CARE et ILEAD de McKesson Canada et de McKesson, en démontrant l’exemple et en encourageant les autres à faire de même.
• Gérer efficacement l’équipe: soutenir, guider et diriger le personnel. Favoriser un haut niveau d’engagement, déléguer adéquatement et fournir orientation, soutien et attentes claires.
• Encourager une communication ouverte, constructive et en temps opportun. Effectuer l’évaluation des performances des employés et soutenir leur développement.
• Promouvoir la collaboration au sein de l’équipe et entre les différents groupes et départements.
• Maintenir une communication appropriée avec tous les niveaux de l’organisation.
• Veiller au respect des politiques de l’entreprise.

 Qualifications 
 • Baccalauréat en commerce avec spécialisation en finance ou comptabilité. Titre comptable professionnel (CPA) requis; solide expertise comptable.
• Minimum de 15 années d’expérience en comptabilité et gestion dans un rôle similaire, incluant au moins 10 années d’expérience en FP&A, idéalement dans une entreprise internationale.
• Expérience démontrée en interaction avec la haute direction et en développement de stratégies financières innovantes.
• Maîtrise approfondie de la planification et de l’analyse financières, des systèmes associés, ainsi que des principes économiques et analytiques liés aux affaires.
• Pensée stratégique, innovante et proactive, avec désir de travailler dans un environnement en évolution.
• Présence exécutive: capacité à interagir avec les dirigeants, influencer sans autorité et défendre ses positions.
• Habileté démontrée à gérer plusieurs livrables simultanément avec un fort sens de l’urgence.
• Excellente communication et fortes capacités d’influence.
• Esprit d’équipe, leadership et excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles.
• Esprit analytique et stratégique, sens de l’organisation, autonomie.
• Capacité à synthétiser des analyses complexes en recommandations claires pour la haute direction.
• Leader de talent capable de maintenir une culture d’excellence.
• Jugement exceptionnel, initiative, rapidité d’apprentissage.
• Bilinguisme (oral et écrit).
• Connaissance avancée des systèmes financiers (ERP, suite Microsoft Office, etc.); la connaissance de SAP, HFM et BPC constitue un atout.

 ------

 The Senior Director, Finance – Corporate FP&A is responsible for developing, communicating, and leading the execution of financial planning & analysis for McKesson Canada consolidation. The i ncumbent acts as the primary financial interface with McKesson Corporate and leaders hip team across different business units for forecast, budget, long range plan and for any ad hoc projects requiring financial analysis.  • Lead cross - functional teams to track key drivers’ performance against budg et / financial business case

 • Identify and communica te KPIs/metrics to senior leadership highlighting the overall impact on the enterprise, with cle ar and con ci se reporting 
 • Accountable to maintain and ensure a highly effective internal control environment and executive accountability to adhere to all SOX related processes for budg et / LRP process. 
 • Accountable to lead the analysis of the business financial results with respect to profits, trends, costs, and compliance with budgets, forecast and LRP. 
 • Responsible to monitor monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results and recommend strategic solutions critical to the success and growth of the business.

 • Guide senior management in developing layovers duri ng monthly forecast and rolling forecast; develops business success planning during budgets and LRP that will be reviewed and approved by executive leadership team 
 • Business partner to the investors relations group at Corporate to represent Canada key drivers’ and performance vs last year 
 • Lead and support process improvements and system implementation projects related to financial planning (including corporate led projects) 

 General Responsibilities

 • Manages effectively. Supports guides and directs activities of staff. Ensure high level of employee engageme nt. Empowers staff by delegating responsibilities and appropriate authority and providing them with direction, support, and clear expectations. 
 • Encourages open, timely and constructive communication and feedback. Evaluates performance of direct reports; a ssists them with their development. Build bench in the team.

 Qualifications

jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

 What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas.  The Senior Director, Infrastructure Compliance & Automation is responsible for leading enterprise Infrastructure compliance, vulnerability remediation enablement, automation, and emerging infrastructure automation technologies.

 This role provides strategic and operational leadership across infrastructure controls, regulatory and audit compliance, vulnerability remediation, patching automation, and infrastructure automation platforms. The Senior Director partners closely with Cyber Security, Internal Audit, External Audit, Infrastructure Engineering and Operations teams, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and other technology organizations to ensure enterprise infrastructure services operate in accordance with established security, compliance, and control requirements.

 The role leads the Infrastructure organization's response to evolving vulnerability management and patching requirements, with a focus on increasing automation, improving remediation velocity, reducing operational risk, and enabling consistent execution across the infrastructure environment.

 The Senior Director also leads Infrastructure compliance activities supporting SOX, SOC 1, SOC 2, and other applicable enterprise controls and audits, ensuring controls are effectively implemented, evidence is complete and timely, deficiencies are remediated, and Infrastructure teams remain audit-ready.

 In addition, this leader owns the Infrastructure automation strategy and capabilities, including Ansible and emerging AI-enabled infrastructure platforms, with responsibility for expanding automation across provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, lifecycle management, and infrastructure operations

 Key Responsibilities: 

 Infrastructure Compliance & Controls: 
 Lead Infrastructure compliance and controls activities across enterprise compute, storage, backup, database, operating system, virtualization, data center, and related infrastructure services.
 Ensure Infrastructure teams effectively implement and maintain required enterprise security, operational, and regulatory controls.
 Lead Infrastructure activities supporting SOX, SOC 1, SOC 2, and other internal and external audits.
 Establish processes to ensure control evidence is accurate, complete, timely, and consistently maintained.
 Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Cyber Security, Risk, and Infrastructure leadership throughout control assessments and audits.
 Coordinate remediation of Infrastructure control deficiencies, audit findings, and identified compliance gaps.
 Translate new or changing enterprise controls into actionable Infrastructure requirements and ensure successful implementation across impacted technology teams.
 Establish reporting and governance mechanisms that provide leadership visibility into Infrastructure compliance posture, control effectiveness, audit readiness, and remediation activities.
 Promote continuous audit readiness rather than point-in-time preparation for individual audits.

 Vulnerability & Patch Management Enablement: 
 Lead Infrastructure vulnerability remediation enablement in partnership with Cyber Security, Infrastructure Engineering and Operations teams, and MSP partners.
 Establish prioritization, and escalation processes supporting timely remediation of infrastructure vulnerabilities.
 Drive remediation of operating system, platform, and third-party software vulnerabilities across the enterprise infrastructure environment.
 Partner with Cyber Security to translate vulnerability management requirements into actionable Infrastructure remediation priorities.
 Drive increased automation of patch deployment and vulnerability remediation across supported infrastructure platforms.
 Partner with MSP providers responsible for operational patching activities to ensure execution aligns with enterprise security requirements, service-level expectations, and remediation timelines.
 Identify systemic barriers to vulnerability remediation and work across Engineering, Operations, Cyber Security, application teams, and technology partners to resolve them.
 Establish metrics and executive reporting for vulnerability backlog, remediation performance, patch compliance, exceptions, aging, and risk.
 Drive continuous improvement in patching coverage, remediation velocity, automation, and operational effectiveness.

 Infrastructure Automation: 
 Define and lead the Infrastructure automation strategy and roadmap.
 Own and advance enterprise Infrastructure automation capabilities, including Ansible Automation Platform and related automation technologies.
 Expand automation across server provisioning, configuration management, patching, compliance, vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, infrastructure operations, and service management processes.
 Partner with Infrastructure Engineering teams to identify high-value automation opportunities that improve reliability, security, speed, and operational efficiency.
 Establish automation standards, reusable capabilities, governance, and engineering practices that enable consistent adoption across Infrastructure.
 Reduce manual operational activities and improve service delivery through automation and orchestration.
 Establish metrics demonstrating automation adoption, operational efficiencies, risk reduction, and measurable business outcomes.

 AI & Emerging Infrastructure Automation: 
 ·       Evaluate emerging AI-enabled infrastructure management and automation capabilities applicable to enterprise Infrastructure.
 ·       Develop the roadmap for responsible adoption of AI capabilities that improve infrastructure operations, automation, compliance, vulnerability remediation, and service reliability.
 ·       Partner with enterprise architecture, Cyber Security, Cloud, Data and AI teams, and other technology organizations to ensure emerging Infrastructure AI capabilities align with enterprise standards and governance.
 ·       Identify practical use cases where AI and intelligent automation can reduce manual effort, accelerate issue identification and remediation, and improve operational decision-making.
 ·       Ensure emerging automation capabilities are introduced with appropriate security, controls, governance, and operational oversight.

 Leadership & Organizational Development: 
 Build and lead a high-performing organization responsible for Infrastructure compliance, controls, vulnerability remediation enablement, and automation.
 Establish clear accountability, priorities, performance expectations, and career development opportunities for team members.
 Develop technical and leadership capabilities across the organization.
 Promote a culture of accountability, automation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and risk awareness.

 Minimum Job Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities): 
 Education/Training –
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree or professional certifications in related areas preferred.

 Specialized Knowledge/Skills – 

 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise Infrastructure, technology operations, automation, cyber security, risk, compliance, or related disciplines.
 Strong understanding of enterprise Infrastructure technologies including compute, operating systems, storage, backup, databases, virtualization, data centers, cloud infrastructure, and related technology services.
 Experience leading teams responsible for infrastructure operations, automation, compliance, controls, vulnerability management, or related technology capabilities.
 Demonstrated experience supporting SOX, SOC, internal audit, external audit, or comparable technology control environments.
 Experience with enterprise vulnerability and patch management programs.
 Experience operating in an outsourced or managed services environment and holding service providers accountable for operational outcomes.
 Experience with enterprise automation platforms such as Ansible Automation Platform and related orchestration technologies.
 Understanding of emerging AI and intelligent automation capabilities applicable to Infrastructure operations.
 Strong analytical, executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
 Strong knowledge of ITIL / IT Service Management practices (incident, problem, change, service level management).

 Hybrid work type

 Large percent of time performing computer based work is required.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform
jobs.description:
About Miovision: 
 At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!
 All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

 One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

 Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

 Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

 Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

 Position Summary: 
 At Miovision, we are engineering the future of smart transportation, and right now, we are laying down the asphalt for our most ambitious infrastructure project yet. We are building a governed, API-first technology platform that will act as the ultimate express lane for how we build software, enabling new experiences for customers, partners, and AI agents. We are looking for a Senior Director, Platform to serve as the master traffic controller for this massive transformation. Reporting to the SVP of Software Engineering & Technology, you will build the foundational highways that our entire product ecosystem travels on. You will steer our engineering organization away from gridlocked, application-centric development and into a high-speed, contract-driven future. If you are a hands-on leader ready to pave the way for AI-assisted innovation and ensure our platform capabilities always get the green light, it is time to take the wheel!

 Objectives and Responsibilities: 
 Platform Strategy & Architectural Foundation 
 Own the engineering strategy and translate our Platform North Star into clear architectural priorities for both human and AI-driven use cases.

 Spearhead the transition from application-centric integration toward a governed, contract-driven, API-first platform.

 Partner with Architecture to establish a durable technical foundation that protects long-term integrity while pragmatically supporting near-term delivery.

 Drive an engineering culture where teams naturally build on the platform because it is the absolute fastest and most effective path to delivering value.

 Organizational Leadership & Scaling 
 Lead, coach, and aggressively grow the Platform Engineering organization by recruiting top-tier talent with deep expertise in APIs, distributed systems, and AI.

 Build a highly resilient team culture grounded in ownership, curiosity, technical excellence, and high-velocity delivery.

 Lead the shift toward platform-first ways of working, building alignment, adoption, and accountability across the broader Engineering department.

 Create an environment where senior engineers are highly empowered to make decisions while remaining perfectly aligned with a shared architectural direction.

 Platform as a Product (First-Party, Third-Party & Ecosystem Enablement) 
 Partner with Product Leadership to operate the Platform exactly like a customer-facing product, treating internal developers, external partners, and AI agents as your core customers.

 Establish API contracts as first-class products that natively support authentication, observability, usage metering, and scalable commercial models from day one.

 Build a governed, unified entry point for Miovision's strategic capabilities, utilizing adoption data and developer feedback to continuously improve the ecosystem.

 Identify and build reusable, standardized capabilities—partnering with Data Science to integrate models and data products—eliminating isolated alternatives across the company.

 Technical Leadership & Hands-On Builder 
 Remain deeply engaged in the technology—reviewing architecture, exploring code, and prototyping solutions alongside your engineers to blast through ambiguity.

 Build the technical foundations for AI-assisted development, personally utilizing modern agentic tools and establishing AI-native practices across your team.

 Partner with Developer Operations to build automation and tooling that makes standardized, scalable architecture the absolute easiest path for our engineers.

 Bring razor-sharp technical judgment to complex distributed systems, helping teams practically evolve existing architecture without requiring massive, disruptive rewrites.

 Operational Excellence, Reliability & Trust 
 Establish world-class reliability, observability, security, and operational readiness as the fundamental DNA of all Platform capabilities.

 Ensure human and agent identity, delegated authorization, auditability, and guardrails are natively built into the platform rather than siloed across individual teams.

 Define strict lifecycle, compatibility, and service health standards so consumers can depend on Platform services with absolute confidence.

 Ensure the Platform seamlessly scales alongside Miovision’s rapidly growing products, customer base, and engineering organization without multiplying operational complexity.

 The Ideal Profile: 
 The Engineering Veteran: You bring 15+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on platform engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale architecture.

 The Organization Builder: You have a proven track record of successfully leading, scaling, and coaching senior engineering teams in highly complex, multi-product environments.

 The API Architect: You boast deep technical expertise in API design, microservices, contract governance, and full API lifecycle management.

 The Platform Product Thinker: You treat platforms exactly like a product. Experience monetizing a platform, scaling a marketplace, or building a third-party developer ecosystem is strongly preferred.

 The AI-Native Leader: You have hands-on experience executing platform strategies that fundamentally change how engineering teams use AI to build, verify, and deliver software (including exposure to MCP and machine-readable interfaces).

 The Hands-On Builder: You are a highly credible technical leader who is just as comfortable exploring code and prototyping a solution as you are driving an executive strategy meeting.

 The Cloud Heavyweight: You have deep, practical familiarity with cloud-native architectures (AWS), Kubernetes, modern CI/CD, and languages like Java, Python, or Node.js.

 The Transformation Driver: You have demonstrated experience successfully driving massive architectural or engineering operating-model shifts within an organization.

 The Operations Sentinel: You possess a profound understanding of reliability, telemetry, security, and operational excellence in massive, high-stakes production systems.

 The Strategic Diplomat: You wield excellent communication and influence skills, capable of partnering flawlessly with Product Management, Architecture, and C-suite stakeholders.

 The Pragmatic Visionary: You excel at systems thinking—perfectly balancing the need for long-term architectural integrity with the reality of pragmatic, incremental delivery.

 Your Rewards & Well-being: 
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.
 Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

 Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

 Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

 Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

 Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together! 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.
 Miovision may use artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the hiring process for tasks such as helping to identify qualified candidates, taking meeting notes, creating summaries, and streamlining administrative work. These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions. 
 PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.
 To all recruitment agencies: Miovision does not accept agency solicitation or resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our HR alias e-mail address, to any Miovision employee, or to other Miovision e-mail addresses. Miovision will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
Who We Are 

 At Momentum Financial Services Group, we help people move forward by reimagining how money works for those who need it most. With more than 40 years of experience, we’re the team behind Money Mart—Canada’s largest non-bank branch network—and a leader in financial solutions for underserved communities.

 From short-term loans to money transfers and prepaid cards, we power the products, technology, and operations that connect over a million customers a year to the money they need, when they need it.

 At MFSG, we come together across teams and departments to create something bigger than ourselves: solutions that remove barriers and give people access to money they might not get anywhere else. Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

 We’ve Got You Covered 

 Compensation Philosophy: Our strategy is designed to attract and retain top talent by offering competitive, fair, and performance-driven rewards. We benchmark against the market, recognize strong performance and continuously evolve to meet the needs of our people and our business.

 Discretionary Annual Bonus: Enjoy the opportunity for a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company success.

 Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits include health and dental plans with 100% of the premiums covered. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being and provide resources for personal challenges.

 Retirement Plans: Plan for your future with our robust retirement savings options, ensuring you’re set for the long haul.

 Hybrid Work Environment: Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model, allowing you to balance remote work with in-office.

 Perks and Rewards: Enjoy reimbursement for tuition assistance and professional development, discounts through Perkopolis and participate in our rewards and recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

 What You’ll Do 

 The Job:  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management

 As the  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management, you will serve as the organization’s designated authority and strategic leader for enterprise data architecture. Working across major business and technology initiatives, you will influence key decisions and lead the evolution of the enterprise data systems architecture, enterprise data model, and Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities.

 This leadership role is accountable for setting the strategic direction for data and establishing the standards, patterns, information models, and architecture review processes that govern how data is designed, integrated, and managed across the enterprise. Through this work, you will enable trusted, scalable, and reusable information assets that support business operations, analytics, digital initiatives, and AI capabilities.

 What You’ll Do 

 Provide architectural leadership and design oversight across major projects, programs, and technology initiatives that impact enterprise data.

 Partner with business and technology leaders to define future-state data capabilities and architecture roadmaps aligned with strategic priorities.

 Define and lead the organization’s Master Data Management (MDM) strategy, architecture, and roadmap, beginning with customer data and expanding across additional domains.

 Own and evolve the enterprise canonical data model and business information architecture to improve consistency, interoperability, reuse, and scalability.

 Establish and govern enterprise data architecture standards, design patterns, information models, reference architectures, and architecture review processes.

 Lead enterprise data modeling, metadata architecture, information lifecycle management, and related architectural practices.

 Evaluate emerging technologies, data platforms, and AI capabilities to strengthen the enterprise data architecture and create business value.

 Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Data Architects, Data Modelers, and Data Engineers..

 What You’ll Bring 

 Required Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.

 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise data architecture, information architecture, data modeling, and information management.

 Proven success influencing enterprise-wide business and technology decisions through architectural leadership.

 Experience partnering with Enterprise, Solution, and Cloud Architects to establish end-to-end architecture strategies.

 Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise data standards, architecture patterns, and governance processes.

 Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling.

 Experience leading Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives and enterprise information management programs.

 Experience developing enterprise information models, integration standards, and reference architectures.

 Proven ability to collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to define future-state architecture roadmaps.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Master’s degree in a related discipline.

 Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.

 Experience designing or supporting modern cloud-based data platforms, preferably Snowflake.

 Experience with modern data transformation and modeling practices using dbt or similar technologies.

 Experience enabling AI, advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and digital transformation initiatives.

 Experience building and leading architecture or information management teams.

 Committed to Equal Opportunity: 

 MFSG is committed to accommodating applicants up to the point of undue hardship during the recruitment, assessment and selection process. If you are selected for an interview, please notify MFSG if you require accommodation in respect of the materials or procedures used at any time during this process. If you require accommodation, MFSG will work with you to determine how to meet your needs.
  

 About MFSG – Our Commitment to Responsible Innovation

 At MFSG, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada’s Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable.

 This posting is for a current position within our organization, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, responsible innovation that supports our employees, clients, and communities. 

 We prioritize strong data governance, clear communication around how systems work, and safeguards that reduce risks and protect individuals. Our focus is on developing tools and processes that promote equity, reliability, and trust, supported by ongoing monitoring and continuous improvement.

 Joining MFSG means contributing to a future-focused organization that values both innovation and integrity, where your work helps shape solutions that responsibly support our employees, clients, and communities.

 Develop and mature cybersecurity governance programs, policies, standards, and procedures

 Improve GRC processes, workflows, and governance effectiveness

 Personally execute critical deliverables in a hands-on leadership capacity

 Balance business objectives with practical, risk-based governance and security controls

 What You’ll Bring to the Table 

 10+ years of experience in information security, cybersecurity, technology risk, or IT controls

 At least 5 years of direct GRC experience, including 3+ years in a leadership capacity

 Experience within banking, fintech, insurance, payments, wealth management, or another regulated financial services environment

 Proven success operating as a senior individual contributor with ownership of risk assessments, governance documentation, executive reporting, and remediation tracking

 Strong understanding of enterprise cyber risk management, governance, and compliance practices

 Extensive experience with data governance risk management, privacy controls, and information asset protection

 Experience managing cyber risk registers, risk reviews, issue management, and remediation programs

 Strong knowledge of Canadian financial sector regulatory expectations, operational resilience principles, and privacy obligations

 Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical issues into clear business risk language

 Education + Experience 

 Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews, customer security assessments, and control testing activities

 Strong understanding of identity and access management, data protection, cloud security, vulnerability management, incident response, third-party risk, and business continuity

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience within a Canadian regulated financial institution or fintech organization

 Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor

 Experience implementing or enhancing GRC platforms, workflow automation, and reporting dashboards

 Familiarity with PCI DSS, SOC 2, cloud control frameworks, and privacy control frameworks

 Experience mapping controls across multiple regulatory and compliance frameworks

 Closing 

 Ready to lead cybersecurity governance and influence enterprise risk decisions across a growing organization? Join us and help strengthen the security, resilience, and compliance foundation of MFSG.

Director, Quantitative Data Products 

 Nasdaq's Alternative Data group specializes in creating unique and insightful data products from non-traditional data sources. Well-known examples of Alternative Data include sentiment measures, real-time tracking of vehicles via GPS transponders, satellite monitoring of industrial facilities, and consumer insights gleaned from anonymized credit card transactions. Our data products empower some of the world's most sophisticated investment funds to outperform. 

 As Director of Quantitative Data Products, you'll play a critical role in defining strategy and driving execution of a portfolio of innovative Alternative Data products. You'll thrive in this position if you're entrepreneurial, data-driven, and strategic, with a deep understanding of investments and a passion for creating products that generate real business impact in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. The ideal candidate has trade floor and/or investments experience, with a strong understanding of buy-side and sell-side trading workflows. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Conduct market research and engage directly with clients to identify new product opportunities and validate concepts.

 Own the full product lifecycle from ideation and validation through launch, scale, and ongoing optimization.

 Develop and prioritize product roadmaps that align with business objectives and drive measurable revenue growth.

 Partner with cross-functional teams including data science, data engineering, partnerships, client success, sales, and marketing to design and deliver innovative data products.

 Drive go-to-market strategy, including pricing, positioning, and sales enablement to maximize product adoption and success.

 Required Qualifications 
 10+ years of experience in product management, product development, and/or data analysis within the investment industry.

 Deep understanding of capital markets, data product fundamentals, and data feeds/products.

 Proven ability to conceptualize and drive new initiatives from 0-to-1 in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.

 Excellent communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and a revenue-focused, owner mindset.

 Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Strong understanding of the alternative data landscape, including key companies and products/services, as well as their competitive positioning.

 Experienced in evaluating and applying alternative data to the investment lifecycle (i.e., programming, statistics, backtesting, etc).

 0-to-1 startup or venture-building experience.

 This position will be located in Toronto and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.

 Come as You Are 

 Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.

 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.

 What We Offer

The base pay range for this role is $121,000 - $170,000. In addition to base salary, Nasdaq provides a generous annual bonus/commission (short-term incentive), and equity (long-term incentive), comprehensive benefits, and opportunity for growth. Exact compensation may vary based on several job-related factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: skill set, experience, education/training, business needs and market demands.

The Integrated Care + SNF Reimbursement portfolio spans the connected workflows that carry a resident from referral through care delivery to payment: including, acute and payer care collaboration on the National Care Collaboration Network and Audacious platforms, Secure Conversations across our customer segments, practitioner EHR solutions, SNF admissions and managed care workflows, and SNF revenue cycle and reimbursement optimization.

The Outbound Product Management team within this portfolio is the bridge between strategic customer relationships, go-to-market execution, and product direction. The team is remote and hybrid across the US and Canada, and works shoulder to shoulder with inbound Product Management, Engineering, and every GTM function.

Position Summary

This role owns product delivery and growth for the Integrated Care + SNF Reimbursement portfolio, carrying accountability for how validated offerings reach the market and convert into adoption, revenue, and reference customers. The VP defines and drives end-to-end go-to-market strategy across the portfolio, co-owns roadmap and investment decisions with inbound Product Management, and owns the commercial model — pricing, packaging, and monetization — for new and AI-enabled capabilities.

The VP leads the portfolio's Outbound Product Management function, building and developing the team that runs launch, enablement, and early adoption. They represent PointClickCare’s product function externally as a market figurehead with SNF, payer, practitioner, and acute customers and across the industry, and internally as a trusted advisor to the SVP, Product Management and the GTM leadership team.

Success is measured in growth outcomes: revenue and adoption attainment against portfolio targets, speed from launch to first reference customer, and the repeatable sales motions that turn early wins into scale.

Go-To-Market Strategy & Portfolio Growth: Own end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the portfolio from launch through scale. Define the growth thesis for each product line, set adoption and revenue targets with Sales and Revenue Operations, and drive cross-functional accountability for attainment.
Commercial Model & Monetization: Lead pricing, packaging, and monetization strategy for new and AI-enabled capabilities, including usage-based pricing, tiered access, and enterprise licensing. Partner with Pricing, Finance, and Revenue Operations on scalable models that protect margin.
Product Strategy & Roadmap: Partner with inbound Product Management leaders to shape portfolio direction, translating customer feedback, competitive signals, and adoption data into roadmap and investment recommendations. Serve as the commercial voice in portfolio planning and trade-off decisions.
Executive Customer Engagement & Market Leadership: Build executive relationships across strategic SNF, payer, practitioner, and acute accounts. Lead beta and co-development programs that generate real-world proof points, and represent PointClickCare with customers, industry bodies, and analysts.
Organizational Leadership & Talent Development: Lead and grow the Outbound Product Management function, including leaders of teams. Hire, coach, and develop talent, establish operating cadence and standards aligned with the product development lifecycle and go-to-market model, and foster accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Portfolio Performance & Market Insight: Define and track portfolio, customer engagement, and go-to-market KPIs. Lead competitive analysis, customer research, and thought leadership, and partner with legal, compliance, and governance teams to support responsible deployment of AI-enabled capabilities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

12+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or product growth, including 5+ years leading teams at the Director level or above.
Demonstrated ownership of go-to-market strategy for a multi-product portfolio, with accountability for adoption and revenue outcomes beyond launch execution.
Proven success building commercial models for SaaS and AI-enabled products, including pricing, packaging, and monetization, with fluency in ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV, and churn.
Executive presence and demonstrated ability to influence and align senior leaders across Sales, Sales Enablement, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Solutions, Pricing, and Professional Services.
Experience leading leaders, including hiring, developing, and scaling teams through organizational change.
Strong data-driven decision-making skills, using qualitative and quantitative signals to set priorities and make defensible trade-offs.
Ability to travel regularly to strategic customer sites and industry events, with occasional travel to PointClickCare offices.

Preferred Experience

Background in post-acute care, senior care, or payer-provider collaboration models.
Experience taking AI-enabled products to market, including generative AI, large language model, and agentic capabilities.
Familiarity with interoperability, care transitions, and referral and authorization workflows.

jobs.title: Head of Toronto AI Center
jobs.description:
Lab Summary: 

 Samsung Research America (SRA) develops next-generation technologies in software, user experience, and services for future products. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with locations across North America, we partner with industry and academia to translate research and innovation into tangible outcomes. We lead in machine intelligence by building AI that is user-centric and physically grounded—AI that understands not just what users want, but their physical context and environment.

 Samsung is uniquely positioned to bring this vision to life through nearly 500 million connected devices we sell annually. Our mission is to holistically integrate AI into connected ecosystems—homes, offices, robotics, and beyond—creating a platform that scales quickly while providing deep contextual understanding and spatial awareness.

   The AI Center in Toronto, Canada plays a pivotal role in developing next-generation software, user experiences, and intelligent services that enrich consumers’ lives. This lab actively contributes to the international research community through publications and presentations at major conferences.

   Areas of Research: 

 Computer Vision

 Contextual/Multi-Modal Modeling

 3D Perception & Scene Understanding

 Inference and Reasoning

 Machine and Deep Learning

 Human Computer Interaction (HCI)

 Natural Language Processing

 Position Summary: 

 Samsung’s AI research team in Toronto is looking for an outstanding and highly self-motivated leader to head the lab. The candidates should have extensive expertise in deep learning, computer vision and physics-based AI.

 The AI research center is a key part of Samsung’s global R&D effort and aims to have direct impact on future Samsung products reaching hundreds of millions of users globally. The candidate will work with a team of research scientists and engineers tackling real-world problems involving Samsung’s Artificial intelligence products. The candidate can also have the opportunity to publish at top-tier conferences in deep learning, computer vision, and language understanding.

 Position Responsibilities: 

 Build, manage, develop, lead, and support the AI research team, with the outcome of high-impact research insights that influence the product roadmap

 Present research findings and insights both within and outside of the company

 Serve as a thought partner with the executive, cross-functional, and line of business leadership teams

 Be an evangelist of research practices throughout the company, influencing partner teams

 Drive innovation programs within the relevant fields of Artificial Intelligence,

 Serve as the external face for the AI Research Lab’s advanced technology capabilities

 Drive key University technology collaboration program to build long term innovation partnerships

 Lead Technology Pathfinding to understand key technology trends and impact for Samsung, to help drive growth and new business opportunities for Samsung

   Required Skills: 

 PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

 10+ years of post-PhD experience leading advanced AI research.

 Deep expertise in vision and multimodal AI and agentic AI (autonomous agents, reasoning, decision-making), plus strong foundations in computer vision, image/video processing, and generative AI applications.

 Significant experience of publishing relevant peer-reviewed articles on artificial intelligence

 Strong algorithmic problem-solving skills, and the ability to program in C/C++, Python, Java, etc.

 Experience in publishing scientific papers in top quality conferences/journals (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, ACL, SIGGRAPH, CoRL, etc.)

 Experience in DL library such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, etc. with strong hands on experience is required

 Experience working with GPU, parallel programming, and Simulation environments is a plus

 Experience in Android development and graphic rendering is a plus

 Ability to work as a team, motivation for international collaboration, strong communication skills, self-motivated, proactive, flexible and passionate about learning

 Ability to work well in a fast-paced global team environment

 Strong network of relationships with entrepreneurs, VC’s industry executives, and technology thought leaders

 Strong presentation skills and excellent interpersonal skills

 Additional Information 

 Disclosure of Trade Secrets 

 Samsung has a strict policy on trade secrets. In applying to Samsung and progressing through the recruitment process, you must not disclose any trade secrets of a current or previous employer.

 Essential Job Functions 

 This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, and frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact the recruiter or email sratalent@samsung.com.
