jobs.description:
About us 
 Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
 We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
 Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

jobs.title: Director, Data Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Work Location: 
Toronto, Ontario, Canada 
 Hours: 
37.5 
 Line of Business: 
Technology Solutions 
 Pay Details: 
$165,000 - $200,000 CAD 

This role is eligible for a discretionary variable compensation award that considers business and individual performance. 
 TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

 As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

 Job Description: 

 Transform How Global Transaction Banking Leverages Data, Analytics & AI 

 As the  Director, Data Platform Engineering, you will define and execute the strategy, architecture, and engineering roadmap for the  Global Transaction Banking (GTB) Data Platform. Built on  Databricks, the platform serves as the foundation for next-generation data products, advanced analytics, AI-driven insights, regulatory reporting, and mission-critical transaction banking capabilities.
 You will lead high-performing engineering teams responsible for building secure, scalable, and resilient data solutions while establishing modern engineering practices, platform standards, and delivery excellence across the organization. This role requires a technology leader who combines deep expertise in data engineering and distributed systems with a passion for developing talent, driving innovation, and delivering business outcomes at scale.

 Mandate:  Own the strategy, engineering delivery, and operational excellence of the GTB Data Platform, enabling trusted data, advanced analytics, AI innovation, and next-generation transaction banking capabilities through a modern Databricks-powered ecosystem.

 Key Accountabilities 

 Strategy & Platform Leadership 
 Define and execute the strategic roadmap for the GTB Data Platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enterprise technology strategy.
 Lead the evolution of the Databricks platform, establishing a scalable, secure, and resilient foundation for analytics, data products, AI, and operational workloads.
 Drive platform modernization, engineering transformation, automation, and AI-enabled development practices.
 Establish engineering and data architecture standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for data, APIs, integration, and platform services.
 Partner with business, product, architecture, security, infrastructure, and operations leaders to prioritize investments and accelerate business outcomes.

 Engineering & Delivery Leadership 
 Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for data platforms, data products, APIs, streaming services, and cloud-native applications.
 Oversee end-to-end delivery of strategic technology initiatives, ensuring quality, scalability, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
 Provide technical leadership and oversight for architecture, system design, engineering standards, and modernization initiatives.
 Drive engineering excellence through adoption of DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, reliability engineering, and platform engineering practices.
 Act as the senior escalation point for critical engineering, platform, operational, and delivery issues.

 Data & Technology Leadership 
 Champion modern data architecture practices, including data products, event-driven architectures, real-time processing, and distributed computing.
 Ensure effective governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, and platform observability across the GTB ecosystem.
 Drive adoption of data and AI capabilities that improve operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and business decision-making.
 Promote reuse, standardization, and scalability of platform capabilities across GTB technology domains.

 Financial, Vendor & Governance Management 
 Accountable for platform investment planning, budget management, forecasting, and delivery performance.
 Manage strategic vendor relationships and global delivery partners to achieve business and engineering objectives.
 Establish governance processes, performance metrics, and operational controls to ensure transparency and predictable outcomes.
 Identify and manage strategic technology, delivery, security, and operational risks.

 People Leadership 
 Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers, architects, principal engineers, and senior technical talent.
 Build a high-performing engineering organization focused on innovation, accountability, customer value, and technical excellence.
 Drive workforce planning, succession management, capability development, and organizational growth.
 Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, ownership, and engineering craftsmanship.

 Required Skills & Experience 

 Leadership & Technology Management 
 12+ years of progressive technology experience with significant experience leading large engineering teams and complex technology portfolios.
 Proven success leading engineering managers, architects, and senior technical professionals.
 Strong executive stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
 Experience managing budgets, strategic investments, vendors, and large-scale transformation initiatives.

 Data Platform Engineering 
 Deep expertise designing, building, and operating enterprise-scale data platforms.
 Extensive experience with  Databricks, including platform architecture, engineering, optimization, governance, and operational management.
 Strong experience with  Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and large-scale distributed data processing frameworks.
 Deep understanding of modern data architecture, data products, metadata management, lineage, governance, and data lifecycle management.
 Experience building and scaling analytical, operational, and AI-ready data platforms.

 Engineering & Architecture 
 Strong foundation in modern programming languages ( Java,  Python ) and API design ( REST,  GraphQL ).
 Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
 Strong experience with  Microsoft Azure  and cloud-native platform delivery.
 Experience with container orchestration ( Kubernetes ) and DevSecOps / CI/CD practices.
 Proven experience building event-driven, real-time data architectures at enterprise scale.
 Working knowledge of  Generative AI,  LLMs, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

 Nice to Have 
 Hands-on experience with streaming technologies such as  Kafka,  Confluent,  Solace, or  Apache Flink.
 Familiarity with graph or document data models ( Neo4J,  MongoDB ).
 Experience with observability tooling such as  Splunk,  Dynatrace, or  Datadog.
 Exposure to  OpenShift  or other enterprise Kubernetes distributions.

 Success Profile 

 The successful candidate will:
 Define and execute the vision for the GTB Data Platform.
 Scale and modernize a Databricks-centric data ecosystem.
 Build and lead world-class data and platform engineering teams.
 Deliver secure, resilient, and scalable data products and services.
 Advance AI, analytics, and data-driven business capabilities.
 Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and accountability.
 Influence technology strategy and transformation outcomes across Global Transaction Banking.

 Why Join Us 
 This is a highly visible leadership role with the opportunity to shape the future of data, analytics, and AI across Global Transaction Banking. You will lead the evolution of a strategic Databricks-powered platform, build exceptional engineering teams, and drive transformative outcomes that directly impact clients, products, and business growth.

 Team:  You will lead distributed engineering teams across  New York,  Toronto, and  Bangalore, with global reach and cross-functional partners across the enterprise.

 #LI-TECH

 Who We Are: 
 TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple.  Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.  

 Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.  

 Our Total Rewards Package 
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more 

 Additional Information: 
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

 Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

 Colleague Development 
 If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities. 

 If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.  

 We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

 Training & Onboarding 
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

 Interview Process  
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

 Accommodation 
Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: VP Technology & Innovation
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global virtual care leader, offering comprehensive virtual care solutions spanning virtual care including primary, mental health, expert medical, devices and licensed platform services. Teladoc Health serves the world's leading insurers, employers, and health systems and helps millions of people around the world resolve their healthcare needs with confidence. Serving over 9 million Canadians, Teladoc Health has been in Canada for more than 20 years and operates in 175 countries world-wide.

 Position Summary 

 The Vice President, Technology and Innovation (“VP”) is responsible for defining and executing Teladoc Health Canada’s technology, product, innovation and cybersecurity strategy. The VP leads the development and delivery of Teladoc Health Canada's digital products and technology ecosystem, including product management, software engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data and analytics, technology operations, and innovation. The role is accountable for building a secure, reliable, scalable, and modern technology environment that enables high-quality virtual and hybrid care, an exceptional client, clinician, and patient experience, and operational excellence.

 The VP provides executive leadership for Teladoc Health Canada's digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap, ensuring technology investments and product capabilities align with Canadian market needs, regulatory requirements, enterprise priorities, and Teladoc Health's global strategy. Working closely with clinical, commercial, operations, legal, privacy, compliance, and global technology leaders, the VP plays a key role in advancing Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework and responsible use of data and AI, while delivering technology solutions that drive revenue growth, innovation, quality of care, security, and operational efficiency.

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

 Technology Strategy & Delivery 
 Develop and refresh Teladoc Health Canada’s digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap aligned with organizational strategy and business objectives;

 Provide secure, scalable, resilient and sustainable digital solutions and technology infrastructure that meet Canadian business, market and regulatory requirements;

 Lead the strategy, design, development, delivery, and lifecycle management of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem, including enterprise architecture, applications, integrations, infrastructure, and digital platforms;

 Develop and execute Teladoc Health Canada’s cybersecurity strategy, ensuring appropriate security controls, resilience, and cybersecurity risk management across technology platforms and information assets

 Own the budget, portfolio, and project management of digital initiatives and ongoing technology operations, ensuring disciplined prioritization, resource allocation, and value delivery; and

 Develop and manage strategic relationships with technology partners and vendors.

 Product Strategy & Delivery 
 Lead Teladoc Canada’s multi-year product roadmap to enable operational excellence, high-quality clinical care, commercial growth, and exceptional client, clinician and patient experiences;

 Translate market, regulatory, clinical, and operational requirements into innovative digital products;

 Champion user-centred design by incorporating the perspectives of clients, clinicians, patients, and internal users throughout the product lifecycle to deliver intuitive, accessible, and seamless digital experiences; and

 Integrate customer feedback, clinical insights, analytics, and user research into product planning, development and continuous improvement.

 Data, Analytics & AI Enablement 
 Lead the operational implementation of Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework, including data architecture, stewardship, quality, metadata, lifecycle management, and data governance technologies, in partnership with the legal, privacy and compliance teams, and business stakeholders.

 Champion enterprise analytics, business intelligence, and AI-enabled capabilities that support operational excellence, clinical quality, innovation, and informed business decision-making.

jobs.title: Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.  

 At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

 Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

 Position Summary 
 We are seeking a Director, Platform Engineering & DevOps to lead the development and maturation of our enterprise Platform Engineering organization.

 This leader will be responsible for building a modern, automation-first platform primarily focused on Microsoft Azure, while supporting remaining legacy workloads in AWS and on-premises data centers during the company's migration to Azure.

 The Director will lead the Platform Engineering team and partner closely with Network Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and application Engineering to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and highly automated infrastructure platforms.

 A key objective of this role is to move the organization toward a self-service Platform Engineering model, enabling application teams to deploy and manage infrastructure using standardized patterns, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and cloud governance.

 Role and Responsibilities 
 Build, lead, and develop the Platform Engineering organization, including engineering strategy, roadmap, standards, and operating model.
 Lead the design and evolution of the company's enterprise Microsoft Azure platform, including landing zones, governance, identity, networking, security, observability, and resiliency.

 Support the migration of applications and infrastructure from AWS and on-premises environments to Azure.

 Establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation as the standard approach for provisioning and managing infrastructure.

 Develop reusable Terraform modules, CI/CD pipelines, reference architectures, and standardized deployment patterns.

 Build self-service platform capabilities and "golden paths" that improve developer productivity and reduce manual infrastructure provisioning.

 Partner with Network Engineering on hybrid cloud connectivity, cloud networking, Private Link, DNS, routing, firewalls, and application delivery.

 Partner with SRE to establish platform availability objectives, observability standards, resiliency practices, incident improvements, and operational readiness, leveraging Datadog Application

 Partner with SRE and Application Engineering to establish consistent standards for application and platform telemetry, including metrics, logs, distributed traces, dashboards, alerting, and service-level monitoring.

 Ensure cloud and platform services are appropriately instrumented and integrated with the enterprise observability platform.

 Partner with Security to implement secure-by-default platform patterns, cloud governance, policy enforcement, and compliance controls.

 Establish cloud cost-management and FinOps practices across Azure and remaining AWS environments.

 Recruit, mentor, and develop engineering leaders and senior technical talent.

 Provide executive-level communication regarding platform strategy, technology risks, investments, reliability, and cloud transformation progress.

 Required Qualifications 
 10+ years of progressive experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, Platform Engineering, systems engineering, or related disciplines, including significant engineering leadership experience.

 Deep technical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including enterprise cloud architecture, networking, security, governance, resiliency, and platform services.

 Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation, particularly Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based engineering workflows.

 Demonstrated experience leading complex cloud transformation initiatives, including hybrid environments, enterprise cloud migrations, or modernization of mission-critical infrastructure.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience building or leading an enterprise Platform Engineering organization or Internal Developer Platform.

 Working knowledge of AWS and experience supporting or migrating AWS workloads.

 Experience with Azure Landing Zones, Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Well-Architected Framework, and Azure Verified Modules.

 Experience with Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

 Experience with GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, GitHub Actions or comparable DevOps platforms.

 Experience with enterprise observability and APM platforms, preferably Datadog, and technologies such as OpenTelemetry.

 Experience implementing SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, resiliency engineering, and incident management.

 Experience implementing cloud FinOps and cost optimization practices.

 Experience operating technology platforms in healthcare, SaaS, financial services, or another regulated environment.

 Success Metrics for the Role 
 Success will be measured by the Director's ability to build a scalable Platform Engineering organization and improve the speed, reliability, security, and efficiency of infrastructure delivery.
 Increased percentage of infrastructure deployed and managed through Infrastructure as Code.

 Increased adoption of standardized Azure landing zones, reusable platform services, and self-service capabilities.

 Reduced infrastructure provisioning and application deployment lead times.

 Progress migrating targeted AWS and on-premises workloads to Azure.

 Improved platform availability and achievement of defined SLOs.

 Increased adoption and effectiveness of standardized observability and APM practices across platform and application services, including improved service visibility and reduced mean time to detect and restore.

 Reduction in infrastructure-related incidents, configuration drift, and manual production changes.

 Improved developer satisfaction and adoption of Platform Engineering services.

 Improved cloud governance, security compliance, and cost efficiency.

 Successful recruitment, development, and retention of a high-performing Platform Engineering team.

 As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

 Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission. 

 Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.

 Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.

 Strategy: Set the practice vision and align Data & AI capabilities to where enterprise demand is heading.

 P&L: Own revenue targets, margin, and growth while being accountable for the practice's full commercial performance.

 Talent & Culture: Build a practice where data-driven thinking, innovation, and engineering rigour are the baseline.

 Client Impact: Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise CxOs navigating data strategy, AI adoption, and governance.

 Responsibilities 
 Define the multi-year vision for the Data Engineering Practice, ensuring our technical capabilities are ahead of the curve for enterprise demand for Data & AI transformation.

 Own the full P&L, including pipeline, pricing, delivery margin, and revenue growth, while reporting directly to executive leadership with clear commercial accountability.

 Build and sustain senior relationships with Google Cloud partner teams and client executives to generate meaningful deal flow and expand strategic accounts.

 Lead the practice's position on ethical AI and data democratisation while making principled, evidence-based bets on where advanced analytics and AI are creating real enterprise value.

 Set the standard for engineering and analytical excellence across the practice by hiring well, developing talent deliberately, and building teams that clients trust and return to.

 12+ years in data or AI consulting, including at least 3–5 years in a practice leadership or executive role, not just senior delivery or individual contribution.

 Data and AI ecosystem depth: Strong command of modern data architecture, AI, and ML trends, cloud-native data platforms, and enterprise data governance.

 Business Development track record: Experience generating pipeline and closing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements, not just managing delivery once work is sold.

 Talent leadership: Has hired, grown, and retained senior data engineering and consulting talent in a practice or delivery organisation.

jobs.title: Managing Director - Data & AI (Montreal, Canada)
jobs.description:
Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organisations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 400 projects and have grown to 175+ talented individuals across 7 office locations.

 Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes. You can learn more about what we are passionate about at and on our you can find more useful information about our business and recruiting process.

 Are You the Leader We're Looking For?
 As a Managing Director at Unit8, success isn't just about closing deals — it's about becoming a cornerstone of how we grow and deliver in the Canadian market. You will own both sides of the equation: originating high-value client relationships and ensuring the work we deliver actually moves the needle for our clients. If you've built your career at the intersection of commercial impact and technical credibility, and you're ready to operate with real autonomy in an expert-led environment, this is the role.

 What Success Looks Like in This Role
 This is a senior leadership position for someone as comfortable originating a complex engagement as overseeing its delivery. You shape and close the deal, build relationships and trust, and you stay close enough to ensure the technical execution actually delivers value. You will succeed by:

 Building and converting a pipeline of high-value opportunities in the Canadian market — primarily in financial services — through a network earned over years of credible work in data & AI
 Selling from expertise: clients engage with you because you understand their problem because of your deep problem solving skills and experience not because you have a polished pitch
 Staying embedded in delivery long enough to set the right pace, challenge client assumptions, and keep teams focused on the actual business problem
 Bridging the gap between a senior data scientist and a C-suite conversation — translating technical constraints into strategic decisions and vice versa
 Raising the delivery bar by knowing what good looks like and holding teams to that standard

 What You'll Do
 Leverage your existing network to source, shape, and close high-value engagements in Canada (new logos, not just expansions)
 Translate complex business problems into concrete Data & AI solutions: identify where value can be created, make sure the team is building toward it, and hold the client accountable to realising it
 Lead and shape complex, tech-enabled transformations — from early problem definition through to scaled delivery — ensuring the right technology choices serve the business outcome, not the other way around
 Act as the senior point of contact for key clients throughout delivery, ensuring technical execution stays anchored to business value
 Challenge clients when necessary — on scope, pace, and ambition
 Work closely with our engineering and data science teams, providing business context, removing blockers and coaching them.

jobs.title: Head of Data & AI
jobs.description:
About Burq 
 Burq started with an ambitious mission: to turn the complex process of offering delivery into a simple, turnkey solution. It’s a big mission, and now we want you to join us in making it even bigger. 🚀
 We’re proud to be recognized as one of Fast Company’s Best Workplaces for Innovators and a 2025 Inc. Magazine Power Partner, awards that highlight how we’re redefining the future of logistics while empowering our partners to grow.
 Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors like Village Global, the fund whose investors include Bill Gates, Jeff Bezos, Mark Zuckerberg, Reid Hoffman, and Sara Blakely, we’ve built a world-class team across the globe.
 We operate at scale but remain small enough for every person to have a massive impact. There’s a lot of important work ahead, and joining Burq means the opportunity to grow faster than ever while doing the most meaningful work of your career.

 Here’s a quick overview of what you will be doing:

 The Role
 We're looking for a Head of Data & AI to build the intelligence that powers Burq. 
 You'll build a world-class data-and-ML platform: the systems that turn data into models which make every delivery decision smarter and agents that automate the work the industry still does by hand. You'll set the strategy, make the hard architecture and modeling calls, ship models into production that move the business, and build the team to do it at scale.
 This is a player-coach role. You'll lead and grow the data and ML team while staying deeply hands-on — making architecture calls, reviewing engineering and modeling work, and ensuring the platform serves both product and business goals. You'll partner closely with the Head of Engineering, and with product and AI leadership on how intelligence shows up in the product.

 What You'll Do
 Data Platform

 Own the full data platform — the warehouse, streaming and batch ingestion, the semantic layer, and BI infrastructure.
 Define and enforce data governance — access management, quality standards, and a well-modeled, trustworthy "gold" layer.
 Make the warehouse the source of truth for operational, product, and financial analytics.

 Intelligence & Machine Learning 

 Build the models that power delivery intelligence — forecasting, prediction, optimization, matching/allocation, and reliability scoring that turn our data into better real-time decisions.
 Stand up the ML systems that make this real and reliable: feature pipelines, training, serving, evaluation, and drift monitoring.
 Design the learning loop — instrument decisions and outcomes so models continuously improve.
 Drive the AI agent initiative to production, partnering with product and engineering on the surrounding workflows.

 Team & Stakeholders

 Manage and grow the data and ML team (starting from a small core) — hire data engineers, analytics engineers, and data scientists/ML engineers as the platform matures.
 Establish a clear intake process for ad hoc data requests so the team works from a roadmap, not in reactive mode.
 Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance on data-driven analyses and decisions.

We are hiring
an Assistant
Vice President, Information Security

VP, Technology Governance, Risk and Performance

What We Offer

Highly competitive compensation package which includes, base salary, bonus, benefits, and career advancement opportunities!

Eligibility for benefits is dependent on the terms of employment

The Opportunity

The Assistant Vice President, Information Security is First National’s enterprise cybersecurity leader within Product and Technology. The role sets cybersecurity direction, operates the Information Security function, improves cyber resilience, and enables secure delivery across applications, infrastructure, cloud, identity, data, integrations, and AI.

The AVP combines technical credibility with executive leadership, sound risk judgment, and disciplined execution. The role initially reports to the Chief Product and Technology Officer and is expected to transition to the Vice President, Technology Governance, Risk and Performance as the target operating model is established, while retaining direct escalation access to the CPTO for material cyber incidents or risk exposures.

How You Will Contribute

Cybersecurity Strategy, Governance and Assurance

Define and execute the cybersecurity strategy and capability roadmap aligned to business priorities, technology modernization, risk appetite, client obligations, and the Product and Technology operating model.
Serve as the senior cybersecurity authority within Product and Technology, advising executives and governance forums on material risk, incidents, exceptions, investment priorities, and security performance. Operate first line cyber risk management while accountable business and technology owners remain responsible for remediation and residual risk decisions within delegated authority.
Maintain and continuously improve the Information Security Management System, policies, standards, control requirements, cybersecurity compliance activities, and performance measures. Maintain strong ISO 27001 aligned practices and support applicable regulatory, contractual, client, and internal policy requirements.
Lead the Information Security responsibilities for SOC 1 and SOC 2 audits and attestations, including security control ownership, evidence readiness, management responses, remediation, and external auditor support, in partnership with Technology Governance, Risk and Performance.
Own the security response to client questionnaires, due diligence, audits, assurance reviews, and control assessments from third party underwriting and servicing clients and strategic partners. Act as the senior security contact for client security teams and maintain reusable approved responses, control narratives, and evidence to improve speed and consistency.

Security Operations, Incident Response & Cyber Resilience

Lead security monitoring, managed detection and response, threat intelligence, detection engineering, incident response, and digital forensics coordination, with clear service levels and performance expectations for managed security providers.
Lead the technical cyber response during material incidents and coordinate with technology, business, legal, privacy, communications, risk, and other enterprise leaders on crisis management, notification, service recovery, and business continuity actions.
Maintain and test cyber incident playbooks, executive and technical exercises, and recovery scenarios, using incidents, threat intelligence, control testing, and exercises to drive continuous improvement and tracked corrective actions.

Security Engineering, Identity, Cloud and Application Security

Define practical security architecture standards, reusable patterns, Zero Trust principles, and minimum control requirements across cloud, infrastructure, networks, end user computing, applications, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and emerging technology.
Set identity security requirements across authentication, privileged access, access governance, conditional access, service identities, secrets, certificates, and excessive or persistent access, while partnering with Enterprise IT and Infrastructure on endpoint, network, cloud, logging, backup, and hardening controls.
Embed security into engineering practices and delivery pipelines through secure coding, threat modelling, dependency and secrets scanning, SAST, DAST, penetration testing, API security, software supply chain controls, and proportionate automated security gates.
Own the vulnerability and exposure management program, including discovery, risk prioritization, remediation standards, exception governance, validation, aging visibility, and escalation. Engineering, Infrastructure, and service owners remain accountable for remediation.
Prioritize material security debt in legacy and proprietary applications and use penetration testing, attack simulation, red team, or purple team techniques where they provide clear risk reduction or validate material controls.

AI, Data, Third Party and Human Risk

Define cybersecurity guardrails for AI and automation, including identity, sensitive data handling, secrets, model and prompt attack risks, third party AI services, logging, monitoring, abuse protection, and secure integration patterns, while partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, Privacy, Legal, and Risk on broader governance.
Set technical data protection requirements for access, leakage prevention, monitoring, and protection of sensitive customer and business information while data governance and privacy accountabilities remain with their respective owners.
Own the cybersecurity assessment, security requirements, risk recommendations, and monitoring components of critical third party and cloud service risk, while Procurement, vendor management, business owners, and Enterprise Risk retain their broader lifecycle accountabilities.
Lead an effective security awareness and human risk program using role based education and targeted interventions for higher risk populations and activities.

Leadership and Operating Performance

Build and lead a high performing Information Security team with clear accountabilities, modern technical depth, succession coverage, and a culture of ownership, transparency, and collaboration.
Define the security operating model, workforce plan, capability roadmap, and sourcing approach across internal capability, managed services, and specialist expertise.
Manage the security budget, tools, vendors, and service performance with clear linkage between spend, risk reduction, control effectiveness, remediation performance, incident response, and continuous improvement, rationalizing overlap where it adds cost or complexity without improving protection.

The Experience You Need

Leadership and Industry Experience

Significant progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, security engineering, or technology risk, typically including 12 or more years of relevant experience and several years leading multidisciplinary security teams or major enterprise security programs.
Demonstrated experience advising senior executives and making risk based decisions during material cyber incidents, significant technology changes, or major control issues.
Experience leading security through modernization, cloud adoption, managed service models, operating model change, or significant technology transformation. Experience in financial services, lending, payments, insurance, or another regulated and data intensive environment is strongly preferred.

Technical, Assurance and Regulatory Depth

Strong practical knowledge of security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, identity and privileged access, cloud security, application and API security, DevSecOps, data protection, third party security, security architecture, cyber resilience, and software supply chain security.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 security capabilities, with working familiarity across Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, Entra ID, Conditional Access, Purview, Intune, and GRC platforms used for cyber risk, controls, issues, evidence, audit, and assurance workflows.
Strong working knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, SOC control environments, Zero Trust principles, PIPEDA, applicable provincial privacy requirements, FSRA expectations where relevant, and client driven cyber expectations from regulated financial institutions, including relevant OSFI guidance where applicable through client or contractual obligations.
Practical understanding of AI security risks and controls and the ability to challenge technical designs and remediation plans credibly without needing to personally perform every engineering task.

Education, Communication and Judgment

Post-secondary degree or diploma in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, technology, risk management, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CCSP, or comparable credentials are preferred.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive presence, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to translate technical and regulatory risk into clear decisions, priorities, and accountabilities.
Demonstrated ability to work across Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Internal Audit, Human Resources, and business teams without creating unnecessary process or ambiguity.
Professional fluency in English is required; French is an asset.

Relationships

External Customers: Regular engagement with external auditors, assessors, regulators or supervisory authorities where applicable, client security teams, cybersecurity and technology vendors, managed security providers, strategic technology partners, consultants, and government or law enforcement authorities when authorized.
Internal Customers: Frequent engagement with the CPTO, Vice President of Technology Governance, Risk and Performance, Product and Technology leaders, Enterprise Risk, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Internal Audit, Human Resources, business executives, Engineering, Enterprise IT and Infrastructure, data owners, and operational leaders.

Working Environment And Physical Demands Analysis

Extensive training programs to set our employees up for success
Modern office environment conducive to collaboration
Supportive teamwork culture
Opportunities to give back to the communities and work through events focused on a variety of charities
Ongoing social events throughout the year

The Team You’ll Join

Founded in 1988, First National is one of Canada’s largest non-bank lenders. We provide residential mortgages exclusively through the mortgage broker channel and we are Canada’s largest commercial mortgage lender.

First National has been consistently recognized as a great place to work and we are proud that our employee engagement feedback is higher than our industry partners.

Title And Summary

Vice President, Product Management, Enterprise Loyalty Consulting

Overview

Mastercard’s Services organization is a key growth engine, delivering innovative solutions that help our customers thrive. By integrating proprietary data, cutting-edge technology, expert insights, and strategic expertise, Services plays a critical role in driving Mastercard’s differentiation and business growth. The Consumer Acquisition & Engagement team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow.

Mastercard is looking for a Vice President, Product Management, Enterprise Loyalty to drive growth of global Consumer Acquisition & Engagement (CA&E) consulting. In CA&E, we help clients build stronger and more profitable relationships with their customers through our combination of data, technology platforms, marketing capabilities, and expertise. Consulting plays a critical role in delivering outcomes for our clients through our trusted advisory that additionally draws in the right solutions from CA&E to solve our clients’ needs.

The VP, Product Management, Enterprise Loyalty Consulting will spearhead the Enterprise Loyalty consulting vision, guiding many of the world’s leading financial institutions in enhancing their relationships with their consumers. You will partner closely across Product, Marketing, Sales, Delivery, regional teams and external partners to build joint solutions, clear product narratives, strengthen go-to-market execution and ensure we deliver measurable value for clients, consumers and Mastercard.

What will you do?

Strategy: Define the vision and product strategy for Enterprise Loyalty consulting
Product innovation: Oversee and evolve a portfolio of solutions that drives consumer engagement strategy and Enterprise Loyalty for many of the world’s leading Financial Institutions.
Go-to-market: Establish GTM playbook and thought leadership for Enterprise Loyalty strategy. Collaborate with product and sales to develop narratives that resonate in the market, and partner with our regional teams to build adoption and pipeline in local markets.
Client impact: Engage directly with clients to understand pain points and challenges in delivering Enterprise Loyalty value propositions with their consumers. Maintain a two-way dialogue with our consultants and sales teams to validate that we are delivering measurable client impact through the work we do.
Market Insights: Maintain awareness of competitive trends, emerging rewards models, partner ecosystems, and broader loyalty innovation across global markets
Product development: Support business case development, pricing inputs, packaging recommendations, and commercialization planning for new and enhanced consulting capabilities. Manage a product roadmap that balances short-term priorities with long-term aspirations.

All About You

Substantial experience leading loyalty and rewards at an established financial institution
Deep knowledge in financial institutions, payments, and marketing
Demonstrated thought leadership in the market through speaking engagements, published articles and/or digital mediums (e.g. podcasts)
Visionary thinking and proven record of owning outcomes
Experience in a matrix organization structure, managing and building relationships with internal and external stakeholders effectively
Exceptional ability to drive strategic alignment both laterally (across stakeholders) and longitudinally (along different time horizons) thinking coupled with deep intellectual curiosity
Consultative mindset with the ability to craft compelling, customer-tailored narratives
Ability to break down and communicate complex ideas in dynamic situations
High level of ownership, quantitative acumen, creativity, and entrepreneurship

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. jobs.description:
Permanent Full Time

Reporting to the AVP, Accounting & Controls, the Director, Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICOFR) is responsible for leading the Canadian ICOFR program and ensuring the organization maintains a sustainable, risk-based, and effective control environment.

The Director serves as the central point of coordination across Canada Finance, Business, Technology, Risk & Controls, Internal Audit, and External Audit, providing governance and oversight over the design, evaluation, remediation, and continuous improvement of internal controls that support reliable financial reporting and CEO/CFO certification requirements.

This role is a key leadership position within the Canada Controller Group, responsible for driving control effectiveness, remediation governance, continuous improvement, and the overall maturity of the Canadian control environment.

What You Will Be Doing

Governance & Program Oversight: Lead the Canadian ICOFR program by providing governance and oversight that supports CEO/CFO certification requirements, coordinating across Canada Finance, Business, Technology, Risk & Controls, Internal Audit, and External Audit, and delivering timely reporting, insights, and recommendations to senior management
Control Design & Operating Effectiveness Oversight: Provide oversight of the design, documentation, assessment, and continuous improvement of the Canadian control environment through risk assessment and scoping activities, quality reviews, consistent application of ICOFR methodologies, and control optimization initiatives
Deficiency Evaluation & Remediation Oversight: Provide Canada-wide governance over control deficiency assessments and remediation activities, including severity evaluation, remediation oversight, progress monitoring, and validation of remediation outcomes. Communicate ICOFR assessments, remediation status, emerging risks, and key conclusions to senior management
Enhancing the Overall Control Environment: Lead the evolution of the Canadian control environment by identifying opportunities to strengthen processes and controls, enhancing the quality and consistency of control documentation, promoting stronger control ownership and accountability across the organization, and providing education and guidance to support control awareness
Leadership: Build and lead a high-performing team by providing coaching, mentorship, and development opportunities, while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and business partnership

What You Will Bring

CPA designation (required)
8+ years of progressive experience in internal controls, external audit, internal audit, or financial reporting, including experience leading teams, complex initiatives, and cross-functional stakeholder groups
Strong knowledge of internal control frameworks, including COSO and Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICOFR/SOX), with experience evaluating control deficiencies, remediation activities, and financial reporting impacts
Demonstrated experience leading ICOFR, control optimization, remediation, or control automation initiatives
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment
Exceptional communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and business partners
Proven experience building, coaching, and leading high-performing teams; experience within the insurance or financial services industry is a strong asset

Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto, London, Winnipeg. This role follows a hybrid work model, with an in-office presence required three days per week.

annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data
jobs.description:
At BuildOps, we build software for modern commercial contractors, from service management through project delivery. We care deeply about the mission and look for people who are driven, self motivated, and excited by fast moving, high ownership environments.



Data sits at the center of BuildOps' AI first strategy. The operational data our customers generate on BuildOps is a long term advantage, but only if it is clean, reliable, and well governed. As Director of Engineering, Data, you will build and lead our unified Data \& AI engineering function. You will own the platforms, pipelines, quality standards, and operating discipline that power AI and ML products and help customers trust BuildOps as their system of record.



Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will help define BuildOps' data strategy over the next three to five years and shape how we build data powered products. This is a foundational leadership role for someone who can think long term about architecture while staying close to the work. You have built and scaled data organizations before and know how to take a team from early stage scrappiness to operational excellence.


**What You'll Do**


* Own BuildOps' data platform and architecture end to end, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and an ML and streaming strategy that evolves with the business and scales efficiently
* Build scalable, repeatable customer and partner data onboarding capabilities that bring data into BuildOps quickly and reliably, reducing time to first value
* Run data systems with production grade discipline, including monitoring, alerting, SLAs, incident response, lineage, freshness, and clear ownership for critical datasets
* Create the data foundation required for AI and ML products, with accurate, well documented inputs today and the right training, inference, and feature infrastructure as those products mature
* Establish governance that supports speed, including access controls, data classification, audit trails, PII handling, and practical data contracts that teams can depend on
* Hire, develop, and lead a strong data engineering team, and establish the right operating rhythms across planning, on call, and stakeholder intake


**What We Look For**


* 10\+ years in data or software engineering, including experience building and scaling teams of 10\+ engineers, with a track record of hiring well, growing leaders, and leading through managers as well as individual contributors
* Deep hands on experience with modern data platforms, including a cloud warehouse or lakehouse such as Snowflake or Databricks, dbt and ELT patterns, orchestration tools like Airflow, and streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis, with AWS experience strongly preferred
* Direct experience building data systems that support production ML use cases, not just analytics, with an understanding of feature stores, training data, real time inference, and the tradeoffs involved in building versus buying ML platform capabilities
* A track record of operational excellence in data, including monitoring, SLAs, incident response, and data quality practices applied with the same rigor as customer facing systems
* Experience delivering customer facing data products such as reporting, analytics, or APIs in B2B SaaS environments where performance, reliability, and trust matter
* Strong architectural judgment, including when to build, when to buy, how to design for change, and how to sequence investments behind validated needs instead of overbuilding
* A pragmatic approach to governance, with security and compliance built in, documentation and contracts that stay current, and access models that balance control with self service
* Early stage or scale up experience in Series B through D companies is a plus, and experience in vertical SaaS or construction tech is helpful but not required


**Who You Are**


* A builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and greenfield work, and can move quickly, ship an MVP, and still make sound decisions for long term scale
* Both hands on and strategic, willing to write code, debug issues, and carry operational responsibility when needed while maintaining a clear multi year vision
* You know how to influence across Product, Engineering, GTM, Finance, and the executive team, build trust, communicate clearly, and push back when priorities are misaligned
* Able to translate technical decisions into business impact and business goals into technical direction
* You have seen this stage of growth before and know what good looks like in a high growth data organization


**Compensation**


* $176,000 \- $235,000 base salary range \+ annual bonus \+ meaningful equity

**What we offer:**
* Generous equity grant, become an owner in our company!
* A comprehensive benefits package
* Flexible PTO and hybrid work schedules
* One\-time work\-from\-home allowance
* Hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Toronto, and Raleigh with hybrid work schedules and lunch provided for in\-office days
* Company events and team\-building activities, both in\-person and virtual
* Fast\-paced, collaborative, and dynamic work environment
* Opportunities for growth and career advancement
* Chance to work with cutting\-edge technology and innovative solutions
* The chance to get in on the ground floor and build something truly groundbreaking for ourselves and our amazing customers


*We welcome applicants from across the U.S. where we are registered to do business and able to support employment. Currently, this excludes the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, Kentucky, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming. This list is based solely on operational and compliance considerations and is reviewed from time to time as our footprint grows.*

Join BuildOps, the largest commercial trade platform in the country, as we transform the multi\-billion dollar commercial contracting industry!

Our Story & Purpose:

We’re Vancity, a member-owned credit union built on the principles of inclusion and social justice. Since 1946, our relentless commitment to these values has helped us challenge the status quo and break down barriers. We’ve made bold commitments to become net-zero by 2040 across all mortgages and loans, and we’re actively pursuing strategies in Indigenous banking and financial resilience for our members.  
As the largest private sector Living Wage Employer in Canada, we’re proud to be consistently recognized as one of the country’s Top Employers. If you’re ready to join our team of 2,300 diverse individuals, access competitive rewards and benefits, and be part of a greater movement - apply today!   
Your Role in Supporting Our Members:

As a Senior Director, Contact Centre Operations & Transformation
, you will provide enterprise-level leadership for the modernization of Vancity’s contact centre into a scalable, resilient, and advice-led channel. You will own the multi-year transformation agenda, shaping the future-state operating model, workforce strategy, quality framework, service model, governance routines, and technology-enabled capabilities.   
We’re looking for an accomplished strategic and operational leader who can navigate complex transformation and turn enterprise priorities into measurable results.   
This is a Full-time, Permanent
role based at our Surrey Central City Office
and will report directly to the VP, Inclusive Banking, Alternate Channels
. While this position provides a hybrid work arrangement, you will be expected to be on-site for events and business demands.

Set the multi-year contact centre strategy, transformation roadmap, future-state operating model, and measures of success.  
Lead through leaders to build an inclusive, accountable, and high-performing culture.  
Modernize workforce management, quality, reporting, IVR, routing, automation, and enabling technology.  
Use operational, financial, risk and member insights to guide investment, capacity, and continuous improvement.

Experience leading leaders and complex operational portfolios across people, financial, risk and member outcomes.

Strategic and future-focused

- You put member relationships, financial well-being, and service quality first.  
Collaborative and influential

This senior professional works cross-functionally with system integrators, site readiness teams, and technology architects to ensure seamless project execution and handover into operations. The Automation Deployment Leader manages timelines, budgets, and stakeholder alignment to deliver automation projects that meet rigorous performance, safety, and cybersecurity requirements. The Automation and Deployment leader is critical in shaping and directing GE Vernova’s global automation strategy through deep engagement in the shops and throughout the automation ecosystem.

Piloter tous les aspects du déploiement de l'automatisation, incluant l'installation, les tests, la validation et la transition vers la production, en assurant la conformité aux normes de sécurité et de cybersécurité.

Favoriser l'établissement de solides relations de travail avec les intervenants de l'ingénierie, des opérations, de la sécurité, de la cybersécurité et des fonctions TI/OT.

Bilingue français/anglais fluide requis. Excellentes capacités de collaboration, de gestion des fournisseurs et de mobilisation des intervenants.

jobs.title: Director, Treasury Finance
jobs.description:
The primary responsibility of the Director is to lead Treasury Finance activities relating to corporate finance strategy, funding strategy, capital structure management, liability management, banking relationships, and capital markets execution. The Director serves as a key advisor to Treasury leadership and business partners on matters relating to funding, leverage, capital deployment, liquidity resources, and balance sheet optimization.

The role is accountable for developing and executing funding strategies that support Manulife's financial objectives while maintaining appropriate financial flexibility, regulatory capital levels, liquidity resources, and access to global capital markets. You will also be responsible for maintaining strong relationships with banking partners, investors, rating agencies, and advisors, while ensuring treasury financing activities are executed efficiently, effectively, and in accordance with approved governance frameworks.

Position Responsibilities

Act as Treasury Finance advisor with an overall mandate to support Treasury leadership, Capital Management, Investor Relations, Treasury Operations, Manulife Bank and other stakeholders through strategic analysis, funding recommendations, and corporate finance expertise.
Develop recommendations regarding capital structure, leverage, funding strategy, refinancing, capital deployment, and balance sheet optimization to support the Company's financial objectives.
Lead the development and ongoing assessment of funding strategies, incorporating market conditions, regulatory and rating agency considerations, funding requirements, investor demand, and competitive developments.
Serve as the primary Treasury Finance lead for debt issuances, liability management transactions, wholesale funding programs, share repurchase initiatives, and other treasury-related financing activities, including strategy, analysis, execution and post-transaction review.
Lead and manage Treasury-owned banking relationships, including revolving credit facilities, letters of credit and other financing arrangements, and negotiate pricing, terms, capacity, documentation and service levels.
Lead complex commercial negotiations with banking partners, dealers, investors, legal counsel and other external stakeholders. Review, analyze and negotiate credit agreements, underwriting agreements, term sheets, offering documents, trust indentures and other financing-related documentation.
Support and influence strategic decision-making through the preparation of financial analysis, funding plans, capital structure assessments, Board materials, executive presentations and other management reporting.
Lead strategic initiatives impacting Treasury Finance, including evaluating alternatives, assessing risks and opportunities, coordinating stakeholders and supporting implementation.
Maintain relationships with banking partners, fixed income investors, rating agencies and other market participants to monitor trends, identify opportunities and support continued access to capital.
Ensure funding instruments remain compliant with contractual, regulatory, reporting and governance requirements, including ongoing monitoring of covenants, obligations and maturity profiles.
Identify and implement process improvements related to treasury strategy, funding activities, governance, reporting, controls and transaction execution.
Responsible for coaching, mentoring and development of staff supporting Treasury Finance activities.

Required Qualifications

Post-secondary education in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline and/or a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in treasury, corporate finance, capital markets, commercial banking, investment banking, insurance finance or a related field.
Strong knowledge of corporate finance, capital structure management, leverage analysis, capital allocation, liquidity management and balance sheet optimization.
Strong understanding of debt and equity capital markets, funding strategies, banking products, credit facilities and liability management activities.
Experience executing complex financing transactions and negotiating commercial arrangements with financial institutions and other counterparties.
Ability to review, understand and negotiate financing documentation, including credit agreements, underwriting agreements, term sheets, offering documents and related contracts.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate strategic alternatives and develop actionable recommendations.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Thorough understanding of risk management, governance and controls as they relate to treasury and financing activities.
Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior management and executive stakeholders.
Strong project management, organizational and stakeholder coordination skills.
Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience managing change, developing talent and fostering high-performing teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure and adapt to changing business requirements.
Capital markets, commercial banking, investment banking, treasury or corporate finance experience within a financial institution is considered a strong asset.

jobs.description:

Description

Why This Role Exists

Creative is one of the biggest levers in scaling our clients’ paid media performance.

We’re looking for a Head of Creative Strategy to build the people, systems, and operating model that turn creative into a repeatable performance advantage across our portfolio, both in social and display networks.

You’ll lead Creative Strategy and oversee Creative Execution through the Performance Creative Manager, ensuring strategy, production, performance, and learning operate as one connected system.

Key Responsibilities

Who We Are

Clever Digital Marketing is a performance marketing agency helping large home improvement companies across the US and Canada grow through Paid Social, Paid Search, CRO, and strategic advising.

We manage a large portfolio of accounts, an in-house creative team, and significant monthly ad spend. As we scale, we're building a stronger creative-strategy function to help clients find new creative winners — and to turn one-off learnings into repeatable systems that compound across every account.

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

What You'll Do

Build and lead CDM’s Creative Strategy function, defining the methodologies, standards, and operating system behind how we research, ideate, test, learn, and scale creative.
Manage Senior Creative Strategists and the Performance Creative Manager.
Build systems that turn customer, market, and performance data into actionable creative direction.
Create a cross-account learning system so wins, losses, hypotheses, and insights compound across the portfolio.
Set and maintain the strategic and creative quality bar across the department, regularly reviewing work and challenging thinking.
Ensure Creative Strategy and Creative Execution scale together with the right quality, capacity, velocity, prioritization, and feedback loops.
Build testing frameworks, briefing standards, and learning loops that improve creative performance and decision-making.
Build training, playbooks, and frameworks that improve creative thinking across Media Buyers and Creative.
Build AI-enabled workflows that improve research, analysis, creative intelligence, and decision-making.
Partner closely with Paid Social, CRO, Paid Search, Client Success, and leadership.
Ensure creative decisions are connected to business outcomes such as Creative Win Rate, CPL, CPS/CPD, lead quality, COM, and account growth.
Hire and develop future Creative Strategy talent.

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience leading creative strategy or performance creative.
Experience building or scaling a team, department, or operating system.
Strong performance-marketing and commercial understanding.
Strong direct-response and consumer-psychology background.
Experience building creative testing frameworks, learning systems, and standards.
Experience managing strategists and/or creative-production teams.
Strong cross-functional leadership and ability to drive adoption.
Strong understanding of AI and how to apply it across a team, not just individually.
Able to operate at portfolio level while still maintaining a strong account-level creative quality bar.
Clear, decisive communicator who can simplify complexity and turn strategy into action.

Nice to Have

Lead generation or high-ticket services experience.
Home improvement experience.
CRO and landing-page testing familiarity.
UGC, founder-led, or spokesperson-led creative experience.
Hands-on familiarity with editing or design tools.

What Success Looks Like

CDM consistently introduces genuinely new creative ideas instead of recycling the same concepts and formats.
Creative iterations are more deliberate, strategic, and evidence-based.
Media Buyers and editors produce stronger briefs and creative recommendations on their own.
Learnings are captured, shared, and applied across accounts.
AI-supported research and creative workflows are adopted department-wide.
CDM has a repeatable creative-strategy engine that gets stronger with every test.

Benefits of Working at CDM

Competitive base salary + performance-based bonuses
Flexible remote work environment with option for in-person collaboration (Vaughan, ON)
Group Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision, RRSP/401k Plan w/matching, more.

Work Abroad Policy: Need a new working environment? Our work abroad policy supports this!
The chance to shape and grow a high-performing Client Success team
A culture of performance and respect where the best work happens with extreme ownership and accountability meets collaboration.

jobs.description:
About the role

McCann is seeking a Strategy Director, Performance & Creative Integration to lead strategies that connect brand building, creative ideas and measurable business outcomes. Rooted in our Truth Well Told ethos, you will turn business, audience and cultural insight into clear strategic direction, then work with creative, media, analytics, CRM and commerce partners to bring that direction to life. You will lead client relationships, guide strategists and help grow our clients and the agency.

What you will do:

Lead strategy and creative development

Understand client business and marketing problems. Draw on consumer, cultural, category, media and performance data to find meaningful truths and opportunities.
Develop integrated strategies that connect brand objectives, customer needs, acquisition and measurable business results.
Write clear briefs and strategic narratives that inspire original creative work across channels and customer journeys.
Partner with Creative and Business Leadership to develop ideas, give constructive feedback and carry the strategic story from opportunity through execution and impact.
Stay close to digital behaviour and social conversation. Explain what people do and why it matters for the work.

Connect performance and creative

Bring creative, media, analytics, CRM and commerce teams together around shared audience insight, campaign objectives and measurement.
Shape demand generation, lead generation, customer acquisition and digital commerce strategies where they serve the client’s business.
Use campaign results to identify creative opportunities, guide versioning and personalization, and recommend what to test next.
Develop practical approaches to testing and iteration, including dynamic creative optimization where appropriate.

Lead clients and the team

Present persuasive strategic recommendations and lead confident, productive conversations with clients and internal teams.
Bring proactive thinking to client relationships, new business opportunities and agency growth.
Mentor strategists, adapt your coaching to their needs and give clear feedback that helps people and the work grow.

What you bring

At least eight years of relevant strategy experience, including agency experience and leadership of client work.
A record of turning insight into strong creative work and clear business outcomes.
Working knowledge of media, audience strategy, analytics and measurement, with experience in performance marketing, lead generation, CRM, customer acquisition or digital commerce.
The ability to decide which data matters, explain what it means and translate it into creative direction.
Strong writing, storytelling, presentation and client leadership skills.
Curiosity about culture and digital behaviour, sound judgment, and an open approach to collaboration and feedback.
Experience guiding or managing strategists and helping multidisciplinary teams work together.

Success in this role

Your strategies will help clients build their brands and achieve measurable business results. Teams will use your direction to create connected work, learn from its performance and improve what comes next. You will strengthen strategic talent, client relationships and McCann’s reputation for effective creative work.
