jobs.description:
Who We Are 
 Welcome to TELUS Digital, where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.
 With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Enterprise Technology, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.
 From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are, all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

 Location 
 This role will be based out of one of our major US or Canada office locations: Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

 The Opportunity 
 This business unit specializes in data-driven solutions and strategic AI implementation. We help our clients unlock the full potential of their data and transform their business through innovative, AI-powered strategies.
 Our Managing Director, Data, AI & Cloud, will lead our Data & AI advisory, AI solutions, Data platforms, and cloud transformation capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the growth, profitability, and success of the practice. You will provide strategic guidance, lead cross-functional teams, and deliver outstanding client value across our global footprint. The Managing Director, Data, AI & Cloud will have P&L responsibility and will play a critical role in shaping our company's overall vision, strategy, and growth.
 This is an exceptional opportunity for a talented and results-oriented leader to make a significant impact in shaping our company's future and driving data-driven solutions in the evolving digital landscape. If you are passionate about data, AI, and strategic consulting, we invite you to apply and join our high-performing team.
 To learn more about our AI practice: https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/enterprise-ai 
 To learn more about our Cloud practice: https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/enterprise-technology-modernization/cloud-services 

 Responsibilities 
 Strategy and Leadership: 
 Collaborate with the executive leadership team to define the company's Data, AI & Cloud vision, strategy, and goals

 Drive growth by identifying emerging trends, market opportunities, and industry best practices

 Lead the planning, development, and execution of the Data, AI & Cloud strategic roadmap

 P&L Responsibility: 
 Assume overall accountability for the financial performance of the Data, AI & Cloud consulting practice

 Partner with Practice Leaders and Business Development to continue to grow managed accounts

 In partnership with Business Development, develop and implement effective revenue generation strategies to meet or exceed annual revenue targets

 Monitor financial performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective actions as necessary

 Team Leadership and Management: 
 Build and lead high-performing teams, including Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Strategists, and AI Engineers

 Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the Data, AI & Cloud teams globally and more broadly through the Practice Advisor team

 Client Engagement and Delivery: 
 Partner with clients to identify their business challenges and design tailored Data, AI & Cloud solutions

 Oversee the delivery of high-quality data-driven insights, models, and strategic recommendations

 Provide thought leadership and build trusted advisor relationships with key client stakeholders

 Competencies 
 Experience: 
 10+ years of relevant leadership and team management experience within a top-tier management consultancy (Partner-level) or global and publicly traded enterprise (VP, SVP, or C-level) with a focus on AI, Data Engineering, Data Science, or Related Fields

 Leads a line of business for a mid-size to large consultancy (i.e., office, industry, etc.)

 Leadership experience in technology consulting, project management, and executive partnerships

 Clear and tested experience in leading cross-functional teams and managing P&L responsibilities 

 Industry Knowledge: 
 In-depth knowledge of Data Engineering, Data Science, and AI technologies and tools

 Familiarity with emerging trends, best practices, and advancements in Data, AI & Cloud applications

 Track record of being a dynamic decision-maker and having adaptability in a quickly changing environment

 Deep knowledge of customer experience strategies and digital transformation

 Leadership Competencies: 
 Exceptional leadership and people management skills, inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams

 Excellent strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities, with strong business acumen

 Proven ability to develop and maintain effective relationships with clients and key stakeholders

 Communication and Collaboration: 
 Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex ideas effectively to C-level and Executive audiences

 Strong collaborator with the ability to work seamlessly across diverse teams and cultures

 Proficiency in English is required; additional fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is a plus

 Equal Opportunity Employer 
 At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity. 
 We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.
 For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**


Crozier is a leading consulting engineering firm serving the land development industry. Crozier's multidisciplinary team offers expertise in land development, transportation engineering, water resources, construction services, structural engineering, and related infrastructure disciplines. With offices in Toronto, Collingwood, Burlington, Bradford, and Guelph, Crozier supports private\-sector clients across Ontario in advancing residential, commercial, and industrial developments, as well as projects across other key industry markets. Crozier has been awarded esteemed top employer, leadership and business growth recognitions, including one of Canada's Top Small \& Medium Employers, Southwestern Ontario's Top Employers, and ranked among Canada's Top Growing Companies by Report on Business.


**Your Impact:**


Crozier is currently seeking a **Director of Finance** to join our growing company.


Reporting to the President, the Director of Finance will serve as Crozier’s lead finance executive and be responsible for oversight of all finance, accounting, treasury, and reporting activities. As a strong communicator, you will make it your mission to streamline our budgeting, payroll, and financial reporting processes. You will produce thorough financial\-status reports for senior management, to help improve our operational efficiency and aid in our continued growth.


**How you will contribute to the team:**


* In conjunction with the Manager of Finance, oversee all accounts, ledgers, and reporting systems ensuring compliance with IFRS and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain internal control and safeguards for receipt of revenue, costs, program budgets, and actual expenditures.
* In conjunction with the President and senior leadership team, establish financial and operating benchmarks, budgets, program monitoring, and reporting standards on a bi\-weekly, monthly, and annual basis.
* Achieve budget goals with proper analysis, and corrective action.
* Help develop and support short and long\-term operational strategies.
* Act as a key member of the executive team, providing strategic financial counsel to the President and the Board on investments, growth initiatives, and risk management.
* Consistently analyze financial data and present financial reports in an accurate and timely manner; clearly communicate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements; monitor progress and changes.
* Develop and enforce internal controls to maximize protection of company assets, policies, procedures, and workflow.
* Oversee and support accounting team with dynamic leadership that creates an environment of trust and productivity.


**What you bring:**


* Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, or related field; CPA designation required.
* 15\+ years of proven accounting experience, with 10\+ years of experience in a senior finance leadership position.
* Strong knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); knowledge of US GAAP is an asset.
* Extremely knowledgeable in financial forecasting, accounting principles, and financial data analysis.
* Strong understanding of economic and banking processes.
* Keen analytic, organization and problem\-solving skills which allows for strategic data interpretation versus simple reporting.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills; experience in effectively communicating key data, including presentations to senior management, board, or other outside partners.
* Ability and desire to translate complex financial concepts to individuals at all levels including finance and non\-finance managers.???????


**We offer:**


**Comprehensive Benefits That Support You:** We offer flexible and customizable health benefits designed to meet your needs, including dental, vision, prescription coverage, a health spending account, and much more. Crozier offers RRSP matching, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), parental leave top\-up, annual wellness allowance, our unique First\-Time Home Buyers' Assistance Program, and more.


**Investing in Your Growth**: Your development matters to us. It is our goal to provide programs that support our employee’s experience through personal and professional development. We offer paid professional development support and training, including a Lifelong Learning Assistance Program to support career pathways.


**Making a Difference Together**: Giving back is part of who we are. We actively support not\-for\-profit organizations in the communities where we live and work, and encourage employees to get involved through community initiatives and local events.


**Crozier Social**: At Crozier, we believe strong relationships make great teams. From sports leagues and game nights to creative workshops and social events, there are plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues. Throughout the year, we bring our teams together through activities such as golf tournaments, hikes, boat cruises, and other fun company\-wide events.


**Salary range:** $130,000 \- $170,000


**About the salary range:** The range shown reflects what we typically offer for this type of role. When we make an offer, we consider the responsibilities of the position, market data, and internal equity to ensure consistency across our teams. Your actual offer will depend on your experience, skills, and alignment with the role.


**Vacancy status:** This posting is for an open position.


**AI Disclosure:** Crozier does not use artificial intelligence (AI) in the hiring process. All applications are reviewed by the People \& Culture team and hiring managers.


*Crozier is committed to providing equal opportunity to candidates of all abilities. If you require accommodation, please contact our People \& Culture team and we will work with you to provide accessibility support.*

jobs.title: Director, Global AI Thought Leadership
jobs.description:
Our Purpose 

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

 Title and Summary 

Director, Global AI Thought Leadership 

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview
The AI & Data Office is responsible for the strategy, acquisition, evaluation, and responsible use of AI and data capabilities that power innovation and operations across Mastercard. It defines the enterprise AI and data vision, develops shared capabilities, and helps the business realize value from AI and data responsibly and at scale. 

The Director, AI Thought Leadership, will report to the Vice President, AI Thought Leadership and partner with AI product, engineering, and SMEs, to cultivate a unified narrative for Mastercard’s AI solutions and position. Within the AI & Data Office, the AI Thought Leadership team shapes Mastercard's internal and external perspective on artificial intelligence and its impact on our business, our customers, and on commerce, business, and society. The team develops original insights, executive narratives, and thought leadership programs that strengthen Mastercard's reputation as a trusted leader in applied AI and execute on Mastercard's AI positioning to strengthen engagement with customers, stakeholders, and employees, and reinforce Mastercard's unique role in the evolving AI landscape

Role
• Monitor AI and data technologies landscape, their application, and industry trends to identify emerging opportunities, risks, and implications for Mastercard and its customers.
• Develop original thought leadership, research, and points of view on topics such as AI adoption, trust, economy, workforce transformation, and the future of commerce.
• Create flagship content including research reports, whitepapers, executive briefs, articles, presentations, keynote materials, and webinar content, building towards an AI-driven AI content studio. 
• Lead the end-to-end thought leadership lifecycle, including research, content development, stakeholder coordination, reviews, approvals, publication, and ongoing content refresh.
• Measure the impact of thought leadership programs and continuously improve content effectiveness, audience engagement, and business outcomes.
• Partner with executives and cross-functional teams across AI & Data, Products, Marketing, and Communications to deliver through leadership programd and activation through speeches, bylines, presentations, customer briefings, executive workshops, facilitation sessions, strategic discussions, and thought leadership programs.
• Represent Mastercard at industry events, customer forums, analyst engagements, and external thought leadership opportunities.

All About You
The ideal candidate for this position should demonstrate:
• Experience in thought leadership, market research, management consulting, technology research, journalism, publishing, editorial strategy, or a related field.
• Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, agentic systems, data strategy, responsible AI, and enterprise AI adoption trends including evaluating emerging technologies and their business and socio-economic implications
• Track record producing high-quality research, reports, articles, or executive content and translating complex technology topics for business audiences.
• Effective project and production management skills, with experience coordinating complex publications from planning through review, approval, and delivery.
• Strong market research and analytical capabilities, able to synthesize large volumes of information into clear viewpoints.
• Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling abilities, and leading the use of AI tools to accelerate and amplify thought leadership work.
• Experience working with senior executives, technical subject matter experts, communications and marketing. 
• Knowledge of payments, technology, financial services, or digital commerce preferred.
• Ability to operate independently in ambiguous and rapidly evolving environments.
Corporate Security Responsibility
Every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security. All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and therefore, it is expected that the successful candidate for this position must:

• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and 
• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. 

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly. 

 Corporate Security Responsibility 

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team. 
 Pay Ranges 
Toronto, Canada: $138,000 - $221,000 CAD

jobs.description:
** English version below **
 Nous sommes une agence Web dynamique qui conçoit des solutions numériques innovantes afin de contribuer au succès de ses clients. Notre équipe mise sur la créativité, la collaboration et l’excellence. Nous sommes à la recherche d’un·e directeur·trice de la stratégie expérimenté·e pour diriger notre équipe de stratégie et accompagner nos clients dans des initiatives de transformation numérique, Web et marketing.
 Le ou la directeur·trice de la stratégie sera responsable du développement et de la mise en œuvre de stratégies globales de marketing et de contenu. Ce rôle requiert un leadership mobilisateur, capable d’inspirer une équipe tout en participant activement à la planification stratégique et à son exécution. La personne idéale possède une solide expérience en marketing, en stratégie de contenu et dans l’élaboration de plans marketing stratégiques.

 Dans ce rôle, vous serez appelé·e à: 
 Diriger, encadrer et faire évoluer l’équipe de stratégie, tout en favorisant une culture d’innovation et d’excellence
 Agir comme conseiller·ère stratégique auprès des clients, comprendre leurs objectifs d’affaires et leur fournir des recommandations pour orienter leurs initiatives numériques et marketing
 Accompagner les clients dans leur transformation numérique et veiller à l’adoption de bonnes pratiques en matière de technologies Web, d’accessibilité et d’expérience utilisateur
 Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies numériques qui alignent les objectifs des clients sur les besoins des utilisateurs, en s’appuyant sur la recherche UX, les données analytiques et la stratégie de contenu
 Veiller à ce que les solutions proposées soient évolutives, rentables et réalisables dans les limites du budget du projet
 Réaliser des études de marché approfondies afin d’identifier les tendances, les occasions et le contexte concurrentiel, et utiliser ces informations pour orienter les recommandations stratégiques
 Collaborer avec les équipes multidisciplinaires de design, de développement et de gestion de projet afin d’assurer l’alignement stratégique tout au long du cycle de vie des projets
 Définir les principaux indicateurs de succès

 Quelles compétences sont nécessaires pour réussir au sein de la communauté Evolving Web? 
 De 7 à 10 ans d’expérience en stratégie numérique, UX ou stratégie produit, idéalement au sein d’une agence de développement Web ou d’une agence numérique
 Expérience démontrée en leadership, notamment dans l’encadrement et le développement d’équipes performantes
 Expérience démontrée dans l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de marketing et de contenu sur différents canaux et plateformes
 Excellente capacité à comprendre les objectifs et contraintes des clients, à analyser des données, à interpréter les résultats et à les traduire en stratégies concrètes
 De solides compétences en communication en français et en anglais. L’anglais est requis puisque ce poste implique une collaboration régulière avec des clients et des membres de l’équipe situés à l’extérieur du Québec qui communiquent principalement en anglais. Si vous estimez que ce poste vous correspond, mais que vous n’êtes pas parfaitement à l’aise dans les deux langues, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler

 Atouts supplémentaires: 
 Connaissance de Drupal et WordPress
 Expérience de travail avec des clients institutionnels
 Expérience dans le développement et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de marketing et de contenu sur différents canaux et plateformes

 Ce que nous offrons: 
 Impact – Travaillez sur des projets pour des organisations prestigieuses qui ont un impact sur la vie de dizaines de milliers d’utilisateurs chaque jour
 Défis – Profitez de l’occasion de prendre en charge des projets présentant un niveau élevé de complexité créative et technique
 Apprentissage et développement – Évoluez dans un environnement collaboratif qui encourage l’apprentissage continu et le mentorat
 Culture – Faites partie d’une équipe internationale, accueillante et soudée
 Mode de travail hybride flexible – Pour les candidat·e·s résidant à Montréal ou dans les environs, ce poste suit un horaire hybride comprenant trois jours par semaine au bureau et deux jours en télétravail

 Prêt·e à faire une différence? Joignez-vous à nous et contribuez à façonner l’avenir des expériences numériques!
 Veuillez noter que toutes les communications liées au processus de recrutement seront effectuées exclusivement par courriel.

 Nous aimerions tout de même avoir de vos nouvelles! 
 Vous ne répondez pas à tous les critères, ou vous avez découvert cette offre après la fin de la période de candidature? Ne laissez pas cela vous empêcher de nous contacter. Plusieurs de nos nouvelles recrues nous rejoignent grâce à des recommandations ou par d’autres moyens. Soumettez une candidature spontanée et parlez-nous de vous.

 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 We are a dynamic web agency committed to delivering innovative digital solutions that drive client success. Our team thrives on creativity, collaboration, and a passion for excellence. We are seeking an experienced Director of Strategy to lead our strategy team, guiding clients through transformative web and marketing initiatives.

 The Director of Strategy will spearhead the development and execution of comprehensive marketing and content strategies. This role demands a visionary leader who can inspire a team while actively engaging in strategic planning and implementation. The ideal candidate will possess a robust background in marketing, content strategy, and the creation of strategic marketing plans.

 In this role, you will be expected to: 
 Lead, mentor, and develop the strategy team, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence
 Serve as a strategic advisor to clients, understanding their business goals and providing insights to inform their digital and marketing initiatives
 Guide clients through digital transformation, ensuring they adopt best practices in web technology, accessibility, and user experience
 Craft and implement digital strategies that align client objectives with user needs, leveraging UX research, analytics, and content strategy
 Ensure solutions are scalable, cost-effective, and achievable within the project budget
 Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive landscapes to inform strategic recommendations
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams (design, development, and project management) to ensure strategic alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
 Define key success metrics

 What kind of skill set do you need to be successful in your role within the Evolving community? 
 Minimum of 7-10 years in digital strategy, UX, or product strategy, preferably in a web development or digital agency.
 Proven leadership experience, with a track record of mentoring and growing high-performing teams.
 Demonstrated proficiency in developing and executing marketing and content strategies across various channels and platforms
 Strong ability to understand client goals and constraints, analyze data, interpret insights, and translate them into actionable strategies
 Strong communication skills in both French and English. English is required because this role involves regular collaboration with clients and team members located outside Quebec who primarily communicate in English. If you feel this position is a good fit for you but you are not fully comfortable in both languages, we still encourage you to apply

 Bonus for: 
 Knowledge of Drupal and WordPress
 Experience working with institutional clients
 Experience in developing and executing marketing and content strategies across various channels and platforms

 What we Offer: 
 Impact - Work on projects for prestigious organizations that impact the lives of tens of thousands of users every day
 Challenge - Opportunity to take ownership of projects with a high level of creative and technical complexity
 Learning & Growth - A collaborative environment that encourages continuous learning and mentorship
 Culture - A company with a team from around the world that feels like a family
 Flexible hybrid - For candidates based in Montreal and its suburbs, this role follows a hybrid work schedule, with three days in the office and two days working remotely each week

 Ready to make a difference? Join us and help shape the future of digital experiences!
 Please note that all communications related to the recruitment process will be conducted exclusively by email.

 We'd still love to hear from you! Don't meet every qualification, or find this posting after applications closed? Don't let that stop you from reaching out. Many of our hires come through referrals and other channels. Submit a Spontaneous Application and tell us about yourself.

About Citi:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

About the Team:

Citi is looking for a Lead AI/ML Data Scientist
to join the Olympus Data Reconciliation and Engineering team, where you will shape the next generation of AI and machine learning capabilities powering enterprise-scale reconciliation across global processing hubs.

In this role, you will drive the full lifecycle of ML model development — from ideation and architecture through to deployment and adoption — delivering measurable impact across Capital Markets operations, risk, and finance. Your work will sit at the intersection of advanced data science and real-world financial systems, influencing outcomes at a global scale.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and deploy AI and machine learning models — including Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions — to solve complex reconciliation and data engineering challenges at enterprise scale.
Lead the end-to-end ML model development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and data preprocessing through to ensemble modeling, validation, and production integration.
Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured financial data to uncover trends, patterns, and opportunities for optimization across banking platforms.
Define and deliver ML model roadmaps in collaboration with technical and business teams, ensuring alignment with project timelines, budgets, and Citi's architecture standards.
Translate complex data findings into clear visualizations and strategic recommendations that inform decisions made by senior business and technology leaders.
Partner with engineering, operations, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless model integration, long-term scalability, and reliable performance in production environments.
Identify and communicate technology risks and their business implications, developing mitigation strategies and maintaining transparency with stakeholders at all levels.
Maintain comprehensive model documentation and support knowledge transfer to ensure continuity and adoption across teams.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

Technical Expertise:

6+ years hands-on experience in AI/ML development and big data engineering within Financial Services, Insurance, or Telecom environments
Expert-level proficiency in Python (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy), R (caret, tidyverse, mlr3), and SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL)
Deep technical knowledge implementing supervised and unsupervised ML algorithms: linear/logistic regression, neural networks (CNN, RNN, LSTM, Transformers), k-means clustering, DBSCAN, decision trees (CART, C4.5), and ensemble methods (Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost)
Proven experience building and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-based solutions using:
LangGraph for complex agent orchestration and state management
LangChain for chain-of-thought reasoning and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
Agent Development Kit (ADK) for enterprise-grade autonomous agent development

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications:

Hands-on experience with advanced statistical modeling: Generalized Linear Models (GLM), Random Forest, Gradient Boosting (AdaBoost, XGBoost), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques including text mining, topic modeling (LDA), and sentiment analysis
Experience with model versioning and experiment tracking tools (Mlflow, Weights & Biases, DVC)
Proficiency with Git/GitHub/Bitbucket for version control and collaborative development
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for ML model deployment (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
Familiarity with data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly) and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience with real-time streaming data frameworks (Kafka, Kinesis)
Passion for staying current with emerging AI/ML frameworks, research papers, and open-source contributions

, Data Science
, Software Engineering

We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients. 

 At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute. 

 To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com 

 What you'll be doing 

 The Marketing and Client Solutions Decision Sciences ( Growth) team is at the center of our Media practice, strategy and innovation at CIBC. Its sole focus is to efficiently drive growth in reach and conversions through efficient media investments that are data driven. We work across different enterprise teams at CIBC and Simplii helping them understand and serve our clients and Canadians better each day. We apply best practices in marketing measurement, descriptive and predictive analysis, machine learning, artificial intelligence and leverage the latest in big data technology platforms.

 Reporting into the COE Lead for Marketing and Client solutions within AI Data and Analytics, this role is responsible for leading a Media decision sciences practice, delivering on strategic priorities, managing and maintaining team operations and senior stakeholder relationships, equipping the Media Ops teams with high quality and timely data and insights to continuously optimize our Media. This Director will lead, manage and mentor a small team of Junior and Media scientists. This role requires a hands-on approach to solving problems, planning and managing change related to all aspects of marketing sciences delivery.

 At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote. 

 How you'll succeed 

 Champion media analytics as a strategic growth driver — Serve as the trusted analytics partner to marketing, retail, wealth, and distribution leaders by translating business priorities into clear media measurement, experimentation, and optimization strategies. Ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes.
 Lead measurement, experimentation, and optimization across the media ecosystem — Oversee the design, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of analytics frameworks, models, and test-and-learn programs that improve media effectiveness. Guide the team in applying advanced analytics, AI/ML, and emerging GenAI capabilities to both structured and unstructured data, with a strong focus on campaign performance, attribution, audience insights, and investment optimization.
 Deliver end-to-end analytical solutions — Lead work from problem definition and methodology through execution, validation, monitoring, and refinement. Continuously evolve approaches as business needs shift, new channels emerge, or performance insights suggest optimization opportunities.
 Build a high-performing analytics function — Lead, coach, and develop a strong team of media analytics professionals. Hire and nurture talent with the right blend of analytical rigor, business acumen, and media expertise. Set clear expectations, remove barriers, and ensure the team is aligned to business priorities and enterprise goals.
 Embed responsible, effective analytics practices — Foster high standards in measurement design, data quality, experimentation discipline, and responsible AI use. Ensure the team’s work adheres to relevant policies, governance standards, and best practices while maintaining credibility with partners across the organization.

 Who you are 

 You are a media analytics leader first. You bring strong command of the media landscape and understand how to connect channels, audiences, and investments to measurable business outcomes. You are fluent in media effectiveness, incrementality, attribution, testing, and optimization.
 You combine craft expertise with strategic thinking. You know how to move from business question to analytical approach to actionable recommendation. You are comfortable shaping measurement strategies that inform planning, improve performance, and support better investment decisions.

You have deep experience applying advanced analytics to marketing and media use cases, including forecasting, audience analysis, causal measurement, optimization, and performance diagnostics. You understand how to structure rigorous experiments and use evidence to guide decisions.

You are thoughtful about where these tools add value and where rigor in measurement must remain paramount.
 You bring strong business and industry judgment. Experience in marketing, media, or sales analytics is essential, and financial services experience is a strong asset. You understand how to operate in a regulated, complex environment while still driving innovation and impact.
 You are well-credentialed and credible. You bring advanced academic training in analytics, statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, along with a track record of delivering large, high-impact analytical initiatives.

jobs.title: Director, Public & Alternative Investments, Data Platforms
jobs.description:
Purpose. Performance. People. 

 Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.   

 With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.  

 For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.   

 The Role 

As Director, Data Engineering for the Public Markets and Alternate Assets (PMAA) team, you will build and publish the enterprise market data products that power investment strategies across our public markets and alternate assets businesses. Partnering closely with your business-aligned product owner, you will lead a talented team of data engineers and analysts and own the end-to-end lifecycle of PMAA data, from vendor and internal feeds through to trusted, well-documented data products used by investment teams, analytics platforms and AI agents. You will set the technical direction for a modern AWS data platform, establish the semantic and knowledge graph foundations that connect data across asset classes, and ensure every data product meets the standards of timeliness, quality, licensing compliance and control that investment decisions demand. 

 The Team 

 CPP Investments invests across public and private markets, supported by technology and data capabilities that enable informed investment decisions and long-term value creation.

 Within PMAA, this role leads market data engineering and the development of enterprise data products that support investment professionals, quantitative and research teams. The team works with investment, product, architecture, technology and governance partners to deliver reliable, accessible and AI-ready market data.

 Accountabilities 
 Define and execute the multi-year data engineering strategy and roadmap for PMAA market data products, partnering with the product owner to align priorities with investment needs and enterprise architecture standards.
 Own the target-state AWS data platform architecture across ingestion, storage, processing, orchestration, governance and consumption, making design and build-versus-buy decisions that balance scalability, resilience, security and cost.
 Lead the development and adoption of enterprise data products across public and private markets, including pricing, reference data, corporate actions and benchmarks, with clear ownership, data contracts, service levels and documentation.
 Establish semantic data capabilities, including RDF knowledge graphs on Amazon Neptune, and enable governed access to AI-ready data through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent skills and Amazon Quick.
 Ensure reliable, timely and secure data delivery through observability, automated quality controls, incident management, AWS Lake Formation, data lineage and market data licensing and entitlement controls.
 Lead agile roadmap delivery and engineering excellence, embedding CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and reusable frameworks while engaging senior stakeholders, investment teams and strategic technology and data partners.
 Build, coach and develop an inclusive, high-performing engineering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and career growth.

 What You Bring 
 Undergraduate degree or college diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field; a graduate degree is an asset.
 10+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platforms or software engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with demonstrated success delivering enterprise-scale, cloud-native data platforms and leading complex agile programs.
 Strong understanding of capital markets, investment management and market and reference data, including experience with major data vendors, licensing, entitlements and usage controls; private markets experience is an asset.
 Advanced AWS architecture expertise equivalent to Solutions Architect – Professional, including security, IAM, networking, resilience and cost optimization, together with hands-on technical depth in Apache Spark (PySpark or Scala), AWS Glue or EMR, Airflow/MWAA, AWS DMS and Amazon RDS/Aurora.
 Expertise in enterprise data product design, AWS Lake Formation governance, data contracts, service levels and consumption patterns, along with RDF, SPARQL, ontology design, Amazon Neptune, MCP servers, agent skills and AI-assisted analytics using Amazon Quick.
 Ability to guide engineering teams across cloud-native development, data quality, observability and delivery practices. Experience with lakehouse technologies, Python, SQL, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, data cataloguing, financial ontologies, Amazon Bedrock or GraphRAG is an asset; relevant AWS certifications are also assets.
 Inclusive people leadership, sound judgment and strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to investment professionals and executives, influence stakeholders and manage strategic vendor partnerships.

 You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to  high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.   

 We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

 Inclusion & Accessibility 
 CPP Investments is committed to  equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.   

 Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud 
 CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.  

 CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

 #LI-ONSITE

This is an 18\-month fixed\-term position covering a maternity leave. The Director, Financial Reporting, reporting to the Vice President of Finance, is a key member of the Finance department and owns the global financial close, consolidation, external financial reporting, and audit execution; and partners with internal stakeholders and external advisors on global tax compliance and planning. They are enthusiastic, high\-energy, an experienced people leader, and passionate about coaching and investing in their team to elevate career development and experience.  

This is a hands\-on role in a high\-growth software business backed by U.S. Private Equity. This role will partner with other senior leaders to continue to build and scale the department with best practices to support our global business with operations in Canada, US, UK, Romania and Australia.


**What You'll Do**


* Financial Accounting and Reporting: Oversee the ongoing accounting function and financial reporting calendar to meet critical reporting timelines. Be the in\-house technical accounting expert that ensures compliance with US GAAP (ASC 606 revenue recognition, ASC 718 stock based compensation, ASC 842 leases, etc), federal, state and local laws and accounting principles in the US, Canada, UK, LATAM, Romania, and Australia.
* Audit Management: Manage the relationships with external auditors and government authorities. Effectively negotiate and defend the Company's accounting positions and manage audits to be on time and on budget. Prepare complex technical accounting and tax memos, working papers, and consolidated financial statements with note disclosures in compliance with US GAAP.

* Collaborate with FP\&A to support internal and external management reporting: Produce high\-quality monthly, quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements, MD\&A and management reports; provide thorough analysis of the financial data and effectively communicate key findings, opportunities and risk.
* Lead AI\-enabled finance automation across close, reconciliations, variance analysis, reporting, and audit support by integrating our tech stack (NetSuite, Concur, Salesforce, Adaptive Planning, UKG, Snowflake, and Claude) in partnership with AI/Systems, ensuring strong controls, data security, and documentation.
* Support the sales process through delivering financial health reviews on customer calls.
* People Leader, Coach \& Active Listener: Lead a team responsible for accounting, audit management, financial reporting and tax. Lead their training and development, performance evaluation and maintaining a healthy and collaborative work environment.
  


**What You'll Bring**


* CPA \+ experience at a top tier accounting firm \+ industry experience.
* 8 years' experience leading global accounting operations as a Controller/Director.
* 4 years of people management experience.
* Advanced knowledge of US GAAP/IFRS.
* Proficiency with NetSuite or similar ERP systems.
* Experience preparing consolidated financial statements and note disclosures and managing auditors and government agencies.
* Experience partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders to drive results.
* Egoless, Innovative and Entrepreneurial: Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. Relentless focus on improvement and raising the bar. Balances scrappiness and execution with business maturity, prioritization, and thoughtfulness. Is curious, agile, a self\-starter and welcomes challenge as a conduit to improvement. jobs.title: CFO/VP Finance
jobs.description:
**Description:**


Vice President, Finance and Administration / Chief Financial Officer
  

  

Division: Finance and Administration
  

  

Reports To: President
  

  

Direct Reports:
  

* Controller
* Executive Director, Procurement and Administrative Services
* Executive Director, Public Safety
* Executive Director, Facilities Management
* Internal Auditor

  

**Position Summary**
  

  

Our post\-secondary education client is seeking an accomplished and strategic financial executive to serve as its next Vice President, Finance and Administration / Chief Financial Officer.
  

  

As the chief financial and administrative officer and a member of the President’s Cabinet, the CFO provides executive leadership, strategic direction, and institutional stewardship for the school's financial operations, administrative services, public safety, and facilities.
  

  

This position ensures the responsible management of institutional resources while advancing the school's mission, vision, and strategic priorities. Serving as a trusted advisor to the President, the CFO helps shape institutional strategy, provides sound financial counsel, and partners with executive leadership to maintain the school's fiscal strength, operational effectiveness, and long\-term sustainability.
  

  

The successful candidate will bring an institution\-wide perspective and contribute to college\-wide initiatives, organizational culture, governance, strategic planning, and executive decision\-making.
  

  

**Executive Leadership Philosophy**
  

  

The school's Vice Presidents serve as institutional leaders first and functional leaders second. As members of the President’s Cabinet, they share responsibility for advancing the school's mission through collaborative leadership, strategic planning, innovation, and responsible stewardship of public resources.
  

  

The CFO will balance financial discipline with innovation, operational excellence with exceptional customer service, and long\-term sustainability with the evolving needs of students, employees, and the community.
  

  

Success will be measured not only by the performance of assigned departments, but also by meaningful contributions to the overall effectiveness, reputation, and future of the college.
  

  

**Core Executive Responsibilities**
  

  

Cabinet and Strategic Leadership
  

* Serve as an active member of the President’s Cabinet and executive leadership team.
* Advise the President on strategic, financial, operational, and organizational matters.
* Participate in institutional planning, executive decision\-making, and policy development.
* Collaborate across divisions to advance college\-wide initiatives and strategic priorities.
* Represent the school before governmental agencies, financial institutions, professional organizations, and community partners.
* Develop long\-range financial and operational strategies that support the school’s Strategic Plan.
* Evaluate emerging trends, risks, and opportunities affecting higher education and public finance.
* Champion innovation, continuous improvement, and responsible resource management.

  

Organizational Leadership
  

* Recruit, develop, mentor, and evaluate executive leaders and management staff.
* Build high\-performing teams committed to operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion, professionalism, and exceptional customer service.
* Promote employee engagement, leadership development, and succession planning.
* Establish measurable goals and performance expectations aligned with institutional priorities.

  

Stewardship and Governance
  

* Ensure responsible stewardship of the college’s financial, physical, and operational resources.
* Support the Board of Regents through executive reports, recommendations, and presentations.
* Develop and implement policies, administrative regulations, and business practices that strengthen institutional effectiveness.
* Ensure compliance with federal and state laws, accreditation standards, Board policies, and administrative regulations.
* Maintain effective systems of internal control, enterprise risk management, and institutional accountability.

  

**Division Leadership Responsibilities**
  

  

Financial Leadership
  

* Serve as the college’s chief financial officer and principal advisor to the President on financial strategy, fiscal sustainability, and institutional stewardship.
* Provide executive leadership for all financial operations, ensuring the integrity, transparency, and long\-term health of the college’s financial resources.
* Deliver financial analysis and recommendations that support informed decision\-making by the President, Cabinet, and Board of Regents.
* Through the Controller and Finance team, provide strategic oversight for:
* Budget development and administration
* Accounting and financial reporting
* Payroll administration
* Treasury, cash, investment, and debt management
* Annual financial audits and internal controls
* Financial forecasting and analysis
* Grant accounting and financial compliance
* State and federal financial reporting

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Director
jobs.description:
**About Beacon Software**
-------------------------


Beacon is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder\-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore.  

  

Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI\-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable.  

  

We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better.  

  

Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M\+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game.

**Role and Mission**
--------------------


This is an exciting and entrepreneurial opportunity to join a fast\-paced technology company with a very significant growth trajectory. Beacon Software is making its first hire on the Strategic Finance team. This is a role where investing turns into building. The individual will report to Beacon’s VP, Strategic Finance and work closely with Beacon’s CEO, CTO, M\&A Directors, industry pod leaders, and the General Managers of Beacon’s portfolio companies.


The Strategic Finance team’s mandate spans the financial decisions that shape Beacon: partnering with portfolio companies on growth and value creation, building AI\-native systems that let functions scale non\-linearly with the portfolio, owning Beacon’s capital allocation across organic and inorganic strategies, leading new strategy extensions beyond core software M\&A, and building Beacon’s capital markets capability. Team members work across a mix of these areas based on their interests and skillset.


This is an asymmetric opportunity to build a company, with decision authority and velocity over process driving compounding equity. You’ll sit next to the CEO on capital allocation and capital markets, or fill a CFO role across dozens of companies on their most consequential decisions. The playbook will be shaped by you with the goal of building Beacon into a $100B company.


To succeed in this role, this individual should be an enthusiastic and energetic self\-starter, with the ability to translate operator intuition into financial decisions and build the analytical rigor behind Beacon’s platform\-level bets. The ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously across portfolio companies and platform initiatives will be essential. We are seeking a collaborative professional who wants to contribute ideas on how to improve the status quo and create best\-practices that will accelerate our execution. Teamwork and positivity are key foundations of this growing team’s culture and ethos.

**Location:** for discussion. Beacon has offices in Toronto, San Francisco, New York, and Chicago.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Finance partner to acquired companies**

* Partner with industry sector leaders and portfolio company General Managers as the financial decision\-making engine across Beacon’s portfolio companies.
* Translate product, AI, and operator intuition into investment decisions: pricing changes, sales hires, direct marketing investments, engineering allocation, and tuck\-in M\&A.
* Build value creation plans, set budgets and targets, and make the day\-to\-day capital decisions that drive growth across companies.

**Beacon capital allocation**

* Help own platform\-level capital allocation: organic platform investment vs. inorganic M\&A, platform\-level acquisitions vs. tuck\-ins, debt vs. equity at the corporate level.
* Build the analytical rigor behind Beacon’s platform\-level bets, ensuring capital is deployed where returns are most asymmetric.

**Strategy extension beyond core software M\&A**

* Own thesis through acquisition through ownership for new strategy extensions, starting with software\-plus\-services vertical integration in end markets where Beacon already owns software.
* Partner with the M\&A team for execution while driving the strategy, the diligence, and the post\-close build.

**Capital markets**

* Lead Beacon’s debt strategy, support future equity raises, and prepare Beacon for an eventual IPO.
* Build best\-in\-class debt and equity investor relations and position Beacon as an institutional\-grade capital allocator.

**Build AI\-native finance systems**

* Partner with Beacon’s CTO and engineering leadership on the company\-wide tools that scale across the portfolio, including BeaconOS and AI\-native financial systems.
* Build the systems, dashboards, and decision frameworks that let sector leaders and GMs self\-serve the financial answers they need, allowing the finance function to scale non\-linearly with the portfolio.

* Strong academic record from a competitive institution with a degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
* Investor mindset, analytical toolkit, and operator instinct: equally comfortable building a model and being in the room with a product leader or GM helping them make the call.

jobs.title: Director of Data and Analytics
jobs.description:
**About Modular Solutions**



Founded in 2015, Modular Solutions delivers enterprise\-grade technology to the insurance industry. Our configurable platform helps insurers, mutuals, MGAs, and brokers manage core operations through a single system designed for flexibility, long\-term growth, and complex regulated environments.

  


**Position Summary**



Modular Solutions is seeking a Director of Data \& Analytics to own the architecture and governance of our data and analytics platform and how our data is turned into decisions, so that the data we collect becomes reporting and answers that clients and teams can trust as we continue to grow our platform, client base, and internal capabilities.

  



Reporting to the CTO, this role leads the Data function, including data engineering, data science, business intelligence, analytics, and migration, and owns the architecture of the data and analytics platform that connects them. While the data and analytics platform is the primary focus, the role also contributes to and collaborates on the data architecture and design of our core application alongside our Product and Development teams.

  



The ideal candidate is a hands\-on leader who sets direction and stays close to the work: designing the analytics data architecture, data models, and semantic layer alongside engineers rather than managing from a distance. You should bring deep experience in data architecture, data modelling, BI and analytics, and data governance, with a working knowledge of data migration and AI\-enabled workflows, along with the ability to lead people, prioritize work, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

  



This role is well suited for someone who can build structure, develop teams, improve processes, and help Modular responsibly adopt data and AI practices that create real value for clients, employees, and the platform.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Set the data strategy and long\-term roadmap for the Data function, including platforms, vendors, budget, and cost, and build a high\-performing team across data engineering, BI and analytics, and data migration.
* Own the data and analytics platform architecture: the target\-state design for how data flows out of our application into ingestion and pipelines, the data warehouse and data marts, the semantic layer, and the BI and AI tools that consume them, supported by reference architectures and documented architecture decisions.
* Define and maintain the analytics data model for insurance data, including policy, billing, claims, bordereaux, brokers, and coverage, aligned with the application's data model, so that migration, reporting, and analytics map to it consistently.
* Collaborate with Product and Development on the data architecture and design of our core application: bring a data perspective to schema and data model design, assess the downstream impact of changes, favour incremental improvements over large\-scale redesign, and establish data contracts so that application changes do not break reporting, integrations, or client deliverables.
* Own metric governance: a single set of business definitions and KPIs with clear owners, implemented once in the semantic layer and consumed consistently by BI, client reporting, and AI.
* Design how clients access their reporting and analytics data, including governed data sharing and extracts, partnering with product engineering where access runs through application APIs, with appropriate tenant isolation, security, and performance.
* Set standards for data quality, governance, privacy, security, and data residency, including PII classification, retention, lineage, and access control, in support of our security and compliance programs.
* Establish a data quality and validation framework, including automated reconciliation, testing, and certification of trusted datasets and AI\-generated outputs, so that our teams and clients can trust results at scale.
* Define the reporting operating model for standard and client\-specific reporting, including intake and prioritization, move clients toward governed self\-service analytics, and deliver executive\-level insights and advanced analytics, such as forecasting, where they create clear business value.
* Build data migration and onboarding into a repeatable capability, with a reusable conversion framework, reconciliation, and post\-migration validation, led by a dedicated migration lead.
* Build AI\-ready data foundations so that AI features call governed data and semantic models rather than calculating on their own, lead AI adoption within the Data team, and help define the product direction for self\-service and AI\-assisted analytics.
* Partner with Product, Development, Implementation, Operations, and leadership to align priorities, and communicate progress, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to executives.
* Perform other duties as required to support the Data function.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, or a related data field, including designing data platforms or data models at an organizational level.
* 3\+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical teams, while remaining hands\-on in the work.
* Proven experience designing enterprise data architecture, including data models, data warehouses and marts, ETL/ELT pipelines, semantic models, and the integration between operational systems and analytics platforms, with a track record of collaborating with application engineering teams on data design and improving existing systems incrementally.
* Hands\-on experience building and governing business definitions, metrics, or semantic models, and working directly with engineers to implement them.
* Strong grounding in data governance, data quality, privacy, and security, including access control, PII handling, lineage, and validation of data and reporting outputs.

Director, Data Engineering

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. The Director, Data Engineering for Cyber Analytics will be a key contributor in helping Mastercard develop and deliver actionable insights and products to mitigate cyber vulnerabilities across the Mastercard ecosystem.

Role:

• Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve data storage, pipelines, and ETL processes.
• Lead the design and build of graph database solutions and data models that support cyber analytics use cases.
• Partner with data scientists to understand existing ML and AI applications, identify optimization opportunities, and craft processes and solutions that streamline data engineering integration.
• Oversee the integration and management of data from various sources and storage systems to produce cohesive datasets for analysis and modeling.
• Partner with software engineering, IT, Info Sec, and infrastructure teams to deploy and validate production artifacts.
• Lead, develop, and grow a team of highly skilled data engineers.

All About You:

• Strong data engineering skills, including building data pipelines and infrastructure for ML and AI applications, with a solid understanding of ML and AI concepts to build solutions together with data scientists.
• Proficiency in graph databases and graph modeling techniques.
• Proficiency in Databricks, Spark, and AWS, with working knowledge of on-prem distributions (Apache, Hadoop, Oracle).
• Skilled in databases and big data tools such as Hive, Impala, OOZIE, Airflow, and NIFI, with working knowledge of Shell scripting and Linux/Unix systems.
• Strong computer science fundamentals in object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and complexity analysis.
• Proven ability to lead and develop a team of data engineers.
• Skilled at delegating, organizing, and motivating a team, and at prioritizing competing requests across multi-person projects.
• Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical and business partners.
• Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, propose solutions, and implement them with cross-functional teams.
• Clear, persuasive communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, in writing and verbally.
• Curiosity and adaptability, with the ability to learn new domains quickly and stay open to alternative ideas.

Preferred Skills:

• A degree in a technical field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or Computer Science, or equivalent skills gained through hands-on work.
• Knowledge of the payments, cyber, and/or fraud domains.

• Exposure to agentic AI.

Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly. 

 Corporate Security Responsibility 

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

 ClearGov is building the modern financial operating layer for the public sector. 

 We help US local governments and school districts plan, budget, report, and communicate their finances with clarity and confidence. Today, more than 2,000 public sector organizations use ClearGov, and we continue to expand our platform and reach as we grow.

 Our Core Values 

 Be Clear & Credible  

 We are authentic in our interactions, communicating with clarity, speaking with honesty, and following through with consistency. We turn transparency into our greatest competitive advantage. 

 Be Human   

 We are human partners to our colleagues and customers and lead with consideration and kindness - making space for others to do the same. We turn empathy into a shared strength.

 Be Better Together   

 We are committed to building an inclusive community where everyone thrives. We share successes, support each other through challenges, and show up for our teammates the way we show up for our customers. We turn togetherness into our greatest advantage and collaboration into our greatest multiplier.

 Be Honourable/Honorable   

 We are responsible to our colleagues and customers. We bring our full selves to every conversation, every project, every decision, and every relationship. We act with intention, deliver on our commitments, and lead with integrity - even when no one is watching. We turn honour into the foundation that powers everything we do.

 Be Connected 

 We are culture builders where people are seen, welcomed, and celebrated. We show up in every interaction - the laughs, the wins, the hard days. We turn connection into opportunities for people to feel they belong.

 What Makes You a Great Fit 

 You take ownership and follow through

 You communicate clearly and effectively

 You're comfortable solving problems and figuring things out

 You learn quickly and adapt as things change

 You care about the team, not just your own work

 You bring a sense of humor and perspective to what you do

 About the Opportunity 

 We are seeking a hands-on Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis to own enterprise-wide planning, forecasting, and performance analytics for a growth-stage SaaS business. This is not a purely oversight role, the VP, FP&A will be in the models directly, building and stress-testing scenarios, and translating the numbers into decisions. Reporting to the CFO, this person will be a key partner to executive leadership and business unit owners, and will play a central role in the company's next chapter of growth.

 We're looking for someone who wants to build, not just review, someone as comfortable inside the mechanics of a model as they are presenting its output to the CFO and board. 

 Key Responsibilities: 

 10+ years of progressive finance experience, including FP&A leadership, with a track record of being genuinely hands-on in the model — not several layers removed from it.

 Direct experience in a SaaS or recurring-revenue business, fluent in ARR, NRR, churn, cohort, and unit economics analysis.

 Strong financial modeling and scenario-planning skills — able to build complex models from scratch and pressure-test assumptions in real time.

 Exposure to an exit, sale process, recapitalization, refinancing, or similar transaction, with a working understanding of what "diligence-ready" actually looks like.

 Executive presence — able to move fluidly between deep model work and clear, confident presentation to the CFO and board.

 Strong judgment about what's urgent, what's important, and what can wait — able to prioritize across competing asks from the CFO, business leaders, and the sponsor.

 Nice-to-haves: 

 M&A diligence or post-acquisition integration experience.

 CPA, CFA, or MBA.
